nexu-io-html-anything-deck-pitch.why_en: The layout speaks fluent investor; you bring the story, it guarantees the form.

nexu-io-html-anything-data-report.tagline_zh: 把 CSV / Excel / JSON 丢进去，出一页漂亮的可视化报告：图表、要点、结论排好版直接发。
nexu-io-html-anything-data-report.tagline_en: Drop in CSV, Excel or JSON and get a polished visual report page — charts, highlights and takeaways, ready to send.
nexu-io-html-anything-data-report.why_zh: 「数据到报告」的最后一公里它包了，周会材料从两小时变两分钟。
nexu-io-html-anything-data-report.why_en: Owns the last mile from data to report; the weekly readout drops from two hours to two minutes.

nexu-io-html-anything-poster-hero.tagline_zh: 竖版海报 / 朋友圈分享图模具：强视觉冲击的大字排版，活动预告、金句卡、新品宣发都能套。
nexu-io-html-anything-poster-hero.tagline_en: Vertical poster / moments-share mold — big-type visual punch for event teasers, quote cards and launch announcements.
nexu-io-html-anything-poster-hero.why_zh: 竖图是中文社交的硬通货，这个模具把「有冲击力」做成了默认值。
nexu-io-html-anything-poster-hero.why_en: Vertical images are hard currency on Chinese social; this mold makes impact the default.

nexu-io-html-anything-frame-light-leak-c.tagline_zh: 胶片漏光 + 颗粒噪点 + 16:9 letterbox + 衬线大字：电影感开场帧和章节卡，视频转场直接用。
nexu-io-html-anything-frame-light-leak-c.tagline_en: Film light-leaks, grain, 16:9 letterbox and serif display type — cinematic openers and chapter cards for video cuts.
nexu-io-html-anything-frame-light-leak-c.why_zh: 视频质感的秘密往往就在这几帧包装，它把「电影感」做成了现成组件。
nexu-io-html-anything-frame-light-leak-c.why_en: Video polish lives in these few frames; this ships "cinematic" as a component.

kkkkhazix-khazix-skills-leader.tagline_zh: 把一句话的想法拆成 agent 能独立跑完的目标任务书：先实测代码库、必要时联网调研，再写 brief。
kkkkhazix-khazix-skills-leader.tagline_en: Turns a one-liner into a goal brief an agent can run solo — it inspects the repo and researches first, then writes the spec.
kkkkhazix-khazix-skills-leader.why_zh: 「给 agent 派活」本身是门手艺，它把卡兹克派活的章法做成了可复用模板。
kkkkhazix-khazix-skills-leader.why_en: Delegating to agents is a craft; this templates how Khazix actually does it.

kkkkhazix-khazix-skills-storage-analyzer.tagline_zh: 只读扫描整机磁盘找出占空间大户，分成🟢可自动清 / 🟡需判断 / 🔴谨慎三级，出一份可交互的清理报告。
kkkkhazix-khazix-skills-storage-analyzer.tagline_en: Read-only full-disk scan that finds the space hogs, triages them green/yellow/red, and emits an interactive cleanup report.
kkkkhazix-khazix-skills-storage-analyzer.why_zh: 「只读扫描 + 分级处置」的安全设计很讲究，普通人也敢放心跑；报告还能一键删除。
kkkkhazix-khazix-skills-storage-analyzer.why_en: Read-only scanning with triaged actions — safe enough for anyone to run; the report even offers one-click cleanup.

phuryn-pm-skills-create-prd.tagline_zh: 用 8 段式标准模板写 PRD：问题、目标、用户分层、价值主张、方案、指标一节不落，评审直接能过。
phuryn-pm-skills-create-prd.tagline_en: PRDs on the comprehensive 8-section template — problem, objectives, segments, value props, solution, metrics, review-ready.
phuryn-pm-skills-create-prd.why_zh: PRD 的价值在完整性而不是文采，这个模板逼你把每个该想的坑都想一遍。
phuryn-pm-skills-create-prd.why_en: A PRD's value is completeness, not prose; this template forces every box you'd otherwise skip.

phuryn-pm-skills-pre-mortem.tagline_zh: 发布之前先假设「项目已经死了」再倒推死因：真老虎、纸老虎、房间里的大象三类风险分开处置。
phuryn-pm-skills-pre-mortem.tagline_en: Assume the launch already failed and work backwards — risks triaged into Tigers, Paper Tigers and Elephants, each handled.
phuryn-pm-skills-pre-mortem.why_zh: 事前验尸是被验证过最有效的风险仪式之一，三分类法让讨论不再各说各话。
phuryn-pm-skills-pre-mortem.why_en: Pre-mortems are among the best-validated risk rituals; the triage keeps the discussion honest.

phuryn-pm-skills-strategy-red-team.tagline_zh: 红队你的 PRD、路线图或战略：先钢人再攻击每条承重假设，按失败概率排序，赶在现实动手之前。
phuryn-pm-skills-strategy-red-team.tagline_en: Red-teams your PRD or strategy — steelmans then attacks each load-bearing assumption, ranked by failure odds, before reality does.
phuryn-pm-skills-strategy-red-team.why_zh: 「先钢人再攻击」保证批评有质量，比开会互相客气有用得多。
phuryn-pm-skills-strategy-red-team.why_en: Steelman-then-attack guarantees quality criticism — far better than a polite meeting.

phuryn-pm-skills-opportunity-solution-tr.tagline_zh: 用 Teresa Torres 的 OST 结构化产品发现：期望结果→机会→解法→实验，一棵树理清整个探索。
phuryn-pm-skills-opportunity-solution-tr.tagline_en: Structures discovery with Teresa Torres' Opportunity Solution Tree — outcome to opportunities to solutions to experiments.
phuryn-pm-skills-opportunity-solution-tr.why_zh: OST 是当代产品发现的事实标准，这件把画树的方法论直接内置了。
phuryn-pm-skills-opportunity-solution-tr.why_en: The OST is modern discovery's de facto standard; the methodology comes built in.

coreyhaines31-marketingskills-cold-email.tagline_zh: 写真能收到回复的 B2B 冷邮件和跟进序列：钩子、个性化、CTA 的配比全按实战回复率调过。
coreyhaines31-marketingskills-cold-email.tagline_en: B2B cold emails and follow-up sequences that actually get replies — hooks, personalization and CTAs tuned on real response data.
coreyhaines31-marketingskills-cold-email.why_zh: 冷邮件是回复率的游戏，这套模板来自发过成千上万封的实操者。
coreyhaines31-marketingskills-cold-email.why_en: Cold email is a reply-rate game; these templates come from someone who's sent thousands.

coreyhaines31-marketingskills-copywritin.tagline_zh: 写或重写任何营销页文案：首页、落地页、定价页、功能页，痛点—收益—证据的骨架现成套用不跑偏。
coreyhaines31-marketingskills-copywritin.tagline_en: Write or rewrite copy for any marketing page — home, landing, pricing, features — on the pain-benefit-proof skeleton.
coreyhaines31-marketingskills-copywritin.why_zh: 文案的骨架比辞藻重要，它先把结构立对，再谈句子漂不漂亮。
coreyhaines31-marketingskills-copywritin.why_en: Copy is structure first, sentences second; this gets the skeleton right before polish.

coreyhaines31-marketingskills-launch.tagline_zh: 产品发布的完整作战计划：Product Hunt、邮件、社媒、社区的节奏编排，倒计时清单一张表。
coreyhaines31-marketingskills-launch.tagline_en: A full launch battle plan — Product Hunt, email, social and community sequenced on one countdown checklist.
coreyhaines31-marketingskills-launch.why_zh: 发布是编排问题不是灵感问题，这张作战图把该踩的点全排好了。
coreyhaines31-marketingskills-launch.why_en: Launches are choreography, not inspiration; every beat is already on the sheet.

coreyhaines31-marketingskills-pricing.tagline_zh: 定价、打包、货币化的决策参谋：梯度设计、价格锚定、免费额度的取舍，用框架推演代替拍脑袋。
coreyhaines31-marketingskills-pricing.tagline_en: A staff officer for pricing, packaging and monetization — tiers, anchoring and free-plan trade-offs by framework, not gut.
coreyhaines31-marketingskills-pricing.why_zh: 定价是杠杆最大的营销决策，却最常被拍脑袋；有个框架能避开大部分经典错误。
coreyhaines31-marketingskills-pricing.why_en: Pricing is marketing's biggest lever and its most winged decision; frameworks dodge the classic errors.

coreyhaines31-marketingskills-marketing-.tagline_zh: 把行为科学真正用进营销：损失厌恶、社会证明、稀缺、承诺一致，每条心理学原理都配一套落地打法。
coreyhaines31-marketingskills-marketing-.tagline_en: Behavioral science applied to marketing — loss aversion, social proof, scarcity, commitment — each principle with a play.
coreyhaines31-marketingskills-marketing-.why_zh: 原理谁都听过，难在落地；它把每条心理学都翻译成了可执行的动作。
coreyhaines31-marketingskills-marketing-.why_en: Everyone knows the principles; this translates each into an executable move.

wondelai-skills-mom-test.tagline_zh: 照《Mom Test》的规矩做用户访谈：聊对方的生活别聊你的点子、问过去的具体事、少说话。
wondelai-skills-mom-test.tagline_en: Customer interviews by Mom Test rules — their life not your idea, specific past events, and you talk less.
wondelai-skills-mom-test.why_zh: 访谈最大的坑是诱导，这三条规矩就是解药；问完你才知道之前听到的都是客气话。
wondelai-skills-mom-test.why_en: Leading questions ruin interviews; these rules are the antidote — and expose all the polite lies you'd been collecting.

wondelai-skills-hundred-million-offers.tagline_zh: 按 Hormozi 的价值方程设计报价：堆奖励、逆转风险、道德稀缺，把「贵」变成「不买亏了」。
wondelai-skills-hundred-million-offers.tagline_en: Offers by Hormozi's Value Equation — bonus stacking, risk reversal, ethical scarcity; "expensive" becomes "can't-miss".
wondelai-skills-hundred-million-offers.why_zh: 这本书的方法论以「照做就涨转化」著称，做成 skill 后连表格都替你画好了。
wondelai-skills-hundred-million-offers.why_en: The book is famous for working as-written; as a skill it even draws the worksheets for you.

wondelai-skills-negotiation.tagline_zh: 用战术同理心、校准问题和 Ackerman 报价法准备并执行谈判：谈薪、谈合同、谈价格都用得上。
wondelai-skills-negotiation.tagline_en: Negotiation prep and execution with tactical empathy, calibrated questions and the Ackerman plan — salary, contracts, deals.
wondelai-skills-negotiation.why_zh: 源自 FBI 谈判专家 Voss 的方法论，谈薪之前跑一遍，气势和话术都不一样。
wondelai-skills-negotiation.why_en: Voss's FBI-honed method; run it before a salary talk and both your posture and lines change.

wondelai-skills-steve-jobs-design-review.tagline_zh: 用乔布斯的标准审你的设计和产品：无情的简化、极致的聚焦、端到端的苛刻，说「不」说到只剩下本质。
wondelai-skills-steve-jobs-design-review.tagline_en: Your design reviewed to Jobs' standards — ruthless simplification, focus, end-to-end excellence, "no" until only essence remains.
wondelai-skills-steve-jobs-design-review.why_zh: 半玩梗半真刀：被它砍完一轮，产品里那些「舍不得删」的东西基本都暴露了。
wondelai-skills-steve-jobs-design-review.why_en: Half homage, half scalpel — one pass exposes everything you kept out of sentiment.

wondelai-skills-refactoring-ui.tagline_zh: 照《Refactoring UI》审并修你的界面：层级、间距、颜色、深度逐项体检，「说不上哪不对」有救了。
wondelai-skills-refactoring-ui.tagline_en: UI triage by the Refactoring UI playbook — hierarchy, spacing, color and depth examined; "something feels off" gets fixed.
wondelai-skills-refactoring-ui.why_zh: Tailwind 作者的书是前端审美第一入门，做成 skill 等于随叫随到的会诊。
wondelai-skills-refactoring-ui.why_en: The Tailwind authors' book is the first stop for frontend taste; as a skill it's a consult on call.

k-dense-ai-scientific-agent-skills-citat.title_zh: 每条引用都回数据库核验，揪出 AI 编造的参考文献
k-dense-ai-scientific-agent-skills-citat.tagline_zh: 检索 OpenAlex、PubMed、Google Scholar，抽取准确元数据、校验引用、格式化文献——引用错误终结者。
k-dense-ai-scientific-agent-skills-citat.tagline_en: Searches OpenAlex, PubMed and Scholar, extracts clean metadata, validates and formats citations — the reference-error killer.
k-dense-ai-scientific-agent-skills-citat.why_zh: AI 编造引用是学术圈最怕的事，它反其道而行：每条引用都可验证、有出处。
k-dense-ai-scientific-agent-skills-citat.why_en: Fabricated citations are academia's nightmare; this does the opposite — every reference verifiable.
k-dense-ai-scientific-agent-skills-citat.limit_zh: 要 Python 3.9+ 和 requests，还要连得上 openalex、crossref、pubmed。Google Scholar 没有 API，靠 scholarly 爬，每条歇 2 到 5 秒还常被封，作者自己说只能当补充。
k-dense-ai-scientific-agent-skills-citat.limit_en: Needs Python 3.9+ with requests plus network access to openalex, crossref and pubmed. Google Scholar has no API: scholarly scrapes it, sleeps 2-5s per result and is blocked often, so the skill itself calls it a supplement.
k-dense-ai-scientific-agent-skills-citat.title_en: Kills the fabricated citation before your reviewer finds it
k-dense-ai-scientific-agent-skills-citat._无封面原因: docs/images/ 下有 170 张 1536x864 的同模板图，一件 skill 一张 —— 这是宣传/说明卡阵列，正是「OG 卡片混进产出物」那个坑。我开了对题的那张 citation-management.png：是一幅做得挺漂亮的信息图（DISCOVERY 三列 OpenAlex/PubMed/Google Scholar → METADATA extract_metadata.py + WebSearch enrichment → references.bi
k-dense-ai-scientific-agent-skills-citat.cover_note: 托管的是 GitHub 预览卡（1200×600/630），不上卡

k-dense-ai-scientific-agent-skills-latex.tagline_zh: 用 beamerposter / tikzposter 做会议海报：版式、字号、配色按学术规范来，LaTeX 源码直接可编译。
k-dense-ai-scientific-agent-skills-latex.tagline_en: Conference posters in beamerposter or tikzposter — layout, sizing and color by academic convention, compile-ready LaTeX.
k-dense-ai-scientific-agent-skills-latex.why_zh: 会前一晚赶海报是科研人共同记忆，它把这晚从灾难变成一小时的事。
k-dense-ai-scientific-agent-skills-latex.why_en: The night-before poster scramble is a shared academic trauma; this turns it into an hour.

k-dense-ai-scientific-agent-skills-exper.title_zh: 在收第一条数据之前，把随机化和分块设计定下来
k-dense-ai-scientific-agent-skills-exper.tagline_zh: 在收数据之前把实验设计好：选设计、做随机化、设分块、排处理组合，保证结果在统计上真正站得住。
k-dense-ai-scientific-agent-skills-exper.tagline_en: Design the study before data exists — choose the design, randomize, block, lay out treatments so results hold statistically.
k-dense-ai-scientific-agent-skills-exper.why_zh: 设计错了数据就废了，这一步的价值在事后无法弥补，只能事前做对。
k-dense-ai-scientific-agent-skills-exper.why_en: A flawed design can't be rescued in analysis; this is the only stage where rigor is cheap.
k-dense-ai-scientific-agent-skills-exper.limit_zh: 只管收数据前那一步：样本量交给 statistical-power，数据分析交给 statistical-analysis，本件两样都不做。脚本要 Python 3.10 以上，外加 numpy、pandas 和 pyDOE3。
k-dense-ai-scientific-agent-skills-exper.limit_en: It covers only the step before data exists: sample size is handed off to the statistical-power skill and analysis to statistical-analysis, neither of which it does. Scripts need Python 3.10+ with numpy, pandas and pyDOE3 installed.
k-dense-ai-scientific-agent-skills-exper.title_en: Designs the experiment before any data exists

k-dense-ai-scientific-agent-skills-dhdna.tagline_zh: 从任何文本里提取认知模式和思维指纹：这个人怎么推理、怎么取舍、口头禅背后藏着什么思考习惯。
k-dense-ai-scientific-agent-skills-dhdna.tagline_en: Extracts cognitive patterns and thinking fingerprints from any text — how someone reasons, trades off, and defaults.
k-dense-ai-scientific-agent-skills-dhdna.why_zh: 用途很妙：研究你欣赏的作者、复盘自己的写作，甚至给团队做「思维画像」。
k-dense-ai-scientific-agent-skills-dhdna.why_en: Delightfully versatile — profile authors you admire, audit your own writing, map how your team thinks.

agricidaniel-claude-seo-seo-geo.tagline_zh: 针对 AI Overviews、ChatGPT 搜索、Perplexity 做优化：让 AI 引用你，而不只是 Google 收录你。
agricidaniel-claude-seo-seo-geo.tagline_en: Optimize for AI Overviews, ChatGPT search and Perplexity — get cited by the AI, not just indexed by Google.
agricidaniel-claude-seo-seo-geo.why_zh: 搜索的入口正在换代，GEO 是下一个五年的 SEO；这件是全包里最有先手价值的。
agricidaniel-claude-seo-seo-geo.why_en: Search's front door is changing; GEO is the next five years of SEO, and this is the pack's best head start.

agricidaniel-claude-seo-seo-content-brie.tagline_zh: 生成有竞争力的 SEO 内容简报：分节字数、竞品得分、关键词密度指引、页面类型模板一次备齐。
agricidaniel-claude-seo-seo-content-brie.tagline_en: Competitive SEO content briefs — per-section word counts, competitor scoring, keyword guidance and page-type templates.
agricidaniel-claude-seo-seo-content-brie.why_zh: 好简报是内容团队的图纸，写手照着写就不会跑题跑量。
agricidaniel-claude-seo-seo-content-brie.why_en: A good brief is the blueprint; writers who follow it can't miss the target.

agricidaniel-claude-seo-seo-technical.tagline_zh: 九大类技术 SEO 审计：可抓取性、索引、安全、URL、移动端、Core Web Vitals、结构化数据、JS 渲染。
agricidaniel-claude-seo-seo-technical.tagline_en: Technical SEO audit across nine categories — crawlability, indexing, security, URLs, mobile, CWV, schema, JS rendering.
agricidaniel-claude-seo-seo-technical.why_zh: 技术问题是内容再好也救不回的地基病，九类清单查完基本无死角。
agricidaniel-claude-seo-seo-technical.why_en: Technical faults sink great content; nine categories leave few blind spots.

affaan-m-ecc-brand-voice.tagline_zh: 从你的真实文字（推文、文章、发布稿）提炼写作风格档案，之后所有内容都按这个声纹稳定产出。
affaan-m-ecc-brand-voice.tagline_en: Builds a style profile from your real posts, essays and launch notes, then writes everything in that voice thereafter.
affaan-m-ecc-brand-voice.why_zh: 「学我说话」的正确做法：从语料反推而不是拍脑袋描述，产出稳定得多。
affaan-m-ecc-brand-voice.why_en: The right way to "sound like me" — derived from corpus, not adjectives; far more stable output.

affaan-m-ecc-investor-materials.tagline_zh: Pitch deck、one-pager、投资人备忘录、加速器申请、财务模型——融资要交的作业一个屋子备齐。
affaan-m-ecc-investor-materials.tagline_en: Pitch decks, one-pagers, investor memos, accelerator apps, financial models — the whole fundraising homework in one room.
affaan-m-ecc-investor-materials.why_zh: 融资材料讲究格式惯例，它把 VC 想看的结构都内置了，创始人专心讲故事。
affaan-m-ecc-investor-materials.why_en: Fundraising docs run on convention; the VC-expected structures are built in, you bring the story.

affaan-m-ecc-content-engine.tagline_zh: 为 X、LinkedIn、TikTok、YouTube、newsletter 建平台原生的内容系统，一次创作多端改写分发。
affaan-m-ecc-content-engine.tagline_en: Platform-native content systems for X, LinkedIn, TikTok, YouTube and newsletters — create once, adapt and ship everywhere.
affaan-m-ecc-content-engine.why_zh: 「多平台运营」的解不是复制粘贴而是系统化改写，它把这套流程做成了机器。
affaan-m-ecc-content-engine.why_en: Multi-platform isn't copy-paste, it's systematic adaptation — and this is the machine for it.

wshobson-agents-before-you-build.tagline_zh: 动手做任何大功能之前先跑一遍风险评审：需求、市场、技术、成本四面照妖，趁便宜先杀死坏项目。
wshobson-agents-before-you-build.tagline_en: Risk review before you build anything big — demand, market, technical and cost lenses; kill bad projects while they're cheap.
wshobson-agents-before-you-build.why_zh: 最贵的浪费是把不该做的东西做完，这一小时的评审可能省下三个月。
wshobson-agents-before-you-build.why_en: The costliest waste is finishing what shouldn't exist; one hour here can save three months.

wshobson-agents-data-storytelling.tagline_zh: 把数据变成有说服力的叙事：可视化、上下文、结构三件套齐上，向老板汇报和写分析报告都压得住场。
wshobson-agents-data-storytelling.tagline_en: Turn data into persuasive narrative — visualization, context and structure; built for exec readouts and analysis writeups.
wshobson-agents-data-storytelling.why_zh: 数字不会自己说话，会讲的人升职快；这套结构就是「会讲」的模板。
wshobson-agents-data-storytelling.why_en: Numbers don't speak; people who narrate them do — this is the template for narrating well.

wshobson-agents-brand-landingpage.tagline_zh: 先做一轮品牌身份访谈（配色、字体、形状语言），再生成并反复迭代一整张真正有品牌感的落地页。
wshobson-agents-brand-landingpage.tagline_en: Runs a brand-identity interview — colors, type, shape language — then generates and iterates a landing page that feels like you.
wshobson-agents-brand-landingpage.why_zh: 先访谈再生成的顺序很对：页面不是模板换字，而是从品牌人格长出来的。
wshobson-agents-brand-landingpage.why_en: Interview-first is the right order; the page grows from brand identity instead of template swapping.

samuraigpt-generative-media-skills-muapi.tagline_zh: 把一张人像照变成 3D 手办：连收藏级玩具包装盒都一起生成，发朋友圈的「本人手办」梗图神器。
samuraigpt-generative-media-skills-muapi.tagline_en: A portrait photo becomes a 3D action figure — collectible toy packaging included; the ultimate "me as a figurine" meme.
samuraigpt-generative-media-skills-muapi.why_zh: 病毒式玩法的代表作：效果一眼惊艳，人人都想拿自己试一张。
samuraigpt-generative-media-skills-muapi.why_en: Peak viral toy — instantly impressive, and everyone wants one of themselves.

samuraigpt-generative-media-skills-muapi.tagline_zh: 照片变皮克斯风 3D 卡通角色，再照一段参考舞蹈视频让它跳起来——自己的卡通分身在跳舞。
samuraigpt-generative-media-skills-muapi.tagline_en: Your photo becomes a Pixar-style 3D character, then dances along to any reference motion video — your cartoon self, dancing.
samuraigpt-generative-media-skills-muapi.why_zh: 「形象生成 + 动作迁移」两步串成一键，出片效果是社交平台的天然爆款。
samuraigpt-generative-media-skills-muapi.why_en: Character gen plus motion transfer in one shot — natural-born social media virality.

samuraigpt-generative-media-skills-muapi.tagline_zh: 人像照 + 衣服图 = 上身效果：还能顺手生成一段职业模特展示视频，网购决策和电商拍摄都省了。
samuraigpt-generative-media-skills-muapi.tagline_en: Portrait plus garment photo equals a realistic try-on — with an optional model video; saves both shopping doubts and shoots.
samuraigpt-generative-media-skills-muapi.why_zh: 试衣是视觉生成最有实用价值的场景之一，买家卖家两头都用得上。
samuraigpt-generative-media-skills-muapi.why_en: Try-on is generative imaging at its most practical — useful on both sides of the checkout.

samuraigpt-generative-media-skills-muapi.tagline_zh: 生成病毒式「会说话的婴儿」视频：自定义服装和台词脚本，让一个奶声奶气的小孩替你一本正经说暴论。
samuraigpt-generative-media-skills-muapi.tagline_en: The viral talking-baby video, on demand — custom costumes and script; let a toddler deliver your hottest takes.
samuraigpt-generative-media-skills-muapi.why_zh: 短视频平台验证过无数次的爆款格式，现在变成了一句话的事。
samuraigpt-generative-media-skills-muapi.why_en: A format proven viral a thousand times over — now one sentence away.

samuraigpt-generative-media-skills-muapi.tagline_zh: 拍下你的房间让它重新设计：换风格、摆家具、出多个方案对比图，装修花钱之前先在效果图里住一遍。
samuraigpt-generative-media-skills-muapi.tagline_en: Photograph your room and let it redesign — new styles, furniture, multiple concepts; live in the render before you renovate.
samuraigpt-generative-media-skills-muapi.why_zh: 装修是低频高价决策，先看效果图再花钱，这个顺序值回所有 token。
samuraigpt-generative-media-skills-muapi.why_en: Renovation is high-stakes and infrequent; seeing before spending is worth every token.

samuraigpt-generative-media-skills-muapi.tagline_zh: 给个歌曲主题就出一支短 MV：生成 N 张关键帧、逐帧动起来、再配上匹配的音乐，全流程自动。
samuraigpt-generative-media-skills-muapi.tagline_en: A song theme in, a short music video out — keyframes generated, animated, and scored with matching music, end to end.
samuraigpt-generative-media-skills-muapi.why_zh: MV 是最贵的内容形态之一，它把整条生产线压成了一个 prompt。
samuraigpt-generative-media-skills-muapi.why_en: Music videos are among the priciest formats; this compresses the whole line into a prompt.

samuraigpt-generative-media-skills-muapi.tagline_zh: 生成小红书风格封面图：鲜亮的生活感画面配平台审美的字效排版，笔记的点开率就赢在这张图上。
samuraigpt-generative-media-skills-muapi.tagline_en: Xiaohongshu-style covers — vibrant lifestyle imagery with platform-native typography; the click happens on this image.
samuraigpt-generative-media-skills-muapi.why_zh: 小红书是封面决定命运的平台，这件专攻那 0.5 秒的第一眼。
samuraigpt-generative-media-skills-muapi.why_en: On XHS the cover decides your fate; this attacks exactly that half-second.

mattpocock-skills.tagline_zh: TypeScript 圈顶流 Matt Pocock 的 .agents 目录直出：真工程师日常在用的 skills，原汁原味打包。
mattpocock-skills.tagline_en: Straight from Matt Pocock's .agents directory — the skills a real engineer runs daily, shipped unedited.
mattpocock-skills.why_zh: 「从自己工作目录里掏出来」是最高级的背书，比精心策划的合集更真实。
mattpocock-skills.why_en: Pulled from his own working directory — the most honest endorsement a skill pack can have.

garrytan-gstack.title_zh: YC 掌门的 Claude Code 全套配置，23 个角色分工
garrytan-gstack.tagline_zh: YC 掌门 Garry Tan 的 Claude Code 配置原样开源：23 个工具分饰 CEO、设计师、工程经理、QA。
garrytan-gstack.tagline_en: YC president Garry Tan's exact Claude Code setup — 23 opinionated tools playing CEO, designer, EM, release manager and QA.
garrytan-gstack.why_zh: 看顶级投资人怎么用 agent 干活，光是角色分工这张图就值得装一遍。
garrytan-gstack.why_en: How a top investor actually runs agents — the role division alone is worth the install.
garrytan-gstack.limit_zh: 这是一套流程，不是一个会写代码的人设，只要聊天式回答会嫌它啰嗦。随件 scripts/preflight-agent-sdk.ts 里写着 permissionMode: 'bypassPermissions'，设计文档也把 --dangerously-skip-permissions 当 CI 用法写；跑之前知道这件事。59 件。

nextlevelbuilder-ui-ux-pro-max-skill.tagline_zh: UI/UX 设计智能合集：84 种风格、192 套配色、74 组字体搭配、98 条 UX 守则，本地可检索。
nextlevelbuilder-ui-ux-pro-max-skill.tagline_en: A searchable local design brain — 84 styles, 192 palettes, 74 font pairings and 98 UX rules for web and mobile.
nextlevelbuilder-ui-ux-pro-max-skill.why_zh: 生态里星数最高的设计 skill 之一：它不替你设计，它让你查得到「好设计长什么样」。
nextlevelbuilder-ui-ux-pro-max-skill.why_en: One of the highest-starred design skills around — not designing for you, but making good design lookup-able.

nextlevelbuilder-ui-ux-pro-max-skill-ui-.tagline_zh: 主技能本体：按产品类型检索风格、配色、字体、UX 规则的完整本地数据库，设计决策先查证据再拍板。
nextlevelbuilder-ui-ux-pro-max-skill-ui-.tagline_en: The main engine — query styles, palettes, fonts and UX rules by product type; look it up before you decide.
nextlevelbuilder-ui-ux-pro-max-skill-ui-.why_zh: 把「设计感觉」变成「设计检索」，新手也能做出有依据的选择。
nextlevelbuilder-ui-ux-pro-max-skill-ui-.why_en: Turns design intuition into design retrieval — beginners get defensible choices.

nextlevelbuilder-ui-ux-pro-max-skill-ban.tagline_zh: 社媒、广告、网站 hero、印刷物的 banner 设计：多套美术方向备选，AI 生成视觉素材直接可用。
nextlevelbuilder-ui-ux-pro-max-skill-ban.tagline_en: Banners for social, ads, website heroes and print — multiple art directions with AI-generated visuals ready to ship.
nextlevelbuilder-ui-ux-pro-max-skill-ban.why_zh: banner 是设计需求里频次最高的杂活，它把「多方向提案」这步也自动化了。
nextlevelbuilder-ui-ux-pro-max-skill-ban.why_en: Banners are design's highest-frequency chore; even the multi-direction pitch is automated.

msitarzewski-agency-agents.tagline_zh: 一整间 AI 代理公司装进口袋：前端巫师、Reddit 社区忍者、奇思注入师、现实检验官，各司其职。
msitarzewski-agency-agents.tagline_en: A whole agency in your pocket — frontend wizards, Reddit ninjas, whimsy injectors and reality checkers, each a specialist.
msitarzewski-agency-agents.why_zh: 角色化分工做得很有戏：不是一个全能 AI，而是一屋子性格分明的专家。
msitarzewski-agency-agents.why_en: The casting is the charm — not one omni-AI but a room of specialists with personality.

zarazhangrui-frontend-slides.tagline_zh: 用前端手艺做惊艳的 HTML 演示：动画丰富、可从 PPT 转换，浏览器里放映比 Keynote 还带感。
zarazhangrui-frontend-slides.tagline_en: Stunning animation-rich HTML presentations built with frontend craft — converts from PowerPoint, presents in the browser.
zarazhangrui-frontend-slides.why_zh: 网页做幻灯片的自由度是 PPT 给不了的，这件把门槛降到一句话。
zarazhangrui-frontend-slides.why_en: The browser gives freedom PowerPoint can't; this drops the barrier to one sentence.

tt-a1i-archify-archify.title_zh: 画出来的架构图要和代码对得上，导出自带动效的 HTML
tt-a1i-archify-archify.tagline_zh: 产出可验证的架构、时序、数据流、生命周期图：自包含 HTML 自带动效，导出清晰锐利可直接交付。
tt-a1i-archify-archify.tagline_en: Validated architecture, sequence, data-flow and lifecycle diagrams — self-contained HTML with motion, crisp exports.
tt-a1i-archify-archify.why_zh: 「可验证」是关键词：图和描述对得上号，不是好看但骗人的装饰画。
tt-a1i-archify-archify.why_en: "Verifiable" is the keyword — diagrams that match reality, not pretty fiction.
tt-a1i-archify-archify.limit_zh: 靠 node bin/archify.mjs 出图；收尾的 visual-check 要本机有 Chrome，没有就退出码 2 给张 skipped 收据。只做架构、流程、时序、数据流、生命周期五类，主节点建议不超过 12 个。
tt-a1i-archify-archify.limit_en: Everything runs through node bin/archify.mjs, and the closing visual-check needs local Chrome — without it you get exit code 2 and a skipped receipt. Five diagram types only, ~12 primary nodes max, and the layout targets desktop widths.
tt-a1i-archify-archify.title_en: Architecture diagrams that get checked against the code

op7418-guizang-social-card-skill.title_zh: 照片多到选不出就让它自己拼三张动图卡
op7418-guizang-social-card-skill.tagline_zh: 歸藏风格社交卡片全家桶：小红书轮播、微信 21:9+1:1 封面对、Live Photo 动卡，28 版式 10 主题。
op7418-guizang-social-card-skill.tagline_en: Guizang-style social cards — XHS carousels, WeChat cover pairs, Live Photo motion cards; 28 layouts, 10 themes.
op7418-guizang-social-card-skill.why_zh: 歸藏是中文 AI 设计内容的头部创作者，这套编辑部×瑞士风的版式体系就是他的招牌。
op7418-guizang-social-card-skill.why_en: Guizang is a top Chinese AI-design creator; this editorial-Swiss layout system is his signature.
op7418-guizang-social-card-skill.limit_zh: 出图靠本机浏览器截图，核查跑 node validate-social-deck.mjs。实况卡要 makelive 打成 .pvt 再 AirDrop 到 iPhone 发，桌面端认不出。OOTD 全身、美食大片、Y2K 风明说不接。
op7418-guizang-social-card-skill.limit_en: Rendering needs a local browser screenshot pass plus node validate-social-deck.mjs. Live Photo cards must be packed into .pvt with makelive and AirDropped to an iPhone; desktop upload can't publish. OOTD and food-styling posts are refused.
op7418-guizang-social-card-skill.title_en: Auto-compose 3-shot Live Photo cards from your pile
op7418-guizang-social-card-skill.cover_note: 命令：`git clone --depth 1 https://github.com/op7418/guizang-social-card-skill; 按 references/production-workflow.md 在 local-tests/swiss-three-rules/index.html 用 assets/template-swiss-card`。我造的 demo（卡片上的文字是我写的，内容取自这件 skill 自己 references/style-system.md 里的硬规则，不是编的）

eugeniughelbur-obsidian-second-brain.title_zh: 让新资料改写旧笔记，而不是在 Obsidian 里越堆越多
eugeniughelbur-obsidian-second-brain.tagline_zh: 把 Obsidian 库运营成会自我改写的第二大脑：新资料改写旧页面而不是堆新笔记，越用越干净。
eugeniughelbur-obsidian-second-brain.tagline_en: Runs your Obsidian vault as a self-rewriting second brain — new sources revise existing pages instead of piling notes.
eugeniughelbur-obsidian-second-brain.why_zh: 「改写而非堆积」师承 Karpathy 的 LLM Wiki 思路，直击笔记软件越用越乱的死穴。
eugeniughelbur-obsidian-second-brain.why_en: Rewrite-don't-accumulate, à la Karpathy's LLM Wiki — aimed at the exact reason vaults rot.
eugeniughelbur-obsidian-second-brain.limit_zh: 脚本层要 Python 3.10+ 和 uv，/x-read、/x-pulse 必须自备 xAI Grok key。正文自认在 1000+ 笔记库首跑 recall@10 是 0%——raw/ 与 log.md 会压垮词频排序。
eugeniughelbur-obsidian-second-brain.limit_en: The script layer needs Python 3.10+ with uv, and /x-read and /x-pulse require your own xAI Grok key. The text reports a first retrieval run on a 1,000+ note vault scoring 0% recall@10 - long raw/ transcripts and log.md dominate ranking.
eugeniughelbur-obsidian-second-brain.title_en: Notes that rewrite themselves instead of piling up

francyjglisboa-agent-skill-creator.title_zh: 把口头流程变成能跑的跨平台技能，三步内交付
francyjglisboa-agent-skill-creator.tagline_zh: 把任何工作流写成一次、装到 17 个平台：Claude Code、Cursor、Copilot、Gemini 全兼容的 skill 铸造机。
francyjglisboa-agent-skill-creator.tagline_en: Write a workflow once, install it on 17 platforms — a skill foundry compatible with Claude Code, Cursor, Copilot and more.
francyjglisboa-agent-skill-creator.why_zh: 跨平台是 skill 生态的下一站。
francyjglisboa-agent-skill-creator.why_en: Cross-platform is the ecosystem's next stop; this ships write-once-run-anywhere early.
francyjglisboa-agent-skill-creator.limit_zh: 17 个平台里只有 12 个原样能装，Cursor、Windsurf 等 4 个要转格式，Zed、Aider 等 4 个得你手抄进配置。校验和安全扫描都是 python3 脚本，过了它会直接装进你的配置目录。
francyjglisboa-agent-skill-creator.limit_en: Of 17 platforms only 12 install SKILL.md as-is; 4 (Cursor, Windsurf, Trae, Junie) are auto-rewritten and 4 (Zed, Augment, Aider, Continue) need manual copying. Validation and security scan are python3 scripts; it auto-installs on pass.
francyjglisboa-agent-skill-creator.title_en: Turn spoken workflows into installable cross-platform.

nolangz-pixel2motion.title_zh: 把 PNG 的 Logo 转成 SVG 再动起来，附动效 QA 证据
nolangz-pixel2motion.tagline_zh: 把位图 Logo（PNG/截图都行）转成干净的极简 SVG，再做成丝滑动画：HTML 演示、GIF、视频全出。
nolangz-pixel2motion.tagline_en: Raster logo in — clean minimal SVG out, then animated: HTML demos, GIFs and video previews, with motion QA evidence.
nolangz-pixel2motion.why_zh: 「位图转矢量再动起来」是设计师收费不菲的活，它连动效 QA 证据都一起交付。
nolangz-pixel2motion.why_en: Vectorize-then-animate is a billable designer job; this even ships motion QA receipts.
nolangz-pixel2motion.limit_zh: 交付是 logo.svg、独立 HTML 和 PNG 帧条——正文没有 GIF 或视频导出这一步。要 python3 配 Pillow/numpy、无头 Chrome，动效取证还要 Playwright。拟合有 10 轮上限，超了就挑最好一版交。
nolangz-pixel2motion.limit_en: Deliverables are logo.svg, a standalone HTML showcase and PNG frame strips - no GIF or video export appears in the body. Needs python3 with Pillow/numpy, headless Chrome, and Playwright for frame capture. Fitting caps at 10 iterations.
nolangz-pixel2motion.title_en: Your PNG logo, vectorized, animated, and QA'd

agricidaniel-claude-blog.tagline_zh: 30 个子技能 + 5 个代理的博客套件：五道交付关卡，同时向 Google 排名和 AI 引用双重优化。
agricidaniel-claude-blog.tagline_en: A 30-sub-skill, 5-agent blog suite with a five-gate delivery contract — dual-optimized for Google rank and AI citation.
agricidaniel-claude-blog.why_zh: 「交付关卡」的设计把内容质量做成了流程保证，双优化的思路也很超前。
agricidaniel-claude-blog.why_en: Delivery gates make quality procedural, and the dual-optimization target is ahead of the curve.

alisa0808-vox-director.title_zh: 给一个主题，出一支 Vox 式纸拼贴解说视频
alisa0808-vox-director.tagline_zh: 一个主题进去，一支 Vox 风纸拼贴解说视频出来：脚本、拼贴关键帧、配音、剪辑全自动跑完。
alisa0808-vox-director.tagline_en: One topic in, a finished Vox-style paper-collage explainer out — script, collage keyframes, voiceover and edit, all automatic.
alisa0808-vox-director.why_zh: Vox 的拼贴美学是解说视频的天花板之一，这件把整个片场压进了一条命令。
alisa0808-vox-director.why_en: Vox's collage aesthetic is explainer royalty; this compresses the whole studio into a command.
alisa0808-vox-director.limit_zh: 整条链只跑 Atlas Cloud 一家，没有 ATLASCLOUD_API_KEY 就只剩一份提示词清单让你自己去粘。本机还要 ffmpeg 和 Pillow。真人和品牌 Omni 会拒，得改用 Kling。
alisa0808-vox-director.limit_en: Every media call goes to Atlas Cloud; without ATLASCLOUD_API_KEY you get only a manual prompt pack to paste elsewhere. Needs local ffmpeg and Pillow. Omni and Seedance refuse real people and brand logos, so those runs must switch to Kling.
alisa0808-vox-director.title_en: Explainer videos in Vox's paper-collage style

juneyaooo-gpt-image2-ppt-skills.title_zh: 让 gpt-image-2 照着别人的 pptx 仿版式，你只换内容
juneyaooo-gpt-image2-ppt-skills.tagline_zh: 把任何 .pptx 模板「抄」成你的 PPT：gpt-image-2 模仿版式、你换内容，另附 10 套现成风格。
juneyaooo-gpt-image2-ppt-skills.tagline_en: Clone any .pptx template into your own deck — gpt-image-2 mimics the layout, you swap the content; 10 styles bundled.
juneyaooo-gpt-image2-ppt-skills.why_zh: 「就要做成那套模板的样子」是真实高频需求，仿版式这个切入点极其聪明。
juneyaooo-gpt-image2-ppt-skills.why_en: "Make it look like that deck" is a real, frequent ask — layout mimicry is the clever cut-in.
juneyaooo-gpt-image2-ppt-skills.limit_zh: gpt-image-2 按张计费，不含在 ChatGPT 订阅里。仿模板要本机跑得起 LibreOffice/Keynote/PowerPoint 渲染，否则得自己把每页导成 PNG。默认成品整页是图，文字改不了。
juneyaooo-gpt-image2-ppt-skills.limit_en: gpt-image-2 bills per image and a ChatGPT subscription does not cover it. Template cloning needs a working local LibreOffice/Keynote/PowerPoint renderer, or you export each page to PNG yourself. Default decks are full-page images.
juneyaooo-gpt-image2-ppt-skills.title_en: Steal that deck's layout, keep your content

dominikmartn-hue.title_zh: 学一次你的品牌，之后 agent 做的每个界面都照着来
dominikmartn-hue.tagline_zh: 学习任何品牌并输出完整设计系统：装一次，之后 agent 做的每个界面都长在你的品牌基因上。
dominikmartn-hue.tagline_en: Learns any brand and emits a full design system — install once, and every UI your agent builds matches your identity.
dominikmartn-hue.why_zh: 「品牌一致性」从人肉盯改变成系统保证，小团队也能有大厂级的视觉纪律。
dominikmartn-hue.why_en: Brand consistency goes from manual policing to systemic guarantee — big-co discipline for small teams.
dominikmartn-hue.limit_zh: 它产的是一件新 skill，不是界面；而且生成的 description 硬写 NEVER trigger automatically，之后每次都得点名叫它。没接 Chrome DevTools MCP 就降级取色并自报低可信。
dominikmartn-hue.limit_en: It outputs a new skill, not a UI - and the generated description must contain "NEVER trigger automatically", so you invoke it by name every time. Without Chrome DevTools MCP it falls back to WebFetch and flags reduced confidence.
dominikmartn-hue.title_en: Install your brand once, every screen obeys
dominikmartn-hue._无封面原因: 全仓 0 张图片，但 examples/ 下有 18 个品牌目录，每个是 design-model.yaml + landing-page.html（部分还有 component-library.html / app-screen.html）—— 产出物是 HTML 不是图。我渲染了 halcyon 的组件库和 ridge 的落地页，挑了前者放在 hearted_covers/_optional-dominikmartn-hue.png（2880x1800）：深色页面，左侧
dominikmartn-hue.cover_note: 托管的是 GitHub 预览卡（1200×600/630），不上卡

dzcmemory-web-bazi-ziwei-skill.title_zh: 排盘交给算法库算，不让模型瞎编的八字与紫微斗数
dzcmemory-web-bazi-ziwei-skill.tagline_zh: 八字 + 紫微斗数精准排盘：算法库计算杜绝 AI 瞎排，三种分析模式，还能出水墨风 HTML 命盘海报。
dzcmemory-web-bazi-ziwei-skill.tagline_en: Bazi and Zi Wei charts computed by real algorithms (no LLM guessing), three analysis modes, plus ink-wash HTML chart posters.
dzcmemory-web-bazi-ziwei-skill.why_zh: 命理内容的死穴是排盘出错，它用算法库把这步锁死了——玩得认真，才好玩。
dzcmemory-web-bazi-ziwei-skill.why_en: Fortune content dies on wrong charts; algorithmic casting locks that down. Taking the fun seriously is the fun.
dzcmemory-web-bazi-ziwei-skill.limit_zh: 排盘走 node dist/run-chart.js，先得在 calculator/ 装依赖，日期只吃 1900–2100。不问出生地、直接用钟表时间，不做真太阳时校正。HTML 海报只对综合印证开放。
dzcmemory-web-bazi-ziwei-skill.limit_en: Charting runs node dist/run-chart.js, so calculator/ needs its deps installed, and dates outside 1900-2100 error. It never asks for birthplace and uses clock time with no true-solar-time correction. The HTML poster is combined-mode only.
dzcmemory-web-bazi-ziwei-skill.title_en: Bazi charts cast by algorithm, not by vibes
dzcmemory-web-bazi-ziwei-skill.unshelf_reason: 上游仓 451 法律原因下架（2026-09-03 进货探到）。装不上的东西不该在架上。

railly-tinte-tinte.tagline_zh: agent 原生的设计系统基建：浏览、安装、预览 tinte.dev 上的主题和设计系统，换肤像装包一样。
railly-tinte-tinte.tagline_en: Agent-native design-system infrastructure — browse, install and preview themes from tinte.dev; reskinning like a package manager.
railly-tinte-tinte.why_zh: 把「换主题」做成了包管理体验，设计系统的分发从此有了正经渠道。
railly-tinte-tinte.why_en: Theming as package management — design systems finally get a proper distribution channel.

hao0321-claude-skill-social-post-social-.title_zh: 学你的语气排好 14 天日历，再替你按下发布键
hao0321-claude-skill-social-post-social-.tagline_zh: 学你的 Facebook 语气，按 14 天内容日历自动写并发到 FB/IG/Threads/X——实测单帖 8 万触达。
hao0321-claude-skill-social-post-social-.tagline_en: Learns your Facebook voice, then writes and posts to FB, IG, Threads and X on a 14-day calendar — 80K-reach validated.
hao0321-claude-skill-social-post-social-.why_zh: 「学语气 + 排日历 + 真发布」三步闭环，是个人 IP 运营少见的全自动解。
hao0321-claude-skill-social-post-social-.why_en: Voice-learning, calendaring and actual posting in one loop — rare full automation for personal brands.
hao0321-claude-skill-social-post-social-.limit_zh: 正文是繁体。真发帖要 chrome:control-chrome 和已登录的浏览器，每篇都得你当场确认，没有 IG 图片素材它就停。成效全落本地 data/*.jsonl，换台机器归零。
hao0321-claude-skill-social-post-social-.limit_en: Traditional Chinese. Publishing needs `chrome:control-chrome` and an already-signed-in browser, with in-session confirmation per post; no IG image and it stops. Performance data lives in local data/*.jsonl, so a new machine starts empty.
hao0321-claude-skill-social-post-social-.title_en: Learns your voice, then actually hits post
hao0321-claude-skill-social-post-social-._无封面原因: 全仓 0 张图片。产出是 14 天内容日历和发布动作，要平台账号，不跑。
hao0321-claude-skill-social-post-social-.cover_note: 托管的是 GitHub 预览卡（1200×600/630），不上卡

danilo-znamerovszkij-draw-your-font-draw.title_zh: 拍一张手写字母，本地生成能装进系统的 TTF 字体
danilo-znamerovszkij-draw-your-font-draw.tagline_zh: 拍一张你的手写字母，产出真正可安装的字体（TTF/WOFF）：免费、开源、本地跑，不上传任何东西。
danilo-znamerovszkij-draw-your-font-draw.tagline_en: Photograph your handwriting, get a real installable font (TTF/WOFF) — free, open source, fully local, nothing uploaded.
danilo-znamerovszkij-draw-your-font-draw.why_zh: 「拥有自己笔迹的字体」是很多人想过没做过的浪漫，本地处理这点尤其体面。
danilo-znamerovszkij-draw-your-font-draw.why_en: A font of your own hand is a romance most people never act on; the local-only processing is the classy touch.
danilo-znamerovszkij-draw-your-font-draw.limit_zh: 只做拉丁字母：字符集就 minimal 和 spanish 两套，汉字做不了。要 Node ≥18 先跑 scripts/resolve-cli.js，CLI 只认文件路径。
danilo-znamerovszkij-draw-your-font-draw.limit_en: Latin only: the charsets are minimal and spanish (A-Z, a-z, 0-9, punctuation, accents) - no CJK. Needs Node >= 18 and scripts/resolve-cli.js first, and the CLI takes file paths only, so an image pasted into chat cannot be processed.
danilo-znamerovszkij-draw-your-font-draw.title_en: Photograph your handwriting, install it as a font

feichanggege-ecommerce-visual-copywritin.title_zh: 先判断什么带来转化，再出电商主图的分镜和文案
feichanggege-ecommerce-visual-copywritin.tagline_zh: 电商主图与详情页的视觉策划 SOP：先判断转化驱动力锁定风格，再出分镜、图内文案和生图 Prompt。
feichanggege-ecommerce-visual-copywritin.tagline_en: An e-commerce visual SOP — diagnose the conversion driver, lock the campaign style, then storyboard, on-image copy and prompts.
feichanggege-ecommerce-visual-copywritin.why_zh: 「设计小白做出五年资深的商品图」不是吹牛，SOP 把资深设计师的判断顺序写死了。
feichanggege-ecommerce-visual-copywritin.why_en: The senior-designer-in-a-box claim holds because the SOP hard-codes a senior's decision order.
feichanggege-ecommerce-visual-copywritin.limit_zh: 它只交画面描述、图内文案和生图 Prompt，图得你另找工具生成。策划案和 Storyboard 两道门必须你回话才继续。资质、检测、销量缺了就标缺失，它不补也不出法律结论。
feichanggege-ecommerce-visual-copywritin.limit_en: It delivers scene descriptions, in-image copy and image-generation prompts - you still need a separate tool to render anything. Two gates (plan, then storyboard) pause for your reply; missing certifications, test reports or sales figures are flagged, never invented, and it draws no legal conclusions.
feichanggege-ecommerce-visual-copywritin.title_en: Works out what converts before designing the image

aldefy-compose-skill-compose-expert.title_zh: 回答 Compose 问题时，每条建议都附上 androidx 源码出处
aldefy-compose-skill-compose-expert.tagline_zh: Jetpack Compose 全平台专家：给的每条建议都附 androidx 源码出处，Android/桌面/iOS/Web 都在行。
aldefy-compose-skill-compose-expert.tagline_en: A Compose Multiplatform expert whose every recommendation ships with androidx source receipts — Android, desktop, iOS, web.
aldefy-compose-skill-compose-expert.why_zh: 「带源码回执」是这件的灵魂：不是凭训练记忆答题，是翻着官方源码给你讲。
aldefy-compose-skill-compose-expert.why_en: Source receipts are the soul here — answers cited from androidx itself, not training-data vibes.
aldefy-compose-skill-compose-expert.limit_zh: 作者已改成插件分发，手动拷进 ~/.claude/skills/ 属于不再维护的装法、收不到更新，v3.0 还会加码警告。源码回执是 androidx-main / jb-main 打包那一刻的快照，上游一动就旧。
aldefy-compose-skill-compose-expert.limit_en: It now ships as a plugin — a manual copy into ~/.claude/skills/ is the unmaintained path and gets no updates, with the banner escalating in v3.0. The bundled androidx-main / jb-main source receipts are a snapshot frozen at packaging time.
aldefy-compose-skill-compose-expert.title_en: Every Compose answer comes with androidx receipts

texasbedouin-vibe-check.title_zh: 带纯新手把模糊点子变成计划，顺手教会他用 GitHub
texasbedouin-vibe-check.tagline_zh: 由 12 年产品老兵带路：把纯新手的模糊点子变成能开工的计划，边建边教 GitHub 和干净代码习惯。
texasbedouin-vibe-check.tagline_en: A 12-year PM walks a total beginner from vague idea to buildable plan, teaching GitHub basics and clean habits along the way.
texasbedouin-vibe-check.why_zh: vibe coding 时代最缺的是「有人扶一把」，这件就是那只手，姿势还很专业。
texasbedouin-vibe-check.why_en: The vibe-coding era's missing ingredient is a steady hand; this is that hand, professionally trained.
texasbedouin-vibe-check.limit_zh: 调研这步靠抓 Reddit 和 G2 评论，抓不动就退成把网址和搜索词交给你自己去粘。作图引擎要浏览器和临时文件，跑不起来退回 mermaid。正文全英文，且明说不管有经验开发者的调试、重构和 CI/CD。
texasbedouin-vibe-check.limit_en: Discovery depends on fetching Reddit and review sites; when the environment blocks that, it hands you the sites and search phrases to paste yourself. The diagram engine needs a browser and temp files or falls back to mermaid. English only.
texasbedouin-vibe-check.title_en: A veteran PM walks your first build

alirezarezvani-claudeforge-claude-md-enh.title_zh: 把随手记的 CLAUDE.md 重写成有模块结构的项目说明
alirezarezvani-claudeforge-claude-md-enh.tagline_zh: 分析、生成、增强你项目的 CLAUDE.md：按 Anthropic 最佳实践来，支持模块化架构和技术栈定制。
alirezarezvani-claudeforge-claude-md-enh.tagline_en: Analyze, generate and enhance your project's CLAUDE.md — Anthropic best practices, modular architecture, stack-aware.
alirezarezvani-claudeforge-claude-md-enh.why_zh: CLAUDE.md 写得好坏直接决定 agent 干活质量，这件把「写好它」变成了标准工序。
alirezarezvani-claudeforge-claude-md-enh.why_en: A good CLAUDE.md decides agent quality; this makes writing one a standard procedure.
alirezarezvani-claudeforge-claude-md-enh.limit_zh: frontmatter 把模型钉在 haiku，Bash 只放行 ls/find/git/wc。技术栈靠 package.json 一类文件的关键词猜，根文件被硬卡在 150 行。只服务 Claude Code。
alirezarezvani-claudeforge-claude-md-enh.limit_en: Frontmatter pins the model to haiku and allows only ls/find/git/wc through Bash. Tech-stack detection is keyword-based on package.json/go.mod and may need manual fixing; the validator hard-caps the root file at 150 lines. Claude Code only.
alirezarezvani-claudeforge-claude-md-enh.title_en: Turns your CLAUDE.md from notes into architecture

bitwize-music-studio-claude-ai-music-ski.title_zh: 给 Suno 配上歌词工作流和混音清单，从玩票做到成品
bitwize-music-studio-claude-ai-music-ski.tagline_zh: 人机协作的 Suno 音乐生产流：风格模板、歌词工作流、混音清单，把「玩 Suno」升级成「做音乐」。
bitwize-music-studio-claude-ai-music-ski.tagline_en: A human-plus-AI Suno production line — style templates, lyric workflows and mix checklists; from toying to producing.
bitwize-music-studio-claude-ai-music-ski.why_zh: Suno 玩家众多但成品率低，这套流程补的正是「从段子到作品」的那段路。
bitwize-music-studio-claude-ai-music-ski.why_en: Plenty of Suno players, few finished tracks — this pack covers exactly that gap.
bitwize-music-studio-claude-ai-music-ski.limit_zh: 歌不是它生成的：音频得你自己去 Suno 出、把 stems 拿回来，它管概念、歌词、Suno 提示词、母带和发行。52 件里 8 件是插件自用件（about/help/setup/test 等），真能用的 44 件。
bitwize-music-studio-claude-ai-music-ski.limit_en: It does not make the audio — you generate on Suno and bring the stems back; it covers concept, lyrics, Suno prompts, mastering and release prep. Of its 52 skills, 8 are plugin housekeeping (about/help/setup/test/health-check); 44 are actually usable.
bitwize-music-studio-claude-ai-music-ski.title_en: Turns Suno noodling into finished, mixed tracks
bitwize-music-studio-claude-ai-music-ski.limit_brief_zh: 歌不是它生成的，音频要你去 Suno 出。
bitwize-music-studio-claude-ai-music-ski.limit_brief_en: It does not make the audio; you generate that on Suno.
bitwize-music-studio-claude-ai-music-ski._无封面原因: 全仓唯一一张 docs/images/be-excellent-to-each-other.jpg(1400x700)，开过：《比尔和泰德历险记》的电影剧照（画面里能认出年轻的基努·里维斯和 Alex Winter 双手张开站在舞台上），底部叠白色大字 'Be Excellent To Each Other'。第三方版权画面 + 真人肖像，两条都撞线，坚决不用。这件其余产出要接 Suno（外部账号）。
bitwize-music-studio-claude-ai-music-ski.cover_note: 托管的是 GitHub 预览卡（1200×600/630），不上卡

superdesigndev-superdesign-skill-superde.tagline_zh: 在 Superdesign 画布上设计或重设计前端：页面、流程、全新产品都能来，出的是能交付的品味前端。
superdesigndev-superdesign-skill-superde.tagline_en: Design or redesign frontend on the Superdesign canvas — pages, flows or brand-new products; shippable, tasteful output.
superdesigndev-superdesign-skill-superde.why_zh: canvas 交互 + anti-slop 立场的组合拳，是「AI 设计工具」里完成度很高的一派。
superdesigndev-superdesign-skill-superde.why_en: Canvas interaction plus an anti-slop stance — one of the more finished schools of AI design tooling.

agent-sh-agnix-agnix.title_zh: 把 lint 用到 CLAUDE.md 和 hooks 上，报出的错还能自动修
agent-sh-agnix-agnix.tagline_zh: 给 AI 配置文件做 lint：校验 CLAUDE.md、AGENTS.md、SKILL.md、hooks、MCP，带自动修复和 IDE 插件。
agent-sh-agnix-agnix.tagline_en: The missing linter for AI configs — validates CLAUDE.md, AGENTS.md, SKILL.md, hooks and MCP, with autofixes and IDE plugins.
agent-sh-agnix-agnix.why_zh: 生态成熟的标志就是有了 linter；写 skill 的人都该装一个再发货。
agent-sh-agnix-agnix.why_en: An ecosystem is mature when it grows a linter; every skill author should run this before shipping.
agent-sh-agnix-agnix.limit_zh: 校验不是 skill 做的，是 Rust 写的 agnix 二进制，得先 cargo install agnix-cli 才跑得起来。它查命名、触发词、格式这类规范，不管你的 skill 装上去到底好不好使。
agent-sh-agnix-agnix.limit_en: The skill validates nothing itself — the work is done by the agnix Rust binary you must cargo install agnix-cli first. Its rules check naming, trigger phrases and file format, not whether your skill works once installed.
agent-sh-agnix-agnix.title_en: Lints the config files nobody thought to lint

irenerachel-visual-style-ppt-skill.tagline_zh: 用 Image 2 按视觉风格库逐页出图，再组装成纯图 PPTX：风格可存、可复用、可持续积累。
irenerachel-visual-style-ppt-skill.tagline_en: Style-driven slide images via Image 2, assembled into image-only PPTX — styles saved, reused and compounding over time.
irenerachel-visual-style-ppt-skill.why_zh: 「可复用的视觉风格库」是这件的巧思：审美资产第一次能像代码一样沉淀。
irenerachel-visual-style-ppt-skill.why_en: The reusable style library is the trick — aesthetic assets finally compound like code.

tizzy916-humanities-writing-companion.title_zh: 用苏格拉底式追问磨论证，最后替你写 AI 使用声明
tizzy916-humanities-writing-companion.tagline_zh: 人文学者的思考伙伴：从苏格拉底式追问研究问题到 AI 使用声明，11 种模式陪你把论证磨锋利。
tizzy916-humanities-writing-companion.tagline_en: A thinking partner for humanities scholars — 11 modes from Socratic question-sharpening to AI-use disclosure statements.
tizzy916-humanities-writing-companion.why_zh: 少见的认真服务文科的 skill：它磨的是论证而不是格式，还懂学术伦理的新规矩。
tizzy916-humanities-writing-companion.why_en: A rare skill that takes the humanities seriously — sharpening arguments, not formatting, and fluent in new AI-ethics norms.
tizzy916-humanities-writing-companion.limit_zh: 它不替你找文献、也不当文献管理器，只查你稿子里已有的引注，验真伪要连 Crossref。那几个脚本得有 shell 才能跑，纯聊天环境只能把学科档案口头记着。学科锁在文史哲、语言、艺术、宗教。
tizzy916-humanities-writing-companion.limit_en: It runs no literature search and is no reference manager — it only audits citations already in your draft, and verification calls the Crossref API. Its scripts need a shell; chat-only sessions keep profiles verbal. Humanities fields only.
tizzy916-humanities-writing-companion.title_en: Sharpens your argument, then writes the AI disclosure

arpitg1304-robotics-agent-skills.tagline_zh: 让 AI 写出生产级机器人软件的军规合集：ROS1/ROS2、设计模式、SOLID、测试，全套工程纪律。
arpitg1304-robotics-agent-skills.tagline_en: The field manual for production-grade robot software — ROS1/ROS2, design patterns, SOLID and testing discipline in one set.
arpitg1304-robotics-agent-skills.why_zh: 机器人代码出错的代价是物理的，这套纪律把「能跑」和「能上机」区分开了。
arpitg1304-robotics-agent-skills.why_en: Robot bugs cost hardware; this discipline separates "runs" from "deployable".

arpitg1304-robotics-agent-skills-robotic.tagline_zh: 机器人软件的架构模式与成熟配方：状态机、行为树、模块边界，别再用 Web 思维写机器人。
arpitg1304-robotics-agent-skills-robotic.tagline_en: Architecture patterns and proven recipes for robots — state machines, behavior trees, module boundaries; stop writing web code for hardware.
arpitg1304-robotics-agent-skills-robotic.why_zh: 机器人有自己的模式语言，这份配方集能少走很多「跑着跑着撞墙」的弯路。
arpitg1304-robotics-agent-skills-robotic.why_en: Robots have their own pattern language; these recipes prevent the drive-into-wall class of bugs.

arpitg1304-robotics-agent-skills-robotic.tagline_zh: 把软件设计基本原则落到机器人模块开发上：职责边界、接口契约、可测性要求，从第一行代码就写对。
arpitg1304-robotics-agent-skills-robotic.tagline_en: Software fundamentals applied to robot modules — responsibility boundaries, interface contracts, testability from line one.
arpitg1304-robotics-agent-skills-robotic.why_zh: 原则类内容贵在「落到具体域」，它每条都带机器人场景的正反例。
arpitg1304-robotics-agent-skills-robotic.why_en: Principles matter when domain-grounded; every rule here comes with robot-specific examples.

arpitg1304-robotics-agent-skills-ros1-de.tagline_zh: ROS1 开发的最佳实践与常见天坑：节点、包管理、通信模式，维护存量机器人系统的救命手册。
arpitg1304-robotics-agent-skills-ros1-de.tagline_en: ROS1 best practices and classic pitfalls — nodes, packages, comms patterns; the survival manual for legacy robot stacks.
arpitg1304-robotics-agent-skills-ros1-de.why_zh: 存量 ROS1 系统还要跑很多年，这份老兵经验就是它们的延寿秘籍。
arpitg1304-robotics-agent-skills-ros1-de.why_en: Legacy ROS1 will run for years yet; veteran knowledge is its life-extension kit.

k-dense-ai-mimeo.tagline_zh: 把任何领域专家「油印」成一份 SKILL.md：思维方式、判断框架、口头禅全套迁移给你的 agent。
k-dense-ai-mimeo.tagline_en: Mimeograph any expert into a SKILL.md — reasoning style, frameworks and verbal tics transplanted into your agent.
k-dense-ai-mimeo.why_zh: 「专家即技能」是个漂亮的抽象：请不动本人，就请一份他的思维方式。
k-dense-ai-mimeo.why_en: Expert-as-skill is a beautiful abstraction — can't hire the person, hire their reasoning.

k-dense-ai-mimeo-kaiming-he.title_zh: 像何恺明那样做架构，删到不能再删，靠消融实验说话
k-dense-ai-mimeo-kaiming-he.tagline_zh: 用 ResNet 之父何恺明的思维方式做深度学习设计：极简假设、消融实验优先、简洁到不能再删。
k-dense-ai-mimeo-kaiming-he.tagline_en: Deep-learning design in Kaiming He's style — minimal assumptions, ablation-first, simplicity pushed to the limit.
k-dense-ai-mimeo-kaiming-he.why_zh: 何式审美「简单到极致」影响了整个 CV 领域，做架构决策时值得请他上桌。
k-dense-ai-mimeo-kaiming-he.why_en: He's radical-simplicity aesthetic shaped modern CV; worth a seat at your architecture reviews.
k-dense-ai-mimeo-kaiming-he.limit_zh: 一份纯提示词，没有脚本：原则、框架、反模式的正文都推到 references/。覆盖面只到架构设计、初始化和生成式建模这几处决策，也明写不许以第一人称扮演他。
k-dense-ai-mimeo-kaiming-he.limit_en: A prompt and nothing else: no scripts, with principles, frameworks and anti-patterns all deferred to references/. Coverage stops at architecture design, initialization and generative formulation, and it bans first-person impersonation.
k-dense-ai-mimeo-kaiming-he.title_en: Kaiming He's rule: fewest assumptions, ablate everything

k-dense-ai-mimeo-andrej-karpathy.title_zh: 像 Karpathy 一样先去盯数据，再怀疑手上每一层抽象
k-dense-ai-mimeo-andrej-karpathy.tagline_zh: 套用 Karpathy 的心智模型思考深度学习与 agent 工程：先看数据、端到端优先、怀疑一切抽象。
k-dense-ai-mimeo-andrej-karpathy.tagline_en: Think with Karpathy's mental models — data first, end-to-end bias, and suspicion of every abstraction layer.
k-dense-ai-mimeo-andrej-karpathy.why_zh: 和守则版是互补品：那件管写码习惯，这件管「像他一样想问题」。
k-dense-ai-mimeo-andrej-karpathy.why_en: Complements the guidelines skill — that one fixes coding habits, this one installs the worldview.
k-dense-ai-mimeo-andrej-karpathy.limit_zh: 五条原则只是索引，理由和引文都在 references/ 的 principles、mental-models、frameworks 等文件里。明写不许扮演本人。全文英文，概念名要求原样引用。
k-dense-ai-mimeo-andrej-karpathy.limit_en: The five principles here are an index; the rationale and quotes live in references/principles.md, mental-models.md and frameworks.md. It states outright that it must not impersonate him. All English, concept names cited verbatim.
k-dense-ai-mimeo-andrej-karpathy.title_en: Think like Karpathy: data first, abstractions suspect

k-dense-ai-mimeo-christopher-manning.tagline_zh: 斯坦福 NLP 掌门 Manning 的推理与架构哲学：语言学直觉 + 工程务实，做 NLP 决策的第二意见。
k-dense-ai-mimeo-christopher-manning.tagline_en: Stanford NLP chief Manning's reasoning and philosophy — linguistic intuition with engineering pragmatism, a second opinion for NLP calls.
k-dense-ai-mimeo-christopher-manning.why_zh: NLP 的品味之争很多，请一位领域宗师当「第二意见」是划算的保险。
k-dense-ai-mimeo-christopher-manning.why_en: NLP is full of taste disputes; a field patriarch as second opinion is cheap insurance.

machina-sports-sports-skills.tagline_zh: 实时体育数据 + 预测市场的开源技能组：足球、F1、Kalshi、Polymarket，零 API Key 直接用。
machina-sports-sports-skills.tagline_en: Open skills for live sports data and prediction markets — football, F1, Kalshi and Polymarket, zero API keys required.
machina-sports-sports-skills.why_zh: 「零 Key 开箱即用」在体育数据领域非常难得，看盘、做预测应用都省了接口费。
machina-sports-sports-skills.why_en: Zero-key sports data is genuinely rare — dashboards and prediction apps without the API bill.

machina-sports-sports-skills-markets.tagline_zh: 把 ESPN 赛程和 Kalshi、Polymarket 预测市场接在一起：统一看盘、赔率对比、实体检索一屏搞定。
machina-sports-sports-skills-markets.tagline_en: ESPN schedules wired to Kalshi and Polymarket — unified dashboards, odds comparison and entity search on one screen.
machina-sports-sports-skills-markets.why_zh: 赛事×预测市场的交叉视角很稀缺，做行情观察和内容选题都是利器。
machina-sports-sports-skills-markets.why_en: The sports-times-prediction-market lens is scarce — sharp for both market watching and content angles.

machina-sports-sports-skills-cfb-data.tagline_zh: NCAA 美式橄榄球数据直连：比分、积分榜、名单、赛程、逐档播报，ESPN 与官方端点双源。
machina-sports-sports-skills-cfb-data.tagline_en: College football data on tap — scores, standings, rosters, schedules and play-by-play from ESPN and official NCAA endpoints.
machina-sports-sports-skills-cfb-data.why_zh: 垂直联赛数据封装到「一句话可查」，做内容和小工具的原料都齐了。
machina-sports-sports-skills-cfb-data.why_en: A vertical league packaged to one-line queries — raw material for content and tools alike.

machina-sports-sports-skills-cbb-data.tagline_zh: NCAA 大学篮球数据直连：比分、排名、球员名单、赛程与比赛摘要，疯狂三月的数据后勤全包。
machina-sports-sports-skills-cbb-data.tagline_en: College basketball data direct — scores, standings, rosters, schedules and game summaries; March Madness logistics covered.
machina-sports-sports-skills-cbb-data.why_zh: March Madness 是数据内容的黄金档，这件就是那两周的弹药库。
machina-sports-sports-skills-cbb-data.why_en: March Madness is content's gold season; this is the ammo depot for those two weeks.

tigerless-labs-design-harness-design-har.title_zh: 喂它论文和半成形想法，产出一份你能答辩的系统设计
tigerless-labs-design-harness-design-har.tagline_zh: 喂它论文和半成形想法，它连成一套你能答辩的系统设计：来源→观点→产出三层，全程 Markdown 留痕。
tigerless-labs-design-harness-design-har.tagline_en: Feed it papers and half-formed ideas; it links them into a defensible system design — sources, ideas, output, all on record.
tigerless-labs-design-harness-design-har.why_zh: 「人拍板、agent 跑腿」的分工设计得很清醒，证据链留痕让结论真能答辩。
tigerless-labs-design-harness-design-har.why_en: Human adjudicates, agent runs errands — and the evidence trail makes conclusions actually defensible.
tigerless-labs-design-harness-design-har.limit_zh: 它一条判断都不替你下：想法要你先说出口才转写成卡，output 只在你下令时才动。建图全靠 python3 脚本，两个校验器不过就一张 HTML 都不出。输出形态目前只有 system-design 一种。
tigerless-labs-design-harness-design-har.limit_en: It never adjudicates: a judgment becomes a card only after you voice it, and output changes only on your command. Canvas builds run on python3 scripts gated by two validators — a failure emits no HTML. Only one output form: system-design.
tigerless-labs-design-harness-design-har.title_en: Turns papers and half-ideas into a defensible design

yusuke710-manim-skill-manim-skill.title_zh: 用 Manim 做 3Blue1Brown 那种数学动画，从分镜到渲染
yusuke710-manim-skill-manim-skill.tagline_zh: 用 Manim 做 3Blue1Brown 风格的数学动画：agent 自己规划分镜、写代码、渲染、按反馈修，出片有辨识度。
yusuke710-manim-skill-manim-skill.tagline_en: 3Blue1Brown-style math animations via Manim — the agent plans scenes, writes code, renders and refines on feedback.
yusuke710-manim-skill-manim-skill.why_zh: 数学可视化是教学内容的王牌，它把 Manim 陡峭的学习曲线整个铲平了。
yusuke710-manim-skill-manim-skill.why_en: Math visualization is teaching's trump card; this bulldozes Manim's learning curve flat.
yusuke710-manim-skill-manim-skill.limit_zh: 本机要装 Manim CE 和 ffmpeg，分镜逐个渲染再 concat 拼。默认只出 480p15，1080p 得点名。写码前强制先调 manimce-best-practices。旁白只写进 plan.md，不生成配音。
yusuke710-manim-skill-manim-skill.limit_en: Manim CE and ffmpeg must be installed locally; scenes render one by one and are stitched with ffmpeg concat. Default output is 480p15, 1080p only on request. Phase 2 requires a separate manimce-best-practices skill. No audio.

phuryn-pm-skills-north-star-metric.tagline_zh: 定义你的北极星指标和 3-5 个输入指标，连成一棵指标树：全公司往一个数字上使劲，别再各拜各的神。
phuryn-pm-skills-north-star-metric.tagline_en: Define a North Star Metric plus 3–5 input metrics as one tree — the whole company pushes one number instead of many gods.
phuryn-pm-skills-north-star-metric.why_zh: 指标混乱是增长团队的常见死法，一棵指标树把讨论从立场拉回数学。
phuryn-pm-skills-north-star-metric.why_en: Metric sprawl kills growth teams; one tree drags debates from opinion back to arithmetic.

wondelai-skills-made-to-stick.tagline_zh: 用 SUCCESs 框架打磨信息：简单、意外、具体、可信、情感、故事——让人听一遍就记住还愿意转述。
wondelai-skills-made-to-stick.tagline_en: Craft messages with the SUCCESs framework — simple, unexpected, concrete, credible, emotional, story — heard once, retold often.
wondelai-skills-made-to-stick.why_zh: 《Made to Stick》是传播学的常青经典，六要素清单拿来逐条对稿非常顺手。
wondelai-skills-made-to-stick.why_en: An evergreen communication classic; the six-trait checklist is perfect for auditing any draft.

alibaba-open-code-review-open-code-revie.tagline_zh: 阿里开源的 AI 代码评审：ocr 一条命令审 Git 变更、PR、暂存区改动，评审意见直接落到行。
alibaba-open-code-review-open-code-revie.tagline_en: Alibaba's open AI code review — one `ocr` command reviews Git changes, PRs and staged diffs, comments landing on exact lines.
alibaba-open-code-review-open-code-revie.why_zh: 大厂把内部评审工具开源出来本身就是信号：工程化程度和规则库的厚度都不是玩具级。
alibaba-open-code-review-open-code-revie.why_en: A big company open-sourcing its internal reviewer is the signal — the engineering and rule depth aren't toy-grade.

blockrunai-clawrouter-clawrouter.title_zh: 自动把请求路由到最便宜够用的模型
blockrunai-clawrouter-clawrouter.tagline_zh: 简单活也在烧贵模型的钱。本地代理按任务难度分流，号称省 87% 推理费——注意流量要经它家网关。
blockrunai-clawrouter-clawrouter.tagline_en: A local proxy routing each request to the cheapest capable model — claims 87% savings; note traffic goes via their gateway.
blockrunai-clawrouter-clawrouter.why_zh: token 账单是真痛点，路由思路也对；「经过第三方网关」这点我们直说，你自己权衡。
blockrunai-clawrouter-clawrouter.why_en: Token bills are a real pain and routing is the right idea; we're upfront that a third-party gateway sits in the path.
blockrunai-clawrouter-clawrouter.limit_zh: 它是 OpenClaw 插件，用 npm 装，进不了 Claude Code；提示词全部发往 blockrun.ai 网关。首次运行自动生成 EVM 私钥并明文落盘，还捆着真金白银下注 Polymarket 的工具。
blockrunai-clawrouter-clawrouter.limit_en: An OpenClaw plugin installed via npm, not a Claude Code skill: every prompt is sent to the blockrun.ai gateway. It auto-generates an EVM wallet key stored in plaintext config, and bundles a tool that places real-money Polymarket bets.
blockrunai-clawrouter-clawrouter.title_en: Shops each request around for the cheapest model

kyanitelabs-kinocut-kinocut.title_zh: 有护栏的 AI 视频剪辑
kyanitelabs-kinocut-kinocut.tagline_zh: 让 AI 直接剪素材，最怕一刀把原片剪废。它先规划后执行、每步可回溯，FFmpeg 操作、字幕、音频、成片改编都管。
kyanitelabs-kinocut-kinocut.tagline_en: Guarded AI video editing — FFmpeg ops, media analysis, subtitles, audio and repurposing, every step source-backed.
kyanitelabs-kinocut-kinocut.why_zh: 「guarded」是它的灵魂：剪辑指令可追溯、可回退，敢让 agent 碰真素材。
kyanitelabs-kinocut-kinocut.why_en: The guardrails are the soul — plan-then-execute, traceable cuts, no irreversible butchery of your footage.
kyanitelabs-kinocut-kinocut.limit_zh: 本体是要装的 kinocut CLI（uvx + FFmpeg），先跑 kino doctor。只碰本地文件，上云要另开 egress 审批。360 只吃拼好的等距 MP4，.insv 直接拒。图层合成不当 NLE 用，音频合成 fail-closed。
kyanitelabs-kinocut-kinocut.limit_en: Drives an installed CLI (uvx kinocut + FFmpeg); run kino doctor first. Local files only - cloud needs a separate egress approval. 360 wants a pre-stitched equirect MP4, .insv rejected. Not an NLE: audio compositing fails closed.
kyanitelabs-kinocut-kinocut.title_en: Video editing that plans before it cuts anything

dimetron-pi-go-design-review.title_zh: 给 Go 代码库做地道性评审
dimetron-pi-go-design-review.tagline_zh: Go 里「能跑」和「地道」差得远。命名、结构、一致性、接口、错误处理逐维打分，还附可执行的修法。
dimetron-pi-go-design-review.tagline_en: Deep design review for Go codebases — naming, structure, consistency, interfaces and error handling scored, with fixes.
dimetron-pi-go-design-review.why_zh: 按维度打分让评审意见特别可落地，不是笼统说「建议重构」。
dimetron-pi-go-design-review.why_en: In Go, "works" and "idiomatic" are far apart; per-dimension scoring makes the feedback actionable.
dimetron-pi-go-design-review.limit_zh: 正文明说单个 PR 或未提交 diff 不归它管，那要另一件 code-review。而且末尾嵌着 pi-go 这个项目自己的检查项（ADK、internal/provider/、禁 init()），换仓库得先删。
dimetron-pi-go-design-review.limit_en: The text excludes single PRs and uncommitted diffs (it points you to a separate code-review skill). It also carries a hardcoded "Project-Specific Checks (pi-go)" block - ADK, internal/provider/, no init() - other repos must strip.
dimetron-pi-go-design-review.title_en: Scores your Go on idiomatic, not on working

dimetron-pi-go-bubbletea-testing.title_zh: 给跑在终端里的 Bubble Tea 界面拍快照做断言
dimetron-pi-go-bubbletea-testing.tagline_zh: 给 Bubble Tea 终端应用写测试的专门手册：teatest、模型断言、快照对比，Go TUI 圈的刚需冷门件。
dimetron-pi-go-bubbletea-testing.tagline_en: The dedicated manual for testing Bubble Tea TUIs — teatest, model assertions and snapshot diffs; niche but essential in Go.
dimetron-pi-go-bubbletea-testing.why_zh: TUI 测试资料少得可怜，这份垂直手册对写 charmbracelet 应用的人是雪中送炭。
dimetron-pi-go-bubbletea-testing.why_en: TUI testing docs are scarce; for charmbracelet builders this vertical manual is rain in a drought.
dimetron-pi-go-bubbletea-testing.limit_zh: 只对 Go 的 Bubble Tea 有用，teatest 和 golden 都在 charmbracelet/x/exp 这个实验路径下。正文 v1、v2 写法混排要自己认版本，且不含任何脚本，全是照抄的片段。
dimetron-pi-go-bubbletea-testing.limit_en: Go + Bubble Tea only. Both teatest and golden live under the experimental charmbracelet/x/exp path, v1 and v2 APIs are interleaved so you must tell them apart yourself, and it ships no scripts - only snippets to copy.
dimetron-pi-go-bubbletea-testing.title_en: Snapshot tests for terminal UIs built in Bubble Tea

vanillagreencom-vstack-trading-design.title_zh: 按专业交易软件的规范设计盯盘界面
vanillagreencom-vstack-trading-design.tagline_zh: 交易界面是设计里的特种兵：红绿语义、毫秒级信息密度、面板布局都有讲究，一般设计规范完全不管。
vanillagreencom-vstack-trading-design.tagline_en: A design system for trading software — panel layouts, data density, market color semantics and interaction rules.
vanillagreencom-vstack-trading-design.why_zh: 成体系的交易 UI 资料极其罕见，做行情类产品时这块知识很难自己攒。
vanillagreencom-vstack-trading-design.why_en: Trading UI is special-forces design — color semantics, millisecond density; systematic references are rare.
vanillagreencom-vstack-trading-design.limit_zh: 只给规则不给 token：具体颜色和像素值要你自己的设计系统补，正文没有一行组件代码。深色是设计靶心，浅色只是把层级反过来。硬到「圆角一律为零、彩色只准两个」，跟通用仪表盘规范会打架。
vanillagreencom-vstack-trading-design.limit_en: Rules only, no tokens — exact colors and pixel values stay in your own design system, and no component code ships. Dark is the target; light is a reversed adaptation. Hard rules: zero border radius everywhere, exactly two chromatic hues.
vanillagreencom-vstack-trading-design.title_en: Design rules for screens where color means money
vanillagreencom-vstack-trading-design._无封面原因: 心选的 skills/trading-design 目录里只有一个 SKILL.md（纯规则文档：密度、配色、组件规范，没有 examples/ 也没有 scripts/）。仓库里 40+ 张图我抽查开过代表性的几张：docs/img/home.png(1440x900) 是 vstack 这个 App 自己的 Home 界面（Needs attention / Recently changed 列表），pi-extensions/*/assets/*.png|gif 是各个
vanillagreencom-vstack-trading-design.cover_note: 托管的是 GitHub 预览卡（1200×600/630），不上卡

vanillagreencom-vstack-iced-rs.title_zh: 用 Rust Iced 写桌面图形界面
vanillagreencom-vstack-iced-rs.tagline_zh: Rust 桌面开发资料零散，Iced 尤其如此，Elm 架构的疑难自己啃很慢。自定义组件、overlay、Canvas、Shader、主题化它都接。
vanillagreencom-vstack-iced-rs.tagline_en: An Iced 0.14 expert for Rust GUIs — custom widgets, overlays, Canvas, shaders, theming and Elm-architecture puzzles.
vanillagreencom-vstack-iced-rs.why_zh: 垂直到 0.14 版本的老手经验，踩坑速度完全不同——这类冷门框架最需要的就是这个。
vanillagreencom-vstack-iced-rs.why_en: Rust desktop knowledge is scattered and Iced doubly so; an in-agent veteran changes your pace entirely.
vanillagreencom-vstack-iced-rs.limit_zh: 全部钉在 Iced 0.14.0 那份本地 refs 上，更新的 API 得自己转 docs.rs 或上游 master。真正的料在 references/、examples/、iced_wgpu/ 三个目录，只抄这份正文等于没装。全英文。
vanillagreencom-vstack-iced-rs.limit_en: Pinned to local Iced 0.14.0 refs; newer API means going to docs.rs or upstream master yourself. The substance lives in references/, examples/ and iced_wgpu/ — copying this page alone gets you nothing. English only.
vanillagreencom-vstack-iced-rs.title_en: Rust desktop GUIs, down to custom Iced shaders

vanillagreencom-vstack-decider.title_zh: 给架构决策建档，并记住哪条被哪条废止
vanillagreencom-vstack-decider.tagline_zh: 架构决策记录（ADR）全流程管理：模板、创建、检索、废止追踪、索引维护，让「当初为什么这么做」有档可查。
vanillagreencom-vstack-decider.tagline_en: Full ADR lifecycle management — templates, creation, search, supersession tracking and index upkeep; "why did we do this" gets an answer.
vanillagreencom-vstack-decider.why_zh: 团队最贵的失忆就是决策依据失传，ADR 是解药，这件把仪式成本降到几乎为零。
vanillagreencom-vstack-decider.why_en: The costliest amnesia is lost decision rationale; ADRs are the cure and this drops the ritual cost to nearly zero.
vanillagreencom-vstack-decider.limit_zh: vstack 工具链里的一件：脚本路径写死 .agents/skills/decider/scripts/decisions，出问题让你跑 vstack report。没有带 INDEX.md 的决策目录，next-id 和 get 直接不工作。
vanillagreencom-vstack-decider.limit_en: One piece of the vstack toolchain: the script path is hardcoded to .agents/skills/decider/scripts/decisions, config comes from vstack.settings.toml, bugs go via `vstack report`. Without a decisions dir with INDEX.md, next-id and get fail.
vanillagreencom-vstack-decider.title_en: Decision records that remember what superseded what

nowork-studio-notfair.title_zh: 给定目标后 24 小时连轴跑的营销 agent 组
nowork-studio-notfair.tagline_zh: 营销素材一次性生成完就断了，没人盯效果。它是目标驱动的循环体：给定业务目标后持续跑、持续调，起名就叫 NotFair。
nowork-studio-notfair.tagline_en: Goal-driven, loop-powered marketing agents grinding your targets 24/7 — it's called NotFair for a reason.
nowork-studio-notfair.why_zh: 「循环 + 明确目标」是营销 agent 的正确形态，比一次性出物料高一档。
nowork-studio-notfair.why_en: Loops plus explicit goals is the right shape for marketing agents — a tier above one-shot asset generation.
nowork-studio-notfair.limit_zh: README 自己标 45 件，仓库 90 份 SKILL.md 只对应 52 个名字——skills/ 那 45 件之外是同名副本。真跑起来要接上 GA4、Search Console 和 Google/Meta/X/LinkedIn 广告账号权限。
nowork-studio-notfair.limit_en: The README says 45 skills; the repo has 90 SKILL.md files covering only 52 distinct names — beyond the 45 under skills/, the rest are same-name copies. Using it for real means connecting GA4, Search Console and Google/Meta/X/LinkedIn ad accounts.
nowork-studio-notfair.title_en: Marketing agents that keep grinding while you sleep

costiash-claude-code-docs-docs.tagline_zh: 本地镜像的 Claude 全套文档随叫随查：白话提问、生成交互式课程和变更报告、检查新鲜度，一个 /docs 入口全包。
costiash-claude-code-docs-docs.tagline_en: A local mirror of all Claude docs behind one /docs router — plain-English Q&A, interactive courses, changelog reports, freshness checks.
costiash-claude-code-docs-docs.why_zh: 官方文档更新快、翻起来碎，本地镜像+路由入口把「查文档」变成一句话；一张卡顶它全家五件。
costiash-claude-code-docs-docs.why_en: Official docs move fast and fragment; a local mirror behind one router turns lookup into a sentence. One card covers the whole set.
costiash-claude-code-docs-docs.limit_zh: 正文写明 disable-model-invocation，你不打 /docs 它一动不动；查询、课程、变更报告全转给 claude-docs 等四件同插件 skill。文档正文不在本地，要联网从 Anthropic 拉进 cache/。
costiash-claude-code-docs-docs.limit_en: Frontmatter sets disable-model-invocation: nothing runs unless you type /docs. Lookup, courses and changelogs are all dispatched to four sibling plugin skills, and page bodies are fetched online into ~/.claude-code-docs/cache/.
costiash-claude-code-docs-docs.title_en: Every Claude doc mirrored locally, with freshness checks

bingo-taiwan-taiwan-student-benefits.title_zh: 用 .edu.tw 邮箱领免费订阅，到期前喊你去续
bingo-taiwan-taiwan-student-benefits.tagline_zh: 追踪并提醒台湾 .edu.tw 学生专属福利：50+ 免费订阅和额度（正版软件、云服务、AI 工具），到期前喊你续。
bingo-taiwan-taiwan-student-benefits.tagline_en: Tracks 50+ free subscriptions and credits for Taiwan .edu.tw students — software, cloud and AI perks, with expiry reminders.
bingo-taiwan-taiwan-student-benefits.why_zh: 垂直到一个群体但需求真实：学生邮箱能薅的羊毛比想象多，有人替你盯到期日更是贴心。
bingo-taiwan-taiwan-student-benefits.why_en: Hyper-vertical but genuinely needed — .edu perks run deeper than people think, and expiry-watching is the thoughtful part.
bingo-taiwan-taiwan-student-benefits.limit_zh: 名单是仓库里那份 references/benefits-catalog.md 写死的，额度和期限不会自己更新。提醒要你自己去配 Task Scheduler / launchd / crontab，脚本输出还被规定只能用英文。
bingo-taiwan-taiwan-student-benefits.limit_en: The catalogue is a static references/benefits-catalog.md in the repo, so amounts and expiry dates change only when the repo does. Reminders need you to set up Task Scheduler, launchd or cron yourself, and script output must be English.
bingo-taiwan-taiwan-student-benefits.title_en: Free student software for .edu.tw, with expiry reminders

arbiterforge-codearbiter.tagline_zh: 「信不过自己就信仲裁」：一组守门 agent 对你的代码库做多方会审，改动过堂之后才准落地。
arbiterforge-codearbiter.tagline_en: "Can't trust yourself with the codebase? Trust the Arbiter" — gatekeeper agents that tribunal every change before it lands.
arbiterforge-codearbiter.why_zh: vibe coding 时代的自我防护装置：把「冲动提交」和「主分支」之间加了一道庭审。
arbiterforge-codearbiter.why_en: Self-defense for the vibe-coding era — a courtroom between your impulse and the main branch.
arbiterforge-codearbiter.limit_zh: 许可证是 AGPL v3 不是 MIT，接进闭源产品前先过法务。167 份 SKILL.md 只对应 62 个名字：core/surface 那 23 件是本体，ca、ca-codex、ca-pi 是同源生成的副本。全局装，仓库不 opt-in 它就一直睡着。
arbiterforge-codearbiter.limit_en: AGPL v3, not MIT — clear it with legal before it touches closed source. 167 SKILL.md files map to only 62 names: the 23 under core/surface are the real set; ca / ca-codex / ca-pi are generated copies. Installs globally, dormant until a repo opts in.
arbiterforge-codearbiter.title_en: Puts every change on trial before it lands

artokun-comfyui-mcp.title_zh: 自然语言改工作流，178 个工具随叫随到
artokun-comfyui-mcp.tagline_zh: ComfyUI 的连线劝退过无数人。装上它用说话就能生成图/视频/音频、搭工作流、改你正在跑的节点图，全程本地不上传素材。
artokun-comfyui-mcp.tagline_en: A local-first control plane for ComfyUI — an MCP server plus sidebar agent that generates media, authors and runs workflows, and edits your live graph in plain language.
artokun-comfyui-mcp.why_zh: 把「拖节点」变成「说人话」，而且本地跑——碰私密素材时这点关键。
artokun-comfyui-mcp.why_en: ComfyUI's node-wiring scares people off; this turns dragging nodes into plain talk, fully local, nothing uploaded.
artokun-comfyui-mcp.limit_zh: 本体是 npm 上的 MCP server，39 件 skill 给它当外围。前提是有一台跑着 ComfyUI 的机器——没有 ComfyUI，这一整包一件都用不上。另外推荐管线里含一个 abliterated（去掉了拒答方向）的文本编码器 LoRA，作者标它是修脸用的；模型表另有一行 abliterated 出图模型标着 uncensored，可换成同表的普通写实模型。
artokun-comfyui-mcp.limit_en: The product is an npm MCP server (node ≥22); the 39 skills under plugin/skills are its periphery. You need a running ComfyUI — local, LAN, VPS or Comfy Cloud. Without one, none of it does anything.
artokun-comfyui-mcp.title_en: Drive ComfyUI workflows by plain language, 178 tools ready

jasoncolapietro-suede-creator-skills.tagline_zh: 面向内容创作者的 71 件 skill 大合集：Full Send 编排、A–F 代码评审、AI 评测、CI 关卡、设计文案、SEO/AEO/GEO、Instagram 增长与上架，一条龙。
jasoncolapietro-suede-creator-skills.tagline_en: 71 skills for creators — Full Send orchestration, A–F code review, AI evals, CI gates, design, copy, SEO/AEO/GEO and Instagram growth, end to end.
jasoncolapietro-suede-creator-skills.why_zh: 少见地把「创作」和「工程交付」缝在一个包里，独立创作者想一站配齐可以从这翻起。
jasoncolapietro-suede-creator-skills.why_en: Rare in stitching creation and engineering delivery into one pack — a one-stop shelf for solo creators.

dongbeixiaohuo-writing-agent.title_zh: 从选题到发布的去 AI 味中文写作系统
dongbeixiaohuo-writing-agent.tagline_zh: AI 写的文章一眼假，改起来比自己写还累。它强制注入人类观点和细节，配读者测试评估和自动图文排版，全流程走完。
dongbeixiaohuo-writing-agent.tagline_en: A full-stack Chinese writing system on Claude Code that strips AI-flavor — forces human viewpoint and detail, with reader-test evals and auto layout, from topic to publish.
dongbeixiaohuo-writing-agent.why_zh: 国产模型友好（DeepSeek/GLM/MiniMax），把「防 AI 味」从口号做成了强制规则——中文写作全家桶里立意很高的一套。
dongbeixiaohuo-writing-agent.why_en: Friendly to domestic models and turning de-AI-flavor from slogan into enforced rules — a high-ambition Chinese writing suite.
dongbeixiaohuo-writing-agent.limit_zh: 9 份 SKILL.md 其实是同样三件放在 .claude、claude-runtime、plugins 三个目录里，真货只有三件。作者实测过的模型只列了 DeepSeek-V3.2、GLM、MiniMax，桌面版只出了 Windows 预览。
dongbeixiaohuo-writing-agent.limit_en: The 9 SKILL.md files are the same three skills mirrored across .claude, claude-runtime and plugins — three, not nine. Only DeepSeek-V3.2, GLM and MiniMax are listed as tested; the desktop app is Windows-preview only.
dongbeixiaohuo-writing-agent.title_en: Chinese writing system that reader-tests its own drafts
dongbeixiaohuo-writing-agent._无封面原因: 4 张图逐张开过，其实是同一张 256x256 反复命名（writing-agent-app/src-tauri/icons/ 下的 128x128.png、128x128@2x.png、32x32.png、icon.png 文件头全是 256x256）：深绿底、米黄圆形里一个 'W' 的 App 图标。demo/ 目录里是整套 md 稿件流程文件（01_theme.md、draft_v1_humanized.md、pre_publish_review.md…），没有图。
dongbeixiaohuo-writing-agent.cover_note: 托管的是 GitHub 预览卡（1200×600/630），不上卡

dongbeixiaohuo-writing-agent-workflow-pr.title_zh: 调度长文写作的总入口
dongbeixiaohuo-writing-agent-workflow-pr.tagline_zh: 写长文最容易写一半跑偏。说「写一篇」或「从选题开始」它就接管规划、写作、评审、交付全程；简单润色翻译不触发。
dongbeixiaohuo-writing-agent-workflow-pr.tagline_en: The master entry for multi-stage Chinese longform — "write me one / start from a topic" triggers planning, writing, review and delivery; simple edits don't.
dongbeixiaohuo-writing-agent-workflow-pr.why_zh: 触发边界划得清楚，不抢简单任务——这是同类总入口件最常犯的毛病。
dongbeixiaohuo-writing-agent-workflow-pr.why_en: The system's hub — longform as a hand-off pipeline, with trigger boundaries drawn cleanly so it won't grab trivial tasks.
dongbeixiaohuo-writing-agent-workflow-pr.limit_zh: 这份正文只是入口：阶段顺序和文件名以 .claude/workflows/collab_v2.json 为准，20 个子代理、verify_required_files.py 都不在里面。只做中文长文，全程十几处必须停机等你回话。
dongbeixiaohuo-writing-agent-workflow-pr.limit_en: This file is only the entry point: stage order and filenames come from .claude/workflows/collab_v2.json, and the 20 sub-agents plus verify_required_files.py live elsewhere. Chinese long-form only, with a dozen mandatory stops.
dongbeixiaohuo-writing-agent-workflow-pr.title_en: The longform pipeline that declines small edits

rampstackco-claude-skills.tagline_zh: 技术栈无关的建站合集：品牌、设计、内容、SEO、开发、运维、增长、调研，覆盖一个网站从搭建到优化的全生命周期。
rampstackco-claude-skills.tagline_en: Stack-agnostic website skills spanning brand, design, content, SEO, dev, ops, growth and research — a site's whole lifecycle in one pack.
rampstackco-claude-skills.why_zh: 「建站」被拆成八个阶段各配 skill，从零做站或接手优化都能按图索骥，胜在覆盖完整。
rampstackco-claude-skills.why_en: Splits site-building into eight staged skills — build from zero or take over and optimize; its strength is completeness.

cecilapp-cecil-cecil.tagline_zh: 用小众静态站生成器最缺一手指引：内容怎么组织、模板怎么写、站点怎么生成。这件是框架作者自己出的。
cecilapp-cecil-cecil.tagline_en: The official helper for Cecil static sites — focused guidance on content, templates and site generation; a field manual for building with Cecil.
cecilapp-cecil-cecil.why_zh: 官方出品，权威性拉满——小众框架的资料别处基本查不到。
cecilapp-cecil-cecil.why_en: Shipped by the framework's own authors — maximal authority, and exactly the first-hand guidance a niche SSG lacks.
cecilapp-cecil-cecil.limit_zh: 先得本机有 PHP，再 curl 下 cecil.phar 才动得了。它不处理版本差异——正文明写「不确定某功能在你那版有没有就直说」，把你打发回 cecil.app 文档。
cecilapp-cecil-cecil.limit_en: You need PHP locally plus a curl-downloaded cecil.phar before anything runs. It refuses to reason about versions: the text tells the agent to say so and point you to cecil.app documentation rather than guess which release has a feature.
cecilapp-cecil-cecil.title_en: The Cecil static-site manual, from Cecil's own authors

hugohe3-ppt-master-ppt-master.title_zh: 出可编辑的 PPTX，也能把做好的稿子重排和加旁白
hugohe3-ppt-master-ppt-master.tagline_zh: 按路由分工：新建、按页面视觉重建、灌进原生 PPTX 模板、美化已有文件，还能给成稿加旁白和动画出成自播视频。
hugohe3-ppt-master-ppt-master.tagline_en: Routed workflow: author new decks, reconstruct page visuals, fill native PPTX templates, enhance finished files, or add narration and animation for a self-running video.
hugohe3-ppt-master-ppt-master.why_zh: 它交的是可编辑的 PPTX 而不是图片拼出来的假幻灯片，模板走原生填充，改起来还是 PPT。
hugohe3-ppt-master-ppt-master.why_en: It hands back a real editable PPTX rather than images posing as slides; templates are filled natively so the deck stays a deck.
hugohe3-ppt-master-ppt-master.limit_zh: 随件的网页转 Markdown 工具可选装 curl_cffi，作者写明那是用来绕开按 TLS 指纹拦 Python 的站点（例如微信公众号）；不装它会回退到 requests。正文按路由分层加载，很吃上下文。
hugohe3-ppt-master-ppt-master.limit_en: Its web-to-markdown helper optionally installs curl_cffi, which the author documents as TLS-fingerprint impersonation for sites that block Python (e.g. WeChat); without it, it falls back to requests.
hugohe3-ppt-master-ppt-master.cover_note: 原封面 gcdn.moonshot.cn/growth-cdn/sponsor/kimi-en.png 是 Kimi（月之暗面）的赞助商广告，托在第三方 CDN 上，却被标成 cover_kind=artwork + cover_real=true——详情页图注会写「这就是它做出来的东西」。covers.json 里此件无任何备选图，故置空走无图卡，不换图也不改 kind。2026-08-19 人工更正。
hugohe3-ppt-master-ppt-master.title_en: Editable PPTX out, and it can rebuild or narrate an existing deck
hugohe3-ppt-master-ppt-master.unshelf_reason: 先发后审：上架后补扫命中红线 —— 命中 1 处 · skills/ppt-master/scripts/docs/conversion.md: 绕反爬 第5行

vishalsachdev-canvas-mcp-canvas-course-b.tagline_zh: 从规格、模板或现有课程批量搭建 Canvas LMS 课程结构：模块、页面、作业、讨论区一次性生成，教师开学前的救命工具。
vishalsachdev-canvas-mcp-canvas-course-b.tagline_en: Scaffolds full Canvas LMS course structures from specs, templates or existing courses — modules, pages, assignments and discussions in bulk.
vishalsachdev-canvas-mcp-canvas-course-b.why_zh: 教育垂直里的真刚需：Canvas 手工搭课极其耗时，批量脚手架把开学前那周从加班变成一下午。
vishalsachdev-canvas-mcp-canvas-course-b.why_en: A genuine need in edtech — hand-building Canvas courses is brutal; bulk scaffolding turns the pre-term week into an afternoon.

vishalsachdev-canvas-mcp-canvas-bulk-gra.tagline_zh: 用评分量规批改 Canvas LMS 作业：单份、批量、代码执行三种策略，先跑 dry-run 再落库，安全优先不误伤成绩。
vishalsachdev-canvas-mcp-canvas-bulk-gra.tagline_en: Rubric-based grading for Canvas LMS — single, batch and code-execution strategies, with safety-first dry runs before anything is written.
vishalsachdev-canvas-mcp-canvas-bulk-gra.why_zh: 「先 dry-run 再落库」这个安全设计对碰学生成绩的工具至关重要，敢放心批量用。
vishalsachdev-canvas-mcp-canvas-bulk-gra.why_en: The dry-run-before-write safety design is exactly what a tool touching real grades needs — batch with confidence.

axoviq-ai-synthadoc.tagline_zh: 开源的 LLM 知识编译引擎：把散乱的原始文档（Markdown、图片、Word）编译成结构化、本地优先、人可读的 Wiki，透明可查。
axoviq-ai-synthadoc.tagline_en: An open LLM knowledge-compilation engine — turns raw docs (Markdown, images, Word) into structured, local-first, human-readable wikis.
axoviq-ai-synthadoc.why_zh: 「本地优先 + 人可读 + 透明」的定位很对：它是黑箱知识库的反面，团队资料沉淀不必交给云端。
axoviq-ai-synthadoc.why_en: Local-first, human-readable and transparent — the anti-black-box knowledge base; your team's docs needn't live in someone's cloud.

xixihhhh-hotclip-hotclip.title_zh: 长视频不出本机，剪成带卡拉OK字幕的竖屏爆点
xixihhhh-hotclip-hotclip.tagline_zh: 切片工具满地都是，但敢把未发布的素材传上去吗？它端侧转写、LLM 找高光、9:16 重构、卡拉OK字幕，每条还打病毒潜力分，全程不出你的机器。
xixihhhh-hotclip-hotclip.tagline_en: Cuts long videos and livestream VODs into viral vertical shorts 100% locally — on-device transcription, LLM highlight detection, 9:16 reframe, karaoke captions, per-clip virality scores.
xixihhhh-hotclip-hotclip.why_zh: 「100% 本地」是它最狠的点：碰未公开素材时，这一条比精度更值钱。
xixihhhh-hotclip-hotclip.why_en: Fully local, nothing uploaded — clip tools are everywhere, but few will touch your unreleased footage without phoning home.
xixihhhh-hotclip-hotclip.limit_zh: 装 skill 还不够：得先 git clone 仓库再 pnpm install，首次跑自动下约 1GB 的 ASR 模型。高光检测要一个 OpenAI 兼容端点，接云端时转写文本会出机器（媒体文件不会），本地则要自己起 Ollama。
xixihhhh-hotclip-hotclip.limit_en: Installing the skill is not enough: git clone the repo and pnpm install, and the first run pulls a ~1GB ASR model. Highlight detection needs an OpenAI-compatible endpoint — with a cloud one the transcript text does leave the machine.
xixihhhh-hotclip-hotclip.title_en: Local long-video to vertical shorts with karaoke captions

staruhub-claudeskills-deck-studio.tagline_zh: PPT 生产 agent：理解场景→推荐风格→先出大纲→逐页定义→双通路交付（内容稿/逐页视觉图/信息图），路演培训提案一把出。
staruhub-claudeskills-deck-studio.tagline_en: A deck-production agent — understands the scene, recommends a style, drafts an outline, defines pages, then delivers on two tracks: content decks and per-page visuals or infographics.
staruhub-claudeskills-deck-studio.why_zh: 「先大纲后成图」的两段式让你有干预点，还能顺手出小红书图文，中文演示场景覆盖得很全。
staruhub-claudeskills-deck-studio.why_en: The outline-then-render split gives you a checkpoint, and it doubles into Xiaohongshu carousels — broad coverage for Chinese presentation needs.

staruhub-claudeskills-university-exam-pr.title_zh: 对着真实课本和考纲突击复习
