staruhub-claudeskills-university-exam-pr.tagline_zh: 考的是老师的 PPT 和课本，AI 却按通用知识给你讲。它强制你先传真材料，再用苏格拉底式提问带你想，不灌答案。
staruhub-claudeskills-university-exam-pr.tagline_en: Built for textbook-and-slides exams — it makes you upload the actual materials first, then Socratically questions you toward understanding instead of spoon-feeding.
staruhub-claudeskills-university-exam-pr.why_zh: 「没材料就不辅导」这条硬约束很诚实：逼你对着真考纲学，而不是听 AI 编一套。
staruhub-claudeskills-university-exam-pr.why_en: The no-materials-no-tutoring rule is honest — it forces study against the real syllabus, not a generic AI-invented one.
staruhub-claudeskills-university-exam-pr.limit_zh: 没传课本/PPT/考纲它就只要材料，不开讲。PDF、Word 得另借 docx/pdf skill 提取。正文全中文，射程锁在大学期中期末，脚本只有 analyze_material.py 和 generate_questions.py。
staruhub-claudeskills-university-exam-pr.limit_en: With no textbook, slides or syllabus uploaded it only asks for material and refuses to tutor. PDFs and Word files need a separate docx/pdf skill to extract. The body is all Chinese and scoped strictly to university midterms and finals.
staruhub-claudeskills-university-exam-pr.title_en: Refuses to tutor you without the actual syllabus

adrianpunk-punk-skill-punk-cover.title_zh: 同一套朋克视觉库，文章、小红书、公众号封面一次生成
adrianpunk-punk-skill-punk-cover.tagline_zh: 每篇文章都要封面，找图配字最耗时。11 种精调风格（商业杂志头版、复古手撕拼贴、巨型透视中文标题…），每种都标了适合什么内容。
adrianpunk-punk-skill-punk-cover.tagline_en: Turn any article, note or tweet into a cover image in one line — 11 finely tuned styles (magazine front page, torn-paper collage, giant Chinese title…) for Xiaohongshu, WeChat and X.
adrianpunk-punk-skill-punk-cover.why_zh: 风格库真下过功夫：选风格像点菜一样准，出的封面有编辑部气质而不是 AI 糊图。
adrianpunk-punk-skill-punk-cover.why_en: The style library is genuinely crafted — each one tagged with what content it fits, so picking feels like ordering off a menu; covers land with editorial polish, not AI mush.
adrianpunk-punk-skill-punk-cover.limit_zh: 没告诉它平台和风格，它就停在提问那一步，不会先出一版给你看。预置比例只有小红书 3:4、公众号 2.35:1、X 5:2；一次一张、不给多版对比，也不许两种风格混用。
adrianpunk-punk-skill-punk-cover.limit_en: Without a platform and a style it stops at the question and won't draft anything first. Preset ratios cover only Xiaohongshu 3:4, WeChat 2.35:1 and X 5:2. One image per run — no side-by-side options, and mixing two styles is forbidden.
adrianpunk-punk-skill-punk-cover.title_en: One punk style library, covers for articles, XHS, WeChat, X

adrianpunk-punk-skill-punk-avatar.title_zh: 用照片生成头像和宠物纪念卡
adrianpunk-punk-skill-punk-avatar.tagline_zh: 想换个有意思的头像，或给毛孩子留点什么。人、宠物、物品照片一键变像素风、怪诞手绘、凌乱蜡笔肖像，还能出一张拍立得纪念卡。
adrianpunk-punk-skill-punk-avatar.tagline_en: Any photo of a person, pet or object becomes an avatar — pixel art, grotesque soul sketch, messy-crayon pet portrait, plus a Polaroid keepsake card for your furry friend.
adrianpunk-punk-skill-punk-avatar.why_zh: 宠物拍立得这个点子戳心：不只是换头像，是给养宠人一件想收藏、想晒的小物。
adrianpunk-punk-skill-punk-avatar.why_en: The pet Polaroid keepsake is the heart-tug — not just a new avatar, but a keepable, shareable memento for pet owners.
adrianpunk-punk-skill-punk-avatar.limit_zh: 拍立得纪念卡和凌乱蜡笔肖像作者只许用于宠物，人像走不了；时尚速写反过来只给人。风格文件放在仓库上一级的 styles/ 目录，单拷这一件会断链。一次只出一张。
adrianpunk-punk-skill-punk-avatar.limit_en: Polaroid keepsakes and messy-crayon portraits are pet-only by rule; the fashion sketch is people-only. Style atoms live in a repo-level ../../styles/ folder, so copying this skill alone breaks the links. One image per run.
adrianpunk-punk-skill-punk-avatar.title_en: Avatars, and a Polaroid keepsake for the dog

adrianpunk-punk-ip-illustrations.title_zh: 角色定妆照先于文章，插图全按它来演
adrianpunk-punk-ip-illustrations.tagline_zh: 先锁定角色，再出插图，不许中途换脸
adrianpunk-punk-ip-illustrations.tagline_en: Upload one photo to mint your own IP character (with a four-view sheet), then send that character into every article you write — retro flat-3D vignette style, image count auto-scaled to article length.
adrianpunk-punk-ip-illustrations.why_zh: 从照片做出能反复用的角色，再进插图工作流。脸漂了就重来。
adrianpunk-punk-ip-illustrations.why_en: Nails a real creator pain — not another article-illustrator, but a way to establish your own visual persona first, then reuse it across every piece. One consistent "you" running through all your content is a recognition moat. Photos stay local; no sensitive-attribute inference.
adrianpunk-punk-ip-illustrations.limit_zh: 不是一次性贴纸。要每张换人，卸掉。
adrianpunk-punk-ip-illustrations.limit_en: The character stays locked until you explicitly confirm it — drafts can't be activated, and handing it an article won't skip that gate. With no image tool on the host it returns prompts instead of pictures. Character packs stay local only.
adrianpunk-punk-ip-illustrations.title_en: Lock the character look first, then illustrate every.

aidevgtm-gtm-cofounder.title_zh: 给独自做产品的技术创始人当 GTM 合伙人
aidevgtm-gtm-cofounder.tagline_zh: 技术能做出来，卖不出去。定位、找首批用户、发布、定价——它先访谈你一次，之后所有建议都基于你的真实业务。
aidevgtm-gtm-cofounder.tagline_en: The GTM co-founder you don't have — for solo technical AI/dev-tool founders: positioning, first users, launch and pricing, open-source and forged from real deals.
aidevgtm-gtm-cofounder.why_zh: 「先访谈再建议」这个设计诚实：不套教科书，而是长在你的业务上。
aidevgtm-gtm-cofounder.why_en: Technical founders lack GTM instinct most; this turns that gap into an executable process. The "interview you once, then ground every later suggestion in your real business" design is refreshingly honest, not textbook.
aidevgtm-gtm-cofounder.limit_zh: 18 件是编号 00–17 的一条链，单拎一件出来等于只拿到半张地图。全套英文，连 founder-brief、gtm-roadmap 两个模板也是。作者把适用面钉在开发者工具和 AI 产品，消费品和本地生意套不进去。
aidevgtm-gtm-cofounder.limit_en: The 18 skills are a numbered chain (00-start-here → 17-review-the-work); pulling one out gets you half a map. All English, templates included. Scoped to dev-tool and AI-product founders.
aidevgtm-gtm-cofounder.title_en: Interviews you once, then stops giving generic advice
aidevgtm-gtm-cofounder._无封面原因: 全仓唯一一张 favicon.png(1442x1718，这个尺寸叫 favicon 挺怪)，开过：黑色圆角方块里一个亮绿色的 '>_' 终端提示符，是 logo。产出是 GTM 策略文档（内容）。
aidevgtm-gtm-cofounder.cover_note: 托管的是 GitHub 预览卡（1200×600/630），不上卡

aidevgtm-gtm-cofounder-positioning-and-s.title_zh: 把产品叙事改写成开发者当英雄的故事
aidevgtm-gtm-cofounder-positioning-and-s.tagline_zh: 文案听起来像在介绍功能而不是解决痛点，转化就上不去。它重写成「开发者是英雄、某个真实趋势是反派」的结构。
aidevgtm-gtm-cofounder-positioning-and-s.tagline_en: Rewrites your product narrative into a story where the developer is the hero and a real trend is the villain — reach for it when your copy describes the product instead of the pain.
aidevgtm-gtm-cofounder-positioning-and-s.why_zh: 英雄 vs 反派这个框架把干巴巴的功能列表变成有代入感的故事——技术人最不擅长、又最影响转化的一环。
aidevgtm-gtm-cofounder-positioning-and-s.why_en: The hero-vs-villain frame turns a dry feature list into a story people enter — the piece technical folks are worst at and that most moves conversion.
aidevgtm-gtm-cofounder-positioning-and-s.limit_zh: 整份反派清单和例子都长在开发者工具语境里（构建慢、YAML 泛滥、云成本、流水线不稳），面向非开发者的产品套不上。它两次把你转去同仓库的 talk-to-users，那件不在包里。
aidevgtm-gtm-cofounder-positioning-and-s.limit_en: Every villain and example lives in dev-tool land — slow builds, YAML sprawl, cloud-cost sprawl, flaky pipelines — so it won't transfer to a non-developer audience. Twice it hands you to a sibling talk-to-users skill that isn't bundled.
aidevgtm-gtm-cofounder-positioning-and-s.title_en: Gives your product story a hero and a villain

amelnagdy-delegate-skills.tagline_zh: 把编码任务后台派给另一个 agent CLI（Antigravity / Codex / Claude），它实现、你审 diff、你自己落 commit——一个实现者一张卡。
amelnagdy-delegate-skills.tagline_en: Delegate a coding task to a background agent CLI (Antigravity / Codex / Claude) — it implements, you review the diff, you land the commit yourself; one card per implementer.
amelnagdy-delegate-skills.why_zh: 「派活但保留落地权」的分工很清醒：让便宜的 agent 干体力活，关键的审查和提交始终在你手里，多 agent 协作里少见的克制设计。
amelnagdy-delegate-skills.why_en: Delegate-but-keep-control is a clear-headed split — cheap agents do the grunt work while review and commit stay in your hands; a rare restraint in multi-agent setups.

aref-vc-tufte-claude-skill.title_zh: 按塔夫特原则画极简数据图
aref-vc-tufte-claude-skill.tagline_zh: 默认图表总是花里胡哨：网格、阴影、图例挤成一团。它砍掉一切多余装饰、拉高数据墨水比，出的图有种克制的高级感。
aref-vc-tufte-claude-skill.tagline_en: Turns "make me a chart" into a Tufte-compliant one — max data-ink, zero junk, distilled from his three foundational books.
aref-vc-tufte-claude-skill.why_zh: 数据可视化的品味天花板就是塔夫特，它把「少即是多」变成可执行规则，而不是口号。
aref-vc-tufte-claude-skill.why_en: Tufte is the ceiling of data-viz taste; this makes "less is more" executable — restrained, high-end charts instead of rainbow clutter.
aref-vc-tufte-claude-skill.limit_zh: 产物只有两条路：自包含 HTML/SVG，或 React 的 Recharts/D3；matplotlib、Excel、PPT 里的图它不管。饼图和双轴在 kill-list 上，你不明说它就不画。
aref-vc-tufte-claude-skill.limit_en: Output is limited to self-contained HTML/SVG or React (Recharts, with D3 for slopegraphs and small multiples) — no matplotlib, Excel or PowerPoint charts. Pie and dual-axis charts sit on the kill list and appear only if you override.
aref-vc-tufte-claude-skill.cover_note: 原封面 vdqi-cover.svg 是 Tufte《The Visual Display of Quantitative Information》的书封——不是产出物，且有用图权问题。撤图，走无图卡。
aref-vc-tufte-claude-skill.title_en: Tufte's three books, enforced like a linter

coleam00-excalidraw-diagram-skill.title_zh: 生成手绘白板风格的示意图
coleam00-excalidraw-diagram-skill.tagline_zh: 讲思路时精确框图显得冷，手绘草图更让人愿意看。它出真正的 Excalidraw 文件，画完你还能自己拖着改。
coleam00-excalidraw-diagram-skill.tagline_en: Generates Excalidraw hand-drawn diagram JSON for workflows, architectures and concepts — that whiteboard-sketch warmth, still editable on import.
coleam00-excalidraw-diagram-skill.why_zh: 产物是可编辑源文件而不是截图——这一点决定了它能进日常工作流，而不只是配图。
coleam00-excalidraw-diagram-skill.why_en: Hand-drawn beats rigid boxes for explaining ideas warmly; real Excalidraw files you keep editing after.
coleam00-excalidraw-diagram-skill.limit_zh: 必做的渲染校验要用 uv 装 Playwright 和 Chromium。正文禁止写脚本生成、禁止转交别的 agent，只能一段段手敲 JSON，再渲染—看图—改，通常来回 2-4 轮。 随件的渲染模板从 esm.sh 拉 excalidraw，传递依赖现在 404、脚本会等到超时；钉版本到 0.18.0 才渲得出来。
coleam00-excalidraw-diagram-skill.limit_en: The mandatory validation step renders through uv, Playwright and Chromium. The skill forbids writing a generator script or handing the job to a coding agent: you hand-write JSON section by section, then loop render-view-fix 2-4 times. Its render template pulls excalidraw from esm.sh; a transitive dependency 404s today and the script hangs until timeout. Pinning 0.18.0 fixes it.
coleam00-excalidraw-diagram-skill.title_en: Generated diagrams that look hand-drawn and stay editable
coleam00-excalidraw-diagram-skill.cover_note: 命令：`git clone --depth 1 https://github.com/coleam00/excalidraw-diagram-skill; python -m venv venv && venv/bin/pip install playwright && venv/bin/playwright install chromium; 【必须打一处补丁】r`。我造的 demo（图的内容我自己写：Agent Skill 的渐进式披露加载流程，四步 + 一段真实 frontmatter + 一条提醒）

cocoon-ai-architecture-diagram-generator.title_zh: 画暗色主题的系统架构图
cocoon-ai-architecture-diagram-generator.tagline_zh: 工程汇报要一张说得清的架构图，画起来最耗时。描述清楚系统，它出自包含的 HTML+SVG 暗色架构图，单文件到处能用。
cocoon-ai-architecture-diagram-generator.tagline_en: Renders systems, cloud infra and security topologies as polished dark-themed architecture diagrams — self-contained HTML+SVG, one file everywhere.
cocoon-ai-architecture-diagram-generator.why_zh: 暗色配色比默认白底图有质感，单文件输出省了导出和依赖的麻烦。
cocoon-ai-architecture-diagram-generator.why_en: Dark themes simply look sharper than default white, and single-file output kills export hassle — a showpiece for eng reviews.
cocoon-ai-architecture-diagram-generator.limit_zh: 说是自包含，其实要联网：字体走 Google Fonts，导出按钮靠 CDN 上的 html2canvas 和 jsPDF。只有一套暗色配色，间距坐标全靠手算，复制到剪贴板还要 https 或 localhost。
cocoon-ai-architecture-diagram-generator.limit_en: "Self-contained" still hits the network: the font loads from Google Fonts and the export buttons pull html2canvas and jsPDF from a CDN. One dark palette only, spacing is computed by hand, and clipboard copy needs https or localhost.
cocoon-ai-architecture-diagram-generator.title_en: Architecture diagrams that ship dark, in a single file

twostraws-swiftui-agent-skill-swiftui-pr.title_zh: 用 SwiftUI 权威的标准审你的 iOS 代码
twostraws-swiftui-agent-skill-swiftui-pr.tagline_zh: SwiftUI 变化快，AI 常拿过时 API 糊你。作者是 Hacking with Swift 的 Paul Hudson，全球 iOS 开发者的教科书作者——现代 API、可维护性、性能逐项过。
twostraws-swiftui-agent-skill-swiftui-pr.tagline_en: A SwiftUI code-review expert from Paul Hudson — modern APIs, maintainability and performance checked; an authority in your pocket for iOS UI.
twostraws-swiftui-agent-skill-swiftui-pr.why_zh: 权威性拉满：评审意见是真行家的话，不是训练记忆里的旧写法。
twostraws-swiftui-agent-skill-swiftui-pr.why_en: By Paul Hudson of Hacking with Swift — the iOS world's textbook author; maximal authority, real-expert review.
twostraws-swiftui-agent-skill-swiftui-pr.limit_zh: 它只读代码写意见，不编译、不跑测试、不替你改。基线写死 iOS 26 与 Swift 6.2，你要兼容旧系统它照样按最新 API 判。默认回避 UIKit，也不主动引第三方框架。
twostraws-swiftui-agent-skill-swiftui-pr.limit_en: It reads and reports only — no compiling, no tests, no edits applied. The baseline is hardwired to iOS 26 and Swift 6.2+, so older deployment targets get judged against the newest APIs. It avoids UIKit and adds no third-party frameworks.
twostraws-swiftui-agent-skill-swiftui-pr.title_en: Paul Hudson reviews your SwiftUI, line by line

sawyerhood-dev-browser-dev-browser.tagline_zh: 给你的 agent 一个能记住状态的真浏览器：导航、填表、截图、抓数据、测网页，会话之间页面状态还在，不用每次从头登录。
sawyerhood-dev-browser-dev-browser.tagline_en: Gives your agent a real browser with persistent state — navigate, fill forms, screenshot, scrape and test; pages survive between sessions.
sawyerhood-dev-browser-dev-browser.why_zh: 「状态持久」是它比一次性无头浏览器强的地方：登录一次后续都在，做需要保持会话的自动化特别顺。
sawyerhood-dev-browser-dev-browser.why_en: Persistent state is the edge over throwaway headless browsers — log in once, stay in; smooth for session-bound automation.
sawyerhood-dev-browser-dev-browser.limit_zh: 正文只有二十行：npm install -g dev-browser 再 dev-browser install，剩下全推给 --help，没写一个具体命令。--connect 接管的 Chrome 不受 --idle-timeout 管。
sawyerhood-dev-browser-dev-browser.limit_en: The skill body is about twenty lines: npm install -g dev-browser, dev-browser install, then it defers every command to `dev-browser --help`. Named browsers persist as daemons, and --idle-timeout never closes a Chrome attached via --connect.
sawyerhood-dev-browser-dev-browser.title_en: A browser for your agent that stays logged in

op7418-claude-to-im-skill.title_zh: 从手机指挥电脑里跑着的 agent
op7418-claude-to-im-skill.tagline_zh: 长任务要跑一小时，你却得出门。把会话桥到 Telegram、飞书、微信，手机上发一句就能远程派活，干完还推给你。
op7418-claude-to-im-skill.tagline_en: Bridges your live agent session to Telegram, Discord, Feishu, QQ or WeChat — command the Claude running on your computer straight from your phone.
op7418-claude-to-im-skill.why_zh: 歸藏出品，解决的是真痛点：agent 的时间和人的时间从此不用绑在一起。
op7418-claude-to-im-skill.why_en: By Guizang — solves the real pain of long tasks while you're away; command remotely from your phone, get pinged when done.
op7418-claude-to-im-skill.limit_zh: 本机得一直开着：桥是常驻 Node 进程，装完还要在 skill 目录 npm install 和 build。微信只能扫码绑一个号，没有内联授权按钮和流式预览，语音只收微信自己转的文字。飞书要两轮发版加管理员审批。
op7418-claude-to-im-skill.limit_en: Your machine must stay up: the bridge is a resident Node daemon, and its dir needs npm install plus build. WeChat is QR-login, one account only, no inline permission buttons or streaming, voice only via WeChat's own transcript.
op7418-claude-to-im-skill.title_en: Runs on your desk, takes orders from your phone
op7418-claude-to-im-skill._无封面原因: 全仓 0 张图片。要 IM 机器人 token / webhook 才能跑 → 跳过，没找也没用任何 token。
op7418-claude-to-im-skill.cover_note: 托管的是 GitHub 预览卡（1200×600/630），不上卡

deusyu-translate-book.title_zh: 整本书拆给多个分身并行翻译，再拼回原排版
deusyu-translate-book.tagline_zh: 一本书几十万字，串行翻要等到天荒地老。它用并行子 agent 分块同时翻，保留原书排版，输出 HTML/DOCX/EPUB。
deusyu-translate-book.tagline_en: Translates whole PDF/DOCX/EPUB books into any language — parallel sub-agents chunk and translate at once, layout preserved, multi-format out.
deusyu-translate-book.why_zh: 并行是关键：把几小时压到几十分钟，而且排版不散——这才让「翻整本书」从设想变成可做的事。
deusyu-translate-book.why_en: Parallel sub-agents are the trick — serial translation of a whole book takes forever; chunked parallelism cuts hours to minutes, layout intact.
deusyu-translate-book.limit_zh: 本机要有 python3 和 pandoc，DOCX/EPUB/PDF 还得装 Calibre，缺了只剩 HTML。默认放 8 个子 agent 并发，整本书的 token 你自己付；术语表只从 5 个抽样块里提。
deusyu-translate-book.limit_en: Needs python3 and pandoc locally; DOCX/EPUB/PDF conversions require Calibre, otherwise you only get HTML. Default 8 parallel sub-agents, so the whole book is billed as tokens, and the glossary is extracted from only 5 sampled chunks.
deusyu-translate-book.title_en: Translate whole books via parallel sub-agents, rebuild.

joeseesun-qiaomu-anything-to-notebooklm.title_zh: 把公众号视频播客一股脑喂进 NotebookLM
joeseesun-qiaomu-anything-to-notebooklm.tagline_zh: 想让 NotebookLM 帮你消化一堆资料，光是把内容搬进去就够烦。公众号、网页、YouTube、小宇宙、PDF 丢给它，自动整理上传，还能出播客和思维导图。
joeseesun-qiaomu-anything-to-notebooklm.tagline_en: WeChat articles, web pages, YouTube, podcasts, PDFs — dump them in, auto-processed into NotebookLM as podcasts, slides and mind maps.
joeseesun-qiaomu-anything-to-notebooklm.why_zh: 乔木出品。它吃透了中文内容源（公众号、小宇宙），这块国外工具基本不管。
joeseesun-qiaomu-anything-to-notebooklm.why_en: By Qiaomu — fully automates feeding multi-source material into NotebookLM, with real fluency in Chinese sources (WeChat, Xiaoyuzhou).
joeseesun-qiaomu-anything-to-notebooklm.limit_zh: 公众号那条要手动把 wexin-read-mcp 写进 ~/.claude/config.json 再重启；小宇宙、喜马拉雅、B站的转写另需 Get笔记 API key 和 tokens.json。还得先 notebooklm login。
joeseesun-qiaomu-anything-to-notebooklm.limit_en: The WeChat path needs wexin-read-mcp hand-registered in ~/.claude/config.json plus a restart; Xiaoyuzhou, Ximalaya and Bilibili transcripts need a separate Get-Note API key pair and tokens.json. And `notebooklm login` before anything.
joeseesun-qiaomu-anything-to-notebooklm.title_en: Feeds NotebookLM the Chinese sources it can't read

neuralinitiative-claude-dnd-skill-dnd.title_zh: 一个人也能玩的 D&D 地下城主
neuralinitiative-claude-dnd-skill-dnd.tagline_zh: 跑团最难的是凑人和一个好 DM。它管战役、角色卡、战斗轮次和 NPC，还带可选的影院式画面，一个人也能沉浸开团。
neuralinitiative-claude-dnd-skill-dnd.tagline_en: An on-call D&D 5e Dungeon Master — persistent campaigns, character sheets, combat tracking and NPCs, with an optional cinematic display. Solo-play ready.
neuralinitiative-claude-dnd-skill-dnd.why_zh: 它补上的是 DM 这个最难替代的位置，规则和状态全托管，所以单人玩不塌。
neuralinitiative-claude-dnd-skill-dnd.why_en: The hard part of tabletop is a good DM and a full table; this fills the DM seat — rules, campaign and NPCs managed for solo immersion.
neuralinitiative-claude-dnd-skill-dnd.limit_zh: 战役数据全在本机 ~/.claude/dnd，换台机器就从零开。随包只有 5e SRD 数据集，跑正式模组得你自己导入书。影院画面是本地/局域网起的 Flask 面板。默认 roll_mode 是玩家自己掷骰，它不替你的 PC 代掷。
neuralinitiative-claude-dnd-skill-dnd.limit_en: Campaign data lives locally under ~/.claude/dnd - a new machine starts empty. Only the 5e SRD dataset ships; published modules you import yourself. The cinematic display is a local/LAN Flask app. Default roll_mode never auto-rolls your PC.
neuralinitiative-claude-dnd-skill-dnd.title_en: A dungeon master for a table of one

jame581-godotprompter.title_zh: 按 Godot 引擎的范式做游戏
jame581-godotprompter.tagline_zh: 通用 agent 不懂节点树和信号，容易用写网页的思路写游戏，跑着就撞墙。这件专修 Godot 4.x 的引擎特有门道。
jame581-godotprompter.tagline_en: An agent-skills framework built for Godot 4.x — GDScript, scene trees, nodes and signals all understood; an engine guide for indie games.
jame581-godotprompter.why_zh: 垂直到具体引擎才有价值——GDScript、场景树、信号这些，通用工具一概不管。
jame581-godotprompter.why_en: Generic coding agents don't grok Godot's node/signal paradigm and write games with web habits; this specializes in the engine's own patterns.
jame581-godotprompter.limit_zh: 它建在 obra/superpowers 之上，skill 加载和工作流基础设施是上游的。范围钉死 Godot 4.3+ 的 GDScript/C#。README 自己标 55 件，另外 8 份是 scripts/fixtures 的测试夹具、2 份是仓库自用件。
jame581-godotprompter.limit_en: Built on top of obra/superpowers — the skill-loading and workflow infrastructure is upstream's. Scoped hard to Godot 4.3+ GDScript/C#. The README claims 55 skills; 8 more files are test fixtures under scripts/ and 2 are the repo's own housekeeping.
jame581-godotprompter.title_en: Stops your agent writing Godot games like web apps

wshuyi-x-article-publisher-skill-x-artic.title_zh: 把 Markdown 直接发成 X 长文
wshuyi-x-article-publisher-skill-x-artic.tagline_zh: X 的长文编辑器手动排版极其难受，复制过去格式必崩。它把 Markdown 到 X Articles 这一步自动化，写完直接发。
wshuyi-x-article-publisher-skill-x-artic.tagline_en: Publishes Markdown articles straight into X's Articles editor with formatting preserved — no manual copy-paste, no broken layout.
wshuyi-x-article-publisher-skill-x-artic.why_zh: 王树义出品。解决的是发布环节那个没人愿意干的脏活。
wshuyi-x-article-publisher-skill-x-artic.why_en: By Wang Shuyi — X's Articles editor is painful to format by hand; this automates Markdown-to-X-Articles so you just publish.
wshuyi-x-article-publisher-skill-x-artic.limit_zh: 要 Playwright MCP、一个 X Premium Plus 账号，和 Python 的 Pillow/pyobjc（Win 换 pywin32）。表格和 Mermaid 得先转 PNG，分割线只能走 Insert 菜单。只存草稿。
wshuyi-x-article-publisher-skill-x-artic.limit_en: Needs Playwright MCP, a logged-in X Premium Plus account, and Python-side Pillow/pyobjc (pywin32 on Windows). Tables and Mermaid must become PNGs first, dividers go through the Insert menu, and it only saves a draft — you publish.
wshuyi-x-article-publisher-skill-x-artic.title_en: Markdown into X's Articles editor without the reformatting

adamlyttleapps-claude-skill-aso-appstore.title_zh: 从代码反推卖点生成 App Store 截图
adamlyttleapps-claude-skill-aso-appstore.tagline_zh: 独立开发者最不擅长又最影响下载量的就是商店截图。它先读你的代码库找出核心卖点，再生成 ASO 优化的展示图。
adamlyttleapps-claude-skill-aso-appstore.tagline_en: Analyzes your app's codebase to surface core benefits, then generates ASO-optimized App Store screenshots — the download page that actually converts.
adamlyttleapps-claude-skill-aso-appstore.why_zh: 从代码反推卖点，比对着空白页想文案聪明——素材来自产品本身而不是想象。
adamlyttleapps-claude-skill-aso-appstore.why_en: Store screenshots are what indies do worst and download rates need most; deriving benefits from code beats guessing at copy.
adamlyttleapps-claude-skill-aso-appstore.limit_zh: 检测不到 Gemini MCP（npm i -g gemini-mcp）它就直接停手不生成；裁切那步调的是 macOS 专有的 sips。尺寸只给 iPhone 6.5/6.7/6.9 三种，没有 iPad，模拟器截图还得你自己拍。 compose.py 把字体写死成 /Library/Fonts/SF-Pro-Display-Black.otf，macOS 不自带、缺了直接崩没兜底；第二段还要付费模型。
adamlyttleapps-claude-skill-aso-appstore.limit_en: It refuses to generate unless the Gemini MCP server (npm i -g gemini-mcp) is present, and the crop/resize step shells out to macOS-only sips. Ships iPhone 6.5/6.7/6.9 sizes only, no iPad — and you supply the simulator screenshots yourself. compose.py hardcodes an SF Pro font path macOS does not ship; it crashes with no fallback. Stage 2 also needs a paid model.
adamlyttleapps-claude-skill-aso-appstore.title_en: Reads your source code to write App Store screenshots
adamlyttleapps-claude-skill-aso-appstore._无封面原因: 全仓唯一一张 assets/device_frame.png(1030x2800)，开过：纯黑的手机边框模板（顶部一小块白），是输入素材不是产出物，宽高比 2.72 本身也过了 2.5 的线。我照 README 真跑了 Stage 1：python3 compose.py --bg '#1F3A93' --verb TRACK --desc 'EVERY PRICE CHANGE' --screenshot <我造的手机截图> --output scaffold.png，**
adamlyttleapps-claude-skill-aso-appstore.cover_note: 托管的是 GitHub 预览卡（1200×600/630），不上卡

cosmoblk-email-marketing-bible.tagline_zh: 邮件营销细节定成败：发送时机、主题行、自动化触发。5.5 万字、908 个信源、19 个行业剧本，装上它 agent 就是个顾问。
cosmoblk-email-marketing-bible.tagline_en: A 55K-word, 908-source, 19-playbook email-marketing skill — install it and your agent becomes an email consultant, from automation to diagnostics.
cosmoblk-email-marketing-bible.why_zh: 内容密度惊人且有信源，不是泛泛而谈——这种「细节定成败」的领域，厚知识库就是硬实力。
cosmoblk-email-marketing-bible.why_en: Staggering density (55K words, 908 sources), not hand-waving; in email marketing where details decide outcomes, a thick knowledge base is real muscle.
cosmoblk-email-marketing-bible.limit_zh: 装进来的是索引，19 章全文在 emailmarketingskill.com 上。基准数据标着截至 2026 年中、作者叮嘱要复核。
cosmoblk-email-marketing-bible.limit_en: What ships is an index; the 19 full chapters live on emailmarketingskill.com. Benchmarks are dated mid-2026 with a note to verify volatile figures, and the top pick for agent-driven email, nitrosend, shares a founder with the guide.
cosmoblk-email-marketing-bible.title_en: 908 sources of email marketing, installed as one consultant
cosmoblk-email-marketing-bible._无封面原因: 全仓 0 张图片。产出是邮件营销顾问建议（内容）。
cosmoblk-email-marketing-bible.cover_note: 托管的是 GitHub 预览卡（1200×600/630），不上卡

coffeefuelbump-csv-data-summarizer-claud.title_zh: 拿到陌生 CSV 先给它做个体检
coffeefuelbump-csv-data-summarizer-claud.tagline_zh: 接手一份没见过的数据，得先知道它长什么样、有没有坑。它用 pandas 出摘要统计、查缺失值、画快速图，几秒钟看清。
coffeefuelbump-csv-data-summarizer-claud.tagline_en: Drop in a CSV and get summary stats, missing-value detection and quick plots — pandas under the hood; a health-check for any unfamiliar dataset.
coffeefuelbump-csv-data-summarizer-claud.why_zh: 比自己手写 df.describe() 那套省事，适合每次拿到新数据先跑一遍。
coffeefuelbump-csv-data-summarizer-claud.why_en: Run it first on any unfamiliar CSV — seconds to see shape, gaps and quirks; easier than hand-writing the df.describe() dance.
coffeefuelbump-csv-data-summarizer-claud.limit_zh: 要本机装好 pandas、matplotlib、seaborn。日期列靠列名里有没有 date 认，文末 Notes 又说只在有日期列时才出图。它被硬性禁止问你想看什么，进来就跑完一整套。
coffeefuelbump-csv-data-summarizer-claud.limit_en: Needs pandas, matplotlib and seaborn installed locally. Date columns are detected by the word "date" in the column name, and the Notes say charts are generated only when a date column exists. It is forbidden to ask what you want first.
coffeefuelbump-csv-data-summarizer-claud.title_en: Interrogates a strange CSV before you trust it

jamditis-claude-skills-journalism.tagline_zh: 给记者和调查报道的技能合集：事实核查、信息公开申请（FOIA）、数据新闻、学术写作——新闻这行的专业活它成套备好。
jamditis-claude-skills-journalism.tagline_en: A skills pack for journalists and investigative reporters — fact-checking, FOIA requests, data journalism and academic writing, the trade's pro tools.
jamditis-claude-skills-journalism.why_zh: 少见地认真服务新闻行业：FOIA、事实核查这些专业流程被做成了可执行技能，垂直受众的刚需。
jamditis-claude-skills-journalism.why_en: A rare pack that takes journalism seriously — FOIA and fact-checking as executable skills; a real need for a vertical audience.

tw93-waza.tagline_zh: tw93 出品：把资深工程师那些「你早就知道但懒得坚持」的好习惯，做成 Claude 能自动执行的技能——规划、UI、复盘都在。
tw93-waza.tagline_en: By tw93 — turns the senior-engineer habits you already know but skip into skills Claude runs automatically: planning, UI, review.
tw93-waza.why_zh: 作者是知名开源人 tw93，口味极正；「把好习惯自动化」这个立意戳中了「道理都懂就是做不到」的普遍痛点。
tw93-waza.why_en: By well-known open-sourcer tw93 with sharp taste; automating good habits nails the universal gap between knowing and doing.

tw93-waza-think.tagline_zh: 把粗糙的想法先逼成一份结构完整、决策到位的计划，再动手写代码——任何语言说「帮我规划一下」都能触发。
tw93-waza-think.tagline_en: Forces a rough idea into a structurally validated, decision-complete plan before any code — say "help me plan" in any language to trigger.
tw93-waza-think.why_zh: 「想清楚再写」是资深和新手最大的分野，它把这一步做成硬前置，治「边写边想、写一半推翻」的通病。
tw93-waza-think.why_en: Think-before-code is the senior/junior divide; making it a hard prerequisite cures the write-then-rethink-then-scrap habit.

tw93-waza-ui.tagline_zh: 产出有辨识度、生产级的界面：页面、组件、排版、截图驱动的细节打磨，任何语言让它做 UI 都行，出的东西不像模板。
tw93-waza-ui.tagline_en: Produces distinctive, production-grade UI — pages, components, typography and screenshot-driven polish; ask in any language, output that isn't templated.
tw93-waza-ui.why_zh: 和它同源的 think 是一对：那个管想清楚，这个管做好看，都带 tw93 的审美，出的 UI 有个性不套模板。
tw93-waza-ui.why_en: Pairs with its sibling think — that one thinks, this one styles; both carry tw93's taste, UI with personality not templates.

heygen-com-hyperframes.title_zh: 用写 HTML 的方式渲染出视频
heygen-com-hyperframes.tagline_zh: 剪辑软件里改一版要重来一遍。HeyGen 这套把视频变成代码：动画、字幕、转场、配音全能写，改一帧不用重剪，还能进 git。
heygen-com-hyperframes.tagline_en: HeyGen's video engine: write HTML, render finished video — built for agents, with 16 skills covering animation, captions, seams and voiceover.
heygen-com-hyperframes.why_zh: 「AI 做视频」目前最扎实的一条路：视频成了可版本控制的代码，能精确改一帧，而不是对着黑箱重新抽卡。
heygen-com-hyperframes.why_en: The most solid path yet for AI video — footage becomes version-controlled code an agent can edit frame-precisely, not a black box you re-roll.
heygen-com-hyperframes.limit_zh: 真正干活的是 npm 上的 hyperframes CLI（node ≥22），skill 只是给 agent 的调用说明。仓库 32 份 SKILL.md 只对应 26 个名字——.agents 和 .claude 底下那 6 件是 skills/ 的宿主副本。
heygen-com-hyperframes.limit_en: The work is done by the hyperframes npm CLI (node ≥22); the skills are just agent-facing call notes. 32 SKILL.md files map to 26 names — the six under .agents and .claude are host copies of ones in skills/.
heygen-com-hyperframes.title_en: Video you can diff instead of re-roll

heygen-com-hyperframes-faceless-explaine.title_zh: 把一篇文章变成无需露脸的解说视频
heygen-com-hyperframes-faceless-explaine.tagline_zh: 想做视频但不想出镜、请不动配音。丢一篇文章或一个主题给它，脚本、画面、字幕、配音一条龙，出来就是能发的成片。
heygen-com-hyperframes-faceless-explaine.tagline_en: Feed it an article, rough notes or just a topic and get a faceless explainer video out — no camera, no voice actor, script to final cut.
heygen-com-hyperframes-faceless-explaine.why_zh: 无脸口播是自媒体最好起量的形态，它把最费时的那条产线整条自动化了。
heygen-com-hyperframes-faceless-explaine.why_en: Faceless explainers are the easiest format to scale, and this automates the whole costly pipeline: script, visuals, captions, voice.
heygen-com-hyperframes-faceless-explaine.limit_zh: 真本事分散在 hyperframes-core/creative/animation 和 media-use 几件兄弟件里，少装一件就断。配音默认走 HeyGen 账号；默认女声 Marcia，说要男声而没传 --voice 会被静默忽略。
heygen-com-hyperframes-faceless-explaine.limit_en: The craft lives in sibling skills (hyperframes-core/creative/animation, media-use) — miss one and the chain breaks. Narration defaults to a HeyGen account; default voice is Marcia (female) and a male-voice ask is ignored without --voice.
heygen-com-hyperframes-faceless-explaine.title_en: An article becomes a video with nobody in it

heygen-com-hyperframes-embedded-captions.title_zh: 给口播视频加字幕，不用重渲整片
heygen-com-hyperframes-embedded-captions.tagline_zh: 字幕改一个错字就要等整片重跑，最磨人。它逐句对齐口型节奏单独处理字幕层，样式还按平台习惯来。
heygen-com-hyperframes-embedded-captions.tagline_en: Adds captions to an existing talking-head video without re-rendering the whole thing — phrase-level timing and platform-native caption styling.
heygen-com-hyperframes-embedded-captions.why_zh: 「不重渲染」是关键差别：反复调字幕的人立刻能感受到——改一次几秒钟，而不是几分钟。
heygen-com-hyperframes-embedded-captions.why_en: No full re-render is the point — tweak captions without waiting on the whole clip; anyone iterating on shorts feels this instantly.
heygen-com-hyperframes-embedded-captions.limit_zh: 只吃单人口播：多说话人、有硬切、短于 3 秒、已烧录过字幕的素材，按规矩直接拒。要先 bun build 出 hyperframes，抠像权重 168MB 首次得联网下，且只跑 CPU。
heygen-com-hyperframes-embedded-captions.limit_en: Single-subject talking-head only: multi-speaker, hard cuts, under 3s, or already-burned subtitles are refused by rule. You must build the hyperframes checkout with bun; the 168MB matting weights download once, and matting is CPU-only.
heygen-com-hyperframes-embedded-captions.title_en: Redo the captions without re-rendering the video

heygen-com-hyperframes-hyperframes-cli.tagline_zh: 一条视频好做，一百条要命。init/add/capture/render 一条龙，把出片变成能脚本化的构建流程，重复劳动交给机器。
heygen-com-hyperframes-hyperframes-cli.tagline_en: The HyperFrames CLI dev loop — init, add, catalog, capture, lint and render; the backbone for batch production and automation.
heygen-com-hyperframes-hyperframes-cli.why_zh: 榜单上 33.6 万安装那件。批量做内容的人靠它把「一条一条手工做」变成流水线。
heygen-com-hyperframes-hyperframes-cli.why_en: The 336K-install piece from the leaderboard — video as a scriptable build process, so batch creators hand repetition to the machine.
heygen-com-hyperframes-hyperframes-cli.limit_zh: 要 Node 22+ 和 FFmpeg。catalog 检索只认英文，中文查询直接零结果；语义那一档要先下 33MB 模型，默认不开。云渲染单项目上传上限 200MB，渲染前必须停下等你批准。
heygen-com-hyperframes-hyperframes-cli.limit_en: Needs Node 22+ and FFmpeg. Catalog search indexes English only — a Chinese query returns nothing; the meaning tier needs a 33MB download and is off by default. Cloud render caps upload at 200MB, and it pauses for approval before rendering.
heygen-com-hyperframes-hyperframes-cli.title_en: Video as a build process, lint step included

geekjourneyx-hyperframes-motion-director.title_zh: 从一份提纲导出中文电影感短片
geekjourneyx-hyperframes-motion-director.tagline_zh: HyperFrames 官方件对中文排版水土不服：字挤、断行难看、字幕节奏不对。这件专治，中文优先重调了排版和镜头语言。
geekjourneyx-hyperframes-motion-director.tagline_en: A Chinese-first HyperFrames motion director — outline in, cinematic short out, with typography, caption rhythm and camera language tuned for Chinese content.
geekjourneyx-hyperframes-motion-director.why_zh: 作者是 md2wechat 那位（已在架的中文精品作者），补的正是官方件在中文场景的短板。
geekjourneyx-hyperframes-motion-director.why_en: By the author of md2wechat (already on our shelves) — the official skills stumble on Chinese typography; this one fixes exactly that.
geekjourneyx-hyperframes-motion-director.limit_zh: 要本机的 HyperFrames CLI 和 Node 脚本，配图走 Codex Image Gen，终版渲染要 Docker。第一阶段只交一份提案就停，你不点头它不动工；默认只出 10-15 秒竖屏 1080x1920。
geekjourneyx-hyperframes-motion-director.limit_en: Needs a local HyperFrames CLI, Node scripts, Codex Image Gen for stills, Docker for the final render. Phase 1 stops at a written proposal until you confirm. Defaults to 10-15s vertical 1080x1920.
geekjourneyx-hyperframes-motion-director.title_en: Fixes the Chinese typography the official tools break

xiejunjie524-handdraw-story-video-handdr.title_zh: 批量做黑白线条逐笔显影的竖屏短片
xiejunjie524-handdraw-story-video-handdr.tagline_zh: 这种「线条一笔笔画出来」的短片在中文平台很吃香，难点是量产还不失手作感。35~45 秒一条，讲一个善行小故事。
xiejunjie524-handdraw-story-video-handdr.tagline_en: Batch-produces 35–45s vertical hand-drawn story shorts — black-line reveal animation telling a small good-deed tale, handmade feel at scale.
xiejunjie524-handdraw-story-video-handdr.why_zh: 它把这条产线固化了，批量出片仍保留手绘质感——这正是同类工具最容易丢掉的东西。
xiejunjie524-handdraw-story-video-handdr.why_en: Line-reveal shorts perform well on Chinese platforms; the trick is scaling without losing the handmade texture, and this pins that pipeline down.
xiejunjie524-handdraw-story-video-handdr.limit_zh: 线稿由 scripts/make_lineart.py 从彩图反推，成片靠 HyperFrames 和手拷进去的 gsap.min.js。每拍母图逐张生成，禁止自动重试。规格写死 720×960、8 拍 40 秒，BGM 你自己找授权。
xiejunjie524-handdraw-story-video-handdr.limit_en: Line art comes from scripts/make_lineart.py off the same color image; rendering needs HyperFrames plus gsap.min.js copied in from npm by hand. One mother image per beat, retries forbidden. Locked to 720x960, 8 beats, ~40s; BGM is on you.
xiejunjie524-handdraw-story-video-handdr.title_en: Vertical shorts drawn line by line, made in batches

nateherkai-hyperframes-student-kit-websi.title_zh: 把一个网站变成演示视频
nateherkai-hyperframes-student-kit-websi.tagline_zh: 做宣发视频要重新设计一遍素材，可你的网站本来就是最全的素材库。给个网址，它抓下来直接做成能播的演示片。
nateherkai-hyperframes-student-kit-websi.tagline_en: Give it a URL: it captures the whole website and turns it into a video — product pages, landing pages and portfolios become playable demo reels.
nateherkai-hyperframes-student-kit-websi.why_zh: 点子很妙：省掉「为视频再造一套视觉」这一整步，产品页、落地页、作品集都能用。
nateherkai-hyperframes-student-kit-websi.why_en: A clever premise — your site is already the most complete asset library, so turning it straight into video skips designing a promo from scratch.
nateherkai-hyperframes-student-kit-websi.limit_zh: 第 6 步要调另一件并未附带的 /hyperframes skill，缺它就断在合成前。校验靠 npx hyperframes lint/validate，要 Node。配音得自己接 TTS 再转写拿词级时间戳。七步每步都要先落一个文件才准往下走。
nateherkai-hyperframes-student-kit-websi.limit_en: Step 6 hands off to a separate /hyperframes skill that is not bundled here - without it the chain stops before compositions. Validation is npx hyperframes lint/validate (Node). VO needs your own TTS plus transcription for word timing.
nateherkai-hyperframes-student-kit-websi.title_en: Your own site is already the promo footage

julianoczkowski-designer-skills.tagline_zh: 给「用 AI 做原型和产品」的设计师准备的 8 件套：设计简报、信息架构、设计令牌、设计评审、成品前端，从想清楚到做出来。
julianoczkowski-designer-skills.tagline_en: Eight skills for designers who prototype and ship with AI agents — briefs, information architecture, tokens, reviews and production frontend.
julianoczkowski-designer-skills.why_zh: 难得从设计师视角组织而非工程师视角：先立简报和信息架构再谈视觉，顺序对了产出才不是只会好看。
julianoczkowski-designer-skills.why_en: Rare in being organized from a designer's view, not an engineer's — brief and IA before visuals, so output isn't just pretty.

julianoczkowski-designer-skills-grill-me.tagline_zh: 围着你的方案连续追问，把藏着的假设、遗漏和自相矛盾一个个问出来，问到双方真的想清楚了才收——榜单第一名，75 万安装。
julianoczkowski-designer-skills-grill-me.tagline_en: Interrogates your plan relentlessly, surfacing hidden assumptions, gaps and contradictions until you both actually understand it. The list's #1, 756K installs.
julianoczkowski-designer-skills-grill-me.why_zh: 做重要决定前给自己做一轮压力测试，比事后返工便宜太多；它的狠劲在于不许你用「差不多想过了」蒙混过关。
julianoczkowski-designer-skills-grill-me.why_en: A stress test before big decisions costs far less than rework; its virtue is refusing to let "I've roughly thought it through" slide.

julianoczkowski-designer-skills-design-r.tagline_zh: 拿着设计简报和代码库逐项评审你的界面：视觉层级、间距、一致性、可用性挨个打分，评审意见对得上原始需求。
julianoczkowski-designer-skills-design-r.tagline_en: Reviews your interface against the brief and the codebase — visual hierarchy, spacing, consistency and usability scored, critique tied back to intent.
julianoczkowski-designer-skills-design-r.why_zh: 关键在「对着简报审」：不是泛泛说好看不好看，而是回答「这版有没有实现当初要解决的问题」。
julianoczkowski-designer-skills-design-r.why_en: Reviewing against the brief is the point — not vague taste talk, but whether this build solves what it set out to.

boraoztunc-skills.tagline_zh: 63 件的设计与营销军械库：暗色玻璃、拟物、粗野主义、杂志海报、阴影层次、CRO 落地页、程序化 SEO——想要什么调性都能翻到。
boraoztunc-skills.tagline_en: A 63-piece design and marketing armory — glass dark, skeuomorphic, brutalist, zine posters, layered shadows, CRO landing pages, programmatic SEO.
boraoztunc-skills.why_zh: 罕见地按「视觉调性」而不是按功能分类，找风格像翻色卡；里面单件质量参差，但好料的密度足够高。
boraoztunc-skills.why_en: Unusually organized by visual register rather than function — browsing styles feels like flipping swatches; quality varies, but the gems run dense.

boraoztunc-skills-impeccable.tagline_zh: 像设计总监一样对页面做多轮体检：层级、间距、一致性、细节逐遍挑刺，直到那种「说不上哪不对」的别扭感消失。
boraoztunc-skills-impeccable.tagline_en: Inspects a page in multiple passes like a design director — hierarchy, spacing, consistency and detail, until the "something feels off" itch is gone.
boraoztunc-skills-impeccable.why_zh: 第一版做出来之后最难的是精修，它专攻这一段：不重做，只把已有页面的粗糙处一轮轮磨掉。
boraoztunc-skills-impeccable.why_en: Polish is the hardest stage after v1, and this owns it — no redesign, just pass after pass sanding down the roughness.

boraoztunc-skills-ogilvy-copywriting.tagline_zh: 把广告教父奥格威的那套准则装进 agent：标题决定八成成败、说事实别耍聪明、长文案照样卖货——经典广告手艺的现代复刻。
boraoztunc-skills-ogilvy-copywriting.tagline_en: Installs David Ogilvy's advertising doctrine — headlines carry most of the weight, sell facts not cleverness, long copy still converts.
boraoztunc-skills-ogilvy-copywriting.why_zh: AI 写营销文案最容易滑向空洞漂亮话，奥格威那套「说事实、给证据」的老规矩正好是解药。
boraoztunc-skills-ogilvy-copywriting.why_en: AI marketing copy slides toward pretty emptiness; Ogilvy's insistence on facts and proof is precisely the antidote.

boraoztunc-skills-apple-design.tagline_zh: 把苹果那套界面哲学和「有物理感的流畅动效」翻译成可执行规则：层级、材质、动画曲线，做出来的东西有那股克制的贵气。
boraoztunc-skills-apple-design.tagline_en: Translates Apple's interface philosophy and fluid, physical motion into executable rules — hierarchy, materials and easing that feel expensively restrained.
boraoztunc-skills-apple-design.why_zh: 大家都想「做得像苹果」，但说不出具体怎么做；它把那种克制和物理感拆成了动效曲线与层级规则。
boraoztunc-skills-apple-design.why_en: Everyone wants "Apple-like" without being able to specify it; this decomposes that restraint and physicality into easing curves and hierarchy rules.

ninehills-skills-bggg-creator-image2ppt.tagline_zh: 把截图、海报、别人的 PPT 页面、HTML 或 SVG 设计稿，逆向成可编辑的 PPTX——不是贴张图，是还原成能改的元素。
ninehills-skills-bggg-creator-image2ppt.tagline_en: Reverse-engineers screenshots, posters, other people's slides, HTML or SVG into an editable PPTX — real editable elements, not a pasted image.
ninehills-skills-bggg-creator-image2ppt.why_zh: 「看到一张好看的 PPT 页想照做」是真实高频需求，它输出的是可编辑元素而不是图片，这一步差别就是能不能用。
ninehills-skills-bggg-creator-image2ppt.why_en: "I want that slide, editable" is a real, frequent ask — and editable elements instead of a flat image is the difference between usable and not.

ninehills-skills-bggg-creator-image2psd.tagline_zh: 把一张或多张图片整理成带图层的 PSD：海报拆成可单独调整的元素、多图拼成分层文件，交给设计师继续改的标准交付物。
ninehills-skills-bggg-creator-image2psd.tagline_en: Turns one or more images into a layered PSD — posters split into separately adjustable elements, ready to hand a designer for real edits.
ninehills-skills-bggg-creator-image2psd.why_zh: 分层 PSD 是设计协作的通用货币，「扁平图片拆回图层」这活以前要人手描，现在一句话。
ninehills-skills-bggg-creator-image2psd.why_en: Layered PSDs are design collaboration's currency; un-flattening an image used to mean tracing by hand, now it's one sentence.

ninehills-skills-bggg-skill-taotie.tagline_zh: Skill 进化器：让一个 skill「吞噬」另一个，分析对方的长处再融进自己——想合并两套技能、或用好的那个改造差的，交给它。
ninehills-skills-bggg-skill-taotie.tagline_en: A skill evolver that makes one skill devour another — analyzing its strengths and fusing them in; for merging two skills or upgrading a weak one with a strong one.
ninehills-skills-bggg-skill-taotie.why_zh: 生态里第一批「用 skill 改造 skill」的元工具，饕餮这名字起得妙；自己攒技能库的人会用上。
ninehills-skills-bggg-skill-taotie.why_en: Among the first meta-tools for improving skills with skills, and aptly named after the mythical devourer — useful for anyone curating a library.

kepano-obsidian-skills-obsidian-cli.title_zh: 在 Obsidian 库里搜、写、改、查，不用开编辑
kepano-obsidian-skills-obsidian-cli.tagline_zh: 笔记都在 Obsidian 里，AI 却看不见。装上它 agent 能直接读写笔记、搜索、改属性和任务——作者就是 Obsidian 的 CEO。
kepano-obsidian-skills-obsidian-cli.tagline_en: Drive your Obsidian vault from the CLI — read, create, search notes and manage tasks and properties. Built by kepano, Obsidian's own creator.
kepano-obsidian-skills-obsidian-cli.why_zh: 一手权威：没人比作者更懂这个库的数据模型，比任何第三方封装都可靠。
kepano-obsidian-skills-obsidian-cli.why_en: Written by Obsidian's CEO — nobody knows the vault data model better; your agent can finally read and write your second brain properly.
kepano-obsidian-skills-obsidian-cli.limit_zh: 要装 obsidian 命令行，而且 Obsidian 必须开着，关掉就全断。命令清单以 obsidian help 为准，这里只列了常用几条。不写 vault= 时动的是最近聚焦的那个库。
kepano-obsidian-skills-obsidian-cli.limit_en: Requires the obsidian CLI and a running Obsidian instance; close the app and everything stops. The command list here is partial, with `obsidian help` as the authority. Without vault=, commands act on whichever vault was focused last.
kepano-obsidian-skills-obsidian-cli.title_en: Search, write, edit your Obsidian vault from the CLI

greensock-gsap-skills.tagline_zh: GSAP 官方出品的 AI 技能包：教 agent 正确使用这套业界标准动画库——时间轴、缓动、ScrollTrigger 的正确姿势全在里面。
greensock-gsap-skills.tagline_en: Official AI skills from GreenSock, teaching agents to use the industry-standard animation library correctly — timelines, easing and ScrollTrigger done right.
greensock-gsap-skills.why_zh: 动画库最怕 AI 凭记忆瞎写 API，官方亲自出的技能包等于把正确答案直接给了 agent，出的动效能跑还符合规范。
greensock-gsap-skills.why_en: Animation libraries suffer most from AI writing APIs from memory; an official skill pack hands the agent the right answers.

huggingface-skills.tagline_zh: Hugging Face 官方技能包：让 agent 直接用上模型库、数据集、Spaces 和推理接口，开源 AI 的整个生态一次接通。
huggingface-skills.tagline_en: Official Hugging Face skills that plug your agent into models, datasets, Spaces and inference — the whole open-source AI ecosystem in one connection.
huggingface-skills.why_zh: 开源模型生态的入口就是 HF，官方亲自封装比第三方包装靠谱；找模型、跑推理、拉数据集从此是一句话的事。
huggingface-skills.why_en: HF is the front door to open models, and first-party packaging beats third-party wrappers — finding models and running inference in one sentence.

jnmetacode-superpowers-zh.title_zh: 把 superpowers 搬成中文，并补上国内团队的反模式
jnmetacode-superpowers-zh.tagline_zh: 原版方法论很好但全英文，中文团队用起来隔一层。这版不只翻译，还补了中文 commit 规范、中文 review 话术、国内团队反模式。
jnmetacode-superpowers-zh.tagline_en: A full Chinese localization of superpowers, plus six China-originated skills — Chinese commit conventions, WeChat-ecosystem workflows and the like.
jnmetacode-superpowers-zh.why_zh: 补的是「本土协作场景」，这部分原版不会有——翻译只是壳，加的那部分才是理由。
jnmetacode-superpowers-zh.why_en: The original methodology is strong but English-only; this isn't just translation — it adds originals for how Chinese teams actually collaborate.
jnmetacode-superpowers-zh.limit_zh: 20 件里 14 件是 obra/superpowers 的翻译，只有 6 件原创，方法论著作权在上游。README 大半篇幅是自家课程和赞助商推广。它自称覆盖 23 款工具，但 v1.7.10 更新日志自己写着 Aider、Kiro、Hermes「此前装了等于没装」。
jnmetacode-superpowers-zh.limit_en: 14 of the 20 skills are translations of obra/superpowers; only 6 are original — the methodology is upstream's. Much of the README is course and sponsor promotion. It claims 23 supported tools, yet its own v1.7.10 notes admit the Aider, Kiro and Hermes installs did nothing.
jnmetacode-superpowers-zh.title_en: Superpowers in Chinese, plus anti-patterns it never met

xiaomacoltai-math-modeling-skill.title_zh: 三天赛程里做完数学建模竞赛全流程
xiaomacoltai-math-modeling-skill.tagline_zh: 建模竞赛最难的是三天内同时搞定建模、编程、写论文。它按三阶段分工推进，每阶段还有独立质检 subagent 把关。
xiaomacoltai-math-modeling-skill.tagline_en: A full-pipeline assistant for math-modeling contests — modeling, solving in code, visualization and paper writing, with an independent QA subagent per stage.
xiaomacoltai-math-modeling-skill.why_zh: 按竞赛真实节奏设计的，不是把「数学建模」当学科名词做个通用助手。
xiaomacoltai-math-modeling-skill.why_en: Contest pain is doing modeling, coding and writing in three days; this splits the roles and adds QA gates — designed to the real contest rhythm.
xiaomacoltai-math-modeling-skill.limit_zh: 作者自己写明产出的论文不能直接当作品交，格式还得对当届官方模板。运行环境派不出 Subagent 时，M1/P1/P2/W1/W2 五道门禁只能标 BLOCKED；LaTeX 分支缺编译引擎会直接阻塞。
xiaomacoltai-math-modeling-skill.limit_en: The author states the paper is not a directly submittable entry, and formatting must follow the current year's official template. Without Subagents the M1/P1/P2/W1/W2 gates can only be marked BLOCKED; LaTeX blocks without a compiler.
xiaomacoltai-math-modeling-skill.title_en: A three-day contest team with its own QA critic

khendzel-skills-janitor.title_zh: 给你装的技能库做体检和减法
khendzel-skills-janitor.tagline_zh: 装得越多上下文越挤，还不知道哪个在偷偷吃 token、哪个藏着提示注入。它左滑扔掉浪费的、扫风险、给诚实的 token 账单。
khendzel-skills-janitor.tagline_en: A health check for your installed skills — swipe away context wasters, scan for prompt injection, get an honest token bill. It calls itself Tinder for skills.
khendzel-skills-janitor.why_zh: 这个生态罕见的「减法」工具：装得多不等于装得好，它同时管省上下文、防注入、看清成本。
khendzel-skills-janitor.why_en: More installed isn't better: it handles context waste, injection risk and real cost at once — a rare subtractive tool in this ecosystem.
khendzel-skills-janitor.limit_zh: 它会真动手删：左滑就把那个 MCP server 从配置文件里移除，只留一个带时间戳的 .bak。判断依据是本机会话记录里的调用次数——刚装没多久的 skill 天然显示成「没用过」，容易误杀。安全扫描作者写明是启发式。
khendzel-skills-janitor.limit_en: It actually deletes: swipe left and the MCP server is removed from your config file, leaving a timestamped .bak. Its verdict comes from call counts in your local transcripts, so anything installed recently reads as 'never used'. The security scan is explicitly heuristic.
khendzel-skills-janitor.title_en: Swipe left on the skills quietly billing you tokens
khendzel-skills-janitor._无封面原因: 唯一的图是 303 帧终端录屏 GIF。**首帧非背景像素只占 0.2%**（实测），懒加载从第 0 帧起，卡片刚出现就是个空框；而且终端界面录屏不是产出物 —— 这条线跟「界面截图不算产出物」是同一条。中段确实有它的裁决卡（Verdict ✓ Used recently — keep + 快捷键条），但取不出一张能当静态封面的帧。
khendzel-skills-janitor.cover_note: 托管的是 GitHub 预览卡（1200×600/630），不上卡

312362115-claude-diagram.title_zh: 自动选对图表类型再画出来
312362115-claude-diagram.tagline_zh: 多数人卡在「该用泳道图还是时序图」，不是不会画。它先按需求选型，再从 29 种里出符合规范的 PNG。
312362115-claude-diagram.tagline_en: Picks the right chart type for your need and renders it — 29 kinds including swimlanes, sequence, ER, Gantt, Kanban and Git graphs, straight to spec-compliant PNG.
312362115-claude-diagram.why_zh: 先选型后出图这个顺序，比丢给你一堆模板实用得多。
312362115-claude-diagram.why_en: Most people stall on which chart, not how to draw it; choosing the type before rendering is more useful than handing over templates.
312362115-claude-diagram.limit_zh: 出 PNG 必须跑 scripts/capture.py 和 bridge.py（内部调 Playwright），正文禁止你手动截图。雷达、热力、散点、漏斗、瀑布不支持 Mermaid 文本输出，只能留 PNG。
312362115-claude-diagram.limit_en: PNGs only come out of scripts/capture.py and bridge.py, which drive Playwright internally — screenshotting by hand is forbidden. Radar, heatmap, scatter, funnel and waterfall get no Mermaid text output, only PNG.
312362115-claude-diagram.title_en: Decides which of 29 diagram types you actually meant

312362115-claude-code-walkthrough.title_zh: 带你读懂一个陌生代码库
312362115-claude-code-walkthrough.tagline_zh: 接手别人的项目，难点从来不是看不懂语法，而是不知道各部分为什么这样连。它从架构到核心流程到关键决策分层讲。
312362115-claude-code-walkthrough.tagline_en: A guide for unfamiliar codebases — architecture, then core flows, then key design decisions, answering why the code is written this way instead of listing files.
312362115-claude-code-walkthrough.why_zh: 目标定得对：它要给你的是心智模型，不是文件清单。
312362115-claude-code-walkthrough.why_en: Building a mental model is the right goal — reading code is hard not because of syntax but because you can't see why parts connect.
312362115-claude-code-walkthrough.limit_zh: 它只回答「这是什么、怎么运转」；「改这里会动到哪儿」作者明说归另一件 dependency-map，那件不在包里。全程没脚本，靠现读 ls 和 git log，长导读落在 docs/guides/。
312362115-claude-code-walkthrough.limit_en: It answers "what is this and how does it run"; the author routes "what breaks if I change it" to a separate dependency-map skill that isn't bundled. No scripts at all — it reads ls and git log live and drops long write-ups in docs/guides/.
312362115-claude-code-walkthrough.title_en: Reads a strange codebase for why, not what

anbeime-skill-antinet-four-color-cards.title_zh: 把一份文档拆成四色行动卡
anbeime-skill-antinet-four-color-cards.tagline_zh: 读完一份合同或报告，记不住重点也不知道下一步做什么。它拆成蓝卡（事实）、绿卡（解释）、黄卡（风险）、红卡（行动）。
anbeime-skill-antinet-four-color-cards.tagline_en: Breaks a document into four colored cards — blue facts, green interpretation, yellow risks, red actions — so what to note, guard against and do is immediately clear.
anbeime-skill-antinet-four-color-cards.why_zh: 颜色分层这个输出格式很聪明：把「读完了」变成「能行动」，看合同、报告、竞品资料尤其顺。
anbeime-skill-antinet-four-color-cards.why_en: The color-layered output is clever — it converts "I read it" into "I can act", especially for contracts, reports and competitor material.
anbeime-skill-antinet-four-color-cards.limit_zh: 拆的是「读完→能行动」的卡片，不替代法律/财务意见。超长文档会按块切，跨块前后文可能丢。
anbeime-skill-antinet-four-color-cards.limit_en: Action cards, not legal or financial advice. Long docs are chunked; cross-chunk context can drop.

wanshuiyin-anti-autoresearch-anti-autore.title_zh: 核查一篇论文是不是 AI 编的
wanshuiyin-anti-autoresearch-anti-autore.tagline_zh: AI 写的论文越来越多，数据对不上、引用编造、结论超出证据。它做实质性诚信取证，专查这类漏洞。
wanshuiyin-anti-autoresearch-anti-autore.tagline_en: Runs a substantive-integrity forensic sweep on a paper, aimed at AI-generated research — mismatched data, fabricated citations, conclusions outstripping evidence.
wanshuiyin-anti-autoresearch-anti-autore.why_zh: 立意站在学术诚信这边，做法也具体——反向取证的工具比生成工具少得多。
wanshuiyin-anti-autoresearch-anti-autore.why_en: AI-written papers keep multiplying while integrity forensics stays rare; this stands on the right side and does it concretely.
wanshuiyin-anti-autoresearch-anti-autore.limit_zh: 得在它自己的仓库里跑（tools/adjudicate_findings.py），还要 codex MCP 调 gpt-5.6-sol 复核；没有就只剩确定性检查，那种模式永远给不出 CLEAN。只有 PDF 时够不着代码级造假。
wanshuiyin-anti-autoresearch-anti-autore.limit_en: Must run inside its own checkout (tools/adjudicate_findings.py) and needs codex MCP with gpt-5.6-sol for cross-model review; without it only deterministic checks run, and that mode can never return CLEAN. A PDF alone can't reach code fraud.
wanshuiyin-anti-autoresearch-anti-autore.title_en: Forensics for papers whose citations were never written

komal-skynet-claude-skill-homeassistant-.title_zh: 用对话管理智能家居的自动化配置
komal-skynet-claude-skill-homeassistant-.tagline_zh: Home Assistant 的 YAML 改错一行，整屋自动化就哑掉。它带安全校验再部署，还能排查设备失联——终于不用手写配置了。
komal-skynet-claude-skill-homeassistant-.tagline_en: Manage all of Home Assistant by conversation — safely edit automation YAML, deploy scripts and blueprints, debug offline devices. No more hand-written config.
komal-skynet-claude-skill-homeassistant-.why_zh: 「校验后再部署」这个设计，是敢让 AI 碰真设备的前提。
komal-skynet-claude-skill-homeassistant-.why_en: HA's YAML is the smart-home hobbyist's shared pain — one wrong line silences the house; this validates before deploying, so letting AI touch real devices is safe.
komal-skynet-claude-skill-homeassistant-.limit_zh: 默认你有 SSH，且手上这个仓库就是 git 连着实例的 /config；改完还要 ssh 进去 git pull 才生效。hass-cli 的 HASS_TOKEN 得在会话启动前就设好，否则它会转向 localhost 报错。
komal-skynet-claude-skill-homeassistant-.limit_en: Assumes SSH access and that the repo you edit is the HA /config dir wired to the instance by git; edits go live only after you ssh in and git pull. hass-cli needs HASS_TOKEN set before the session starts, or it hits localhost.
komal-skynet-claude-skill-homeassistant-.title_en: Rewrites the YAML that can silence your whole house

borski-travel-hacking-toolkit.title_zh: 用现金里程积分四路比价找最省的飞法
borski-travel-hacking-toolkit.tagline_zh: 同一趟航线，行家和小白的票价能差几千块。它搜奖励座位、算兑换比、盯放票，把泡论坛才学得会的手艺自动化。
borski-travel-hacking-toolkit.tagline_en: Finds the cheapest way to fly across cash, points, miles and award tickets — searching award seats, computing redemption value and watching availability.
borski-travel-hacking-toolkit.why_zh: 里程兑换门道深、信息碎，这类知识差价最大——它把差价那部分变成了工具。
borski-travel-hacking-toolkit.why_en: Award travel is deep and fragmented — experts and novices can pay thousands apart for the same seat; this automates craft you'd otherwise learn on forums.
borski-travel-hacking-toolkit.limit_zh: 48 件几乎全是欧美体系——美航、西南、Chase、Amex、Bilt、德铁、北欧铁路，一件亚洲航司或国内银行积分都没有。装法是 /plugin marketplace add；六个 MCP server 里 LiteAPI 那个要自己申请 key。
borski-travel-hacking-toolkit.limit_en: All 48 skills sit in the US/EU ecosystem — American, Southwest, Chase, Amex, Bilt, Deutsche Bahn — with no Asian carrier or Chinese bank program. Installs via /plugin marketplace add; of six MCP servers, LiteAPI needs your own key.
borski-travel-hacking-toolkit.title_en: The same seat, thousands apart in price

mvanhorn-last30days-skill-last30days.title_zh: 查最近30天网上真实在聊什么
mvanhorn-last30days-skill-last30days.tagline_zh: 要判断一个话题热不热、用户到底在骂什么，读官方介绍全是好话。它抓 Reddit、X、YouTube、HN 的原帖和互动数据，给你带出处的真实民意。
mvanhorn-last30days-skill-last30days.tagline_en: Finds what people actually said about any topic in the last 30 days — pulling posts and engagement from Reddit, X, YouTube, TikTok and HN, then synthesizing with sources.
mvanhorn-last30days-skill-last30days.why_zh: 它要的不是官方说法而是用户原话——做选题、验证需求、看竞品口碑时，比读一百页产品页有用。
mvanhorn-last30days-skill-last30days.why_en: A 58k-star hit that chases real user words over official positioning — worth a hundred product pages when validating demand or reading sentiment.
mvanhorn-last30days-skill-last30days.limit_zh: 硬卡 Python 3.12+，低了它宁可停也不退成网页搜索。首跑要过向导：装 yt-dlp、npx 装 Digg CLI、抽浏览器 cookie；X 那路要 AUTH_TOKEN/CT0，没配的源只标成未配置。存档落在 ~/Documents/Last30Days。
mvanhorn-last30days-skill-last30days.limit_en: Hard-gated on Python 3.12+; below that it stops rather than fall back to web search. First run installs yt-dlp and the Digg CLI via npx and extracts browser cookies; X search needs AUTH_TOKEN/CT0. Saves to ~/Documents/Last30Days.
mvanhorn-last30days-skill-last30days.title_en: What people actually said in the last thirty days

alchaincyf-nuwa-skill.title_zh: 把任何人的思维方式做成一个能装的 skill
alchaincyf-nuwa-skill.tagline_zh: 想让 AI 像某个高手那样思考，你却说不清他到底怎么想。给它一个名字，它自动深度调研、提炼决策框架，当场造出一个能用的人物 skill。
alchaincyf-nuwa-skill.tagline_en: Give it a name or even a vague need: it researches deeply, distills the mental framework, and mints a working persona skill on the spot.
alchaincyf-nuwa-skill.why_zh: 店里的张雪峰、X 导师都是它造出来的——「用 skill 造 skill」这条路上目前最成气候的一个。
alchaincyf-nuwa-skill.why_en: Several skills on our own shelves came out of it — the most mature take yet on skills that build skills.
alchaincyf-nuwa-skill.limit_zh: 作者原话：顶级模型跑一次完整蒸馏可消耗数十美元；单次能累到 50 万 token，20 万窗口的模型得分三段会话续跑。知乎、微信公众号、百度百科被永久列入信息源黑名单。
alchaincyf-nuwa-skill.limit_en: The author's own number: a full distillation on a top model can burn tens of dollars and 500k+ tokens, so 200k-window models must split it across three sessions. Zhihu, WeChat public accounts and Baidu Baike are blacklisted as sources.
alchaincyf-nuwa-skill.title_en: Turns a person's thinking into an installable skill

op7418-guizang-ppt-skill.title_zh: 做能双屏演讲的网页版 PPT
op7418-guizang-ppt-skill.tagline_zh: 上台讲的时候最想要演讲者视图和观众屏同步，普通 AI 做的 PPT 一概没有。它出的是单文件网页 deck，带 WebGL 流体背景和章节幕封。
op7418-guizang-ppt-skill.tagline_en: Single-file web decks with WebGL fluid backgrounds, presenter view, audience-screen sync and chapter covers — in editorial-magazine or Swiss-international styles.
op7418-guizang-ppt-skill.why_zh: 演讲者视图和双屏同步这种细节，市面上的 AI PPT 工具基本没人做，歸藏把它塞进了一个 HTML。
op7418-guizang-ppt-skill.why_en: Presenter view and second-screen sync are details almost no AI deck tool bothers with, and this one folds them into a single HTML file.
op7418-guizang-ppt-skill.limit_zh: 作者自己划的禁区：大段表格图表、培训课件、多人协作编辑都别用它，成品就是一份静态 HTML。主题只能从预设 5 套/4 套里挑，不收自定义 hex；两套风格类名互斥不能混。校验脚本要 Node，渲染实测还要 Playwright。
op7418-guizang-ppt-skill.limit_en: The author rules out dense tables, courseware and collaborative editing - the artifact is one static HTML file. Themes come from the 5 or 4 presets, no custom hex, and the two styles' class names cannot be mixed. Validators need Node.
op7418-guizang-ppt-skill.title_en: Presenter view and dual screens, in one file

alchaincyf-zhangxuefeng-skill.title_zh: 用张雪峰的框架分析升学和职业选择
alchaincyf-zhangxuefeng-skill.tagline_zh: 高考志愿、考研、转行——这类决定影响十年，家里人给的建议却常常凭感觉。它基于他 5 本书、15 篇深访提炼出的心智模型和决策启发式来拆。
alchaincyf-zhangxuefeng-skill.tagline_en: Analyzes education and career choices through Zhang Xuefeng's frameworks — five mental models and eight decision heuristics distilled from five books and 15+ interviews.
alchaincyf-zhangxuefeng-skill.why_zh: 调研扎实，不是拿网红名字贴标签；请不到本人，就请一份他的思维方式。
alchaincyf-zhangxuefeng-skill.why_en: College and career decisions are high-stakes for Chinese families; if you can't hire him, hire his reasoning — and the research behind it is real, not name-dropping.
alchaincyf-zhangxuefeng-skill.limit_zh: 适用面它自己划得很死：普通家庭、就业导向的升学选择；家境宽裕、想走学术或创业的人，正文说这套建议可能反而是束缚。语料截至 2026-04-05，碰院校专业数据必须现搜。
alchaincyf-zhangxuefeng-skill.limit_en: It draws its boundary hard: ordinary families making employment-driven education choices. For well-off, academic or entrepreneurial paths it says the advice may become a constraint. Research ends 2026-04-05; school data is searched live.
alchaincyf-zhangxuefeng-skill.title_en: Eight decision rules from China's bluntest college counselor

alchaincyf-darwin-skill.title_zh: 让你写的 skill 自己迭代变强
alchaincyf-darwin-skill.tagline_zh: skill 写完就定死了，好不好用只能凭感觉。它跑「评估→改进→测试→保留或回滚」的闭环，改坏了自己退回去，2.0 还接了微软研究院的九维评测。
alchaincyf-darwin-skill.tagline_en: An autonomous skill optimizer running evaluate → improve → test → keep-or-rollback, with Microsoft Research's nine-dimension SkillLens wired into v2.0.
alchaincyf-darwin-skill.why_zh: 带回滚的进化循环才算真自动优化；接学术评测体系这一步说明作者不是随口说进化。
alchaincyf-darwin-skill.why_en: An evolution loop with rollback is real self-optimization — a bad change reverts itself; wiring in an academic eval suite shows the author means it.
alchaincyf-darwin-skill.limit_zh: 保留还是回滚要 spawn 三个独立 judge 做配对比较，跑不了子 agent 就退成干跑，作者自己写明干跑超 30% 评估即失效。它在 git 分支上直接改你的 SKILL.md，每支改完都停下等你点头。
alchaincyf-darwin-skill.limit_en: Keep-or-revert needs three independent judge subagents doing paired comparison; with no subagents it falls back to dry runs, which the author says invalidate scoring past 30%. It edits your SKILL.md on a git branch and halts for sign-off.
alchaincyf-darwin-skill.title_en: The skill that rewrites itself, and rolls back

kkkkhazix-human-writing-human-writing.title_zh: 按活人那套改中文长文
kkkkhazix-human-writing-human-writing.tagline_zh: 知乎帖、人物故事、行业文，先删腔再写
kkkkhazix-human-writing-human-writing.tagline_en: Makes Chinese read like a person who has seen things, checked sources and wants to explain properly — long answers, articles, scripts and dialogue alike.
kkkkhazix-human-writing-human-writing.why_zh: 卡兹克这件卖的是中文现场的人味，不是通用润色按钮。
kkkkhazix-human-writing-human-writing.why_en: Installing a specific human voice beats blacklisting AI words — the first governs syntax and point of view, the second only swaps vocabulary. Chinese original, not a translation.
kkkkhazix-human-writing-human-writing.limit_zh: 不是短视频口播稿。要英文明信片、要公文，另装。
kkkkhazix-human-writing-human-writing.limit_en: If a nonfiction piece cannot list five concrete pieces of material, it refuses to write long and caps you near 600 characters. Em dashes, signposting colons and "not A but B" framing are banned. check_prose.py checks hard bans only.
kkkkhazix-human-writing-human-writing.title_en: Installs a voice instead of banning AI words

alchaincyf-x-mentor-skill.title_zh: 读过 X 开源算法再教你写推文的增长教练
alchaincyf-x-mentor-skill.tagline_zh: 蒸馏 Nicolas Cole、Sahil Bloom、Hormozi 等六位顶级创作者的方法论,加上对 X 开源算法的分析,给出选题—写作—增长的完整操作手册。
alchaincyf-x-mentor-skill.tagline_en: Distills the playbooks of six top creators — Nicolas Cole, Sahil Bloom, Hormozi and more — plus analysis of X's open-sourced algorithm into a topic-to-growth manual.
alchaincyf-x-mentor-skill.why_zh: 少见地把「创作者方法论」和「平台算法机制」两头都吃透:知道写什么,也知道平台为什么推它。
alchaincyf-x-mentor-skill.why_en: Rare in covering both sides — what to write and why the platform amplifies it, methodology married to algorithm.
alchaincyf-x-mentor-skill.limit_zh: 算法那部分停在 2026 年 4 月的 X 开源数据，作者自陈方法论以英文市场为主、中文传播规律未必相同。账号诊断要 computer-use 或 Chrome 扩展去抓推文，抓不到就得你自己导 CSV。
alchaincyf-x-mentor-skill.limit_en: Its algorithm reading is frozen at the April 2026 open-source X data, and the author notes the methodology is English-market first. Account diagnosis needs computer-use or a Chrome extension to scrape tweets, else you export CSV by hand.
alchaincyf-x-mentor-skill.title_en: Six creators' playbooks, plus the algorithm's source code
alchaincyf-x-mentor-skill._无封面原因: 作者仓库里没有产出物样张（逐张开过：「X导师.skill — 路由逻辑」流程图：用户输入 → 紫色问题路由器 → 四个场景框（写推文/选题/审阅/增长），下）

alchaincyf-huashu-skills.tagline_zh: 花叔的内容创作 11 件套:AI 审校、选题生成、视频大纲、素材搜索、设计风格顾问——中文创作者的日常流水线。
alchaincyf-huashu-skills.tagline_en: Huashu's 11-piece content kit — AI proofreading, topic generation, video outlines, asset search and design-style advising; a Chinese creator's daily line.
alchaincyf-huashu-skills.why_zh: 和已在架的花叔设计是同一位作者的另一条产品线:这套管「内容」,那套管「视觉」,都是他自己每天在用的。
alchaincyf-huashu-skills.why_en: A second product line from the same author as our Huashu design skill — this one handles content, that one visuals; both tools he uses daily.

alchaincyf-huashu-skills-huashu-video-ou.tagline_zh: 一次给出 2-3 个视频大纲方案,每个都带标题、封面建议和结构设计——开拍之前先把方向选对,别拍到一半推翻。
alchaincyf-huashu-skills-huashu-video-ou.tagline_en: Delivers two or three video outline options at once, each with titles, cover suggestions and structure — pick the direction before you shoot, not halfway through.
alchaincyf-huashu-skills-huashu-video-ou.why_zh: 「一次给几个方案对比」比一口气生成一个更实用:视频最贵的是拍完发现方向错了。
alchaincyf-huashu-skills-huashu-video-ou.why_en: Options to compare beat one confident answer — the costliest video mistake is discovering the wrong direction after shooting.

joeseesun-qiaomu-cut-skill.title_zh: 做可复现可验收的视频剪辑工程
joeseesun-qiaomu-cut-skill.tagline_zh: AI 剪的视频改一版就得重新抽卡，交付时也说不清素材哪来的。它做素材治理、双语字幕、品牌包装，每步留痕，重跑结果不变。
joeseesun-qiaomu-cut-skill.tagline_en: Turns a one-line brief into a reproducible, reviewable video project — governed sourcing, bilingual subtitles, brand packaging and traceable renders.
joeseesun-qiaomu-cut-skill.why_zh: 「可复现 + 可验收」在 AI 视频里很少见：改一版不用碰运气，交付时每一帧都有出处。
joeseesun-qiaomu-cut-skill.why_en: Reproducible and reviewable are rare words in AI video — revisions don't re-roll the dice, and you can account for every frame.
joeseesun-qiaomu-cut-skill.limit_zh: 渲染要 ffmpeg-full，随附的安装脚本只写了 macOS 和 Homebrew。台词库与 ListenHub 各要自己单独装的 CLI，还会耗积分。片尾硬性带「向阳乔木」和 @vista8，规则里不许省。
joeseesun-qiaomu-cut-skill.limit_en: Rendering needs ffmpeg-full and the bundled bootstrap script is Homebrew/macOS only. The movie-line search and ListenHub each need their own separately installed CLI and burn credits. Every outro must carry the author's name and @vista8.
joeseesun-qiaomu-cut-skill.title_en: Video edits that don't re-roll the dice

joeseesun-qiaomu-opencli-skills.tagline_zh: 用一套 CLI 接通 B 站、知乎、X、YouTube、微博、小红书、V2EX、Reddit:借你已登录的 Chrome 会话取内容,不用申请 API。
joeseesun-qiaomu-opencli-skills.tagline_en: One CLI reaching Bilibili, Zhihu, X, YouTube, Weibo, Xiaohongshu, V2EX and Reddit — using your logged-in Chrome session, no API applications.
joeseesun-qiaomu-opencli-skills.why_zh: 中文平台的 API 基本申请不到,它走「复用你自己的登录态」这条路,把最难拿的中文语料变成可抓的。
joeseesun-qiaomu-opencli-skills.why_en: Chinese platform APIs are effectively unobtainable; reusing your own logged-in session makes the hardest corpus reachable.

op7418-logo-generator-skill.tagline_zh: 生成专业级 SVG logo 和高级感展示图:矢量输出可无损缩放,顺手给你出一套品牌应用场景效果图。
op7418-logo-generator-skill.tagline_en: Generates professional SVG logos plus high-end showcase renders — vector output that scales losslessly, with brand mockups thrown in.
op7418-logo-generator-skill.why_zh: 输出是矢量而不是位图,这一点决定了能不能真用在产品上;歸藏出品,审美有保证。
op7418-logo-generator-skill.why_en: Vector, not raster — that alone decides whether a logo is usable in production. And it's Guizang's, so the taste is vetted.
op7418-logo-generator-skill.limit_zh: SVG 是模型现写的；但那套高级感展示图要 scripts/generate_showcase.py、Python 3.8+、cairosvg，还得自备 .env 里的 GEMINI_API_KEY，没 key 就只剩矢量图。
op7418-logo-generator-skill.limit_en: The SVGs are model-authored and free, but the showcase renders need scripts/generate_showcase.py, Python 3.8+, cairosvg and your own GEMINI_API_KEY in .env. No key means vectors only; with one you still hit Gemini quota and rate limits.
op7418-logo-generator-skill.title_en: A logo that's vector from the first draft

ourword-ai-pixelpad.title_zh: 在 24×24 画布上画原生像素图
ourword-ai-pixelpad.tagline_zh: 想要一张像素风头像或游戏精灵，AI 给的却是大图缩小后的糊边。它逐像素落调色板索引，边缘是硬的，还能导出一格格蹦出来的显影动画。
ourword-ai-pixelpad.tagline_en: Native 24x24 pixel art — every pixel is a palette index placed on purpose, not a downscaled render; exports transparent PNG plus a pixel-by-pixel reveal GIF.
ourword-ai-pixelpad.why_zh: 本店自制。质量不靠一次成型，靠「画→渲染→自己看一眼→改」的回环，两轮从一团色到能用；全本地跑，不调图像 API。器物比有机形体扎实。
ourword-ai-pixelpad.why_en: Made in-house. Quality comes not from one-shot generation but from teaching the agent to draw, render, actually look, and fix — usually two rounds from blob to usable sprite. Fully local.
ourword-ai-pixelpad.limit_zh: 画布固定 24×24，不是任意分辨率像素风滤镜。有机体（人脸、动物）往往要多轮，器物更稳。全本地、无图像 API。
ourword-ai-pixelpad.limit_en: Fixed 24×24 canvas — not a downscale filter at any size. Organic forms often need extra rounds; objects are more solid. Fully local, no image API.

lincwang123-bot-moonlit-stories-moonlit-.title_zh: 给自家孩子做一本带家长配音的绘本
lincwang123-bot-moonlit-stories-moonlit-.tagline_zh: 12 页同一张脸，用你的声音读完
lincwang123-bot-moonlit-stories-moonlit-.tagline_en: Makes a 12-page personalized English picture book for your kid — a fixed watercolor house style plus a per-book character sheet keeps the child looking like the same character across all pages, narrated in a parent's own cloned voice, shipped as one sendable HTML file.
lincwang123-bot-moonlit-stories-moonlit-.why_zh: 固定水彩画风加角色设定图，保证每页都是同一个小孩，再用你自己的声音朗读，出一个能发出去的文件。
lincwang123-bot-moonlit-stories-moonlit-.why_en: It solves the hard parts: AI illustration usually drifts into a different-looking child each page, so it locks consistency with a style anchor plus a character sheet; voice cloning accepts only authorized adult recordings with guardian checkpoints, and private audio never ships in the output. Apple Silicon Mac + Codex only, ~3.2GB local model.
lincwang123-bot-moonlit-stories-moonlit-.limit_zh: 是英文 12 页绘本。要中文长篇、要每页换脸，会漂。
lincwang123-bot-moonlit-stories-moonlit-.limit_en: It produces an English picture book — Chinese needs another pass. Costs scale with pages since it calls an image model and TTS; changing the style key or character sheet forces a full regeneration.
lincwang123-bot-moonlit-stories-moonlit-.title_en: A bedtime book read in your own cloned voice
lincwang123-bot-moonlit-stories-moonlit-.cover_note: 托管的是 GitHub 预览卡（1200×600/630），不上卡

worldwonderer-drama-skills.tagline_zh: AI 短剧/漫剧的全链路 10 件套：原著拆解、改编方案、分集地图、分镜与冻结关键帧、图片视频提示词，一直到独立审查。
worldwonderer-drama-skills.tagline_en: A ten-piece pipeline for AI short-drama and comic-drama — source deconstruction, adaptation plan, episode map, storyboards with frozen keyframes, prompts, and independent review.
worldwonderer-drama-skills.why_zh: 网文全家桶那位作者的新作，同样的工业化路子搬到短剧上；短剧是眼下中文内容最猛的赛道，这是少见的成体系解法。
worldwonderer-drama-skills.why_en: By the author of our web-fiction pack, applying the same industrial approach to short drama — the hottest Chinese content format, with a rare end-to-end system.

worldwonderer-drama-skills-short-drama-n.tagline_zh: 把长篇小说或连载网文拆成可追溯的改编分析：章节索引、逐章功能提取、剧情单元与节奏聚合，最后给出改编价值判定和分集候选。
worldwonderer-drama-skills-short-drama-n.tagline_en: Deconstructs a novel or serial into traceable adaptation analysis — chapter index, per-chapter function extraction, story units and pacing, then an adaptation-value verdict with episode candidates.
worldwonderer-drama-skills-short-drama-n.why_zh: 「这本书值不值得改编、怎么分集」是制片端最贵的判断，它把它拆成了有依据的流程而不是拍脑袋。
worldwonderer-drama-skills-short-drama-n.why_en: Whether a book is worth adapting and how to cut episodes is the priciest call in production; this makes it evidence-based instead of instinct.

worldwonderer-drama-skills-short-drama-d.tagline_zh: 把一个想法或梗概发展成可追溯的改编方案：戏剧方向、创作简报、导演阐述、故事引擎、分集地图，按题材和画风分别成型。
worldwonderer-drama-skills-short-drama-d.tagline_en: Grows an idea or synopsis into a traceable adaptation package — dramatic direction, creative brief, director's statement, story engine and episode map, shaped by genre and art style.
worldwonderer-drama-skills-short-drama-d.why_zh: 策划案是短剧开机前的命根子，这件把它做成有交接、可追溯的文档链，不是一篇散文。
worldwonderer-drama-skills-short-drama-d.why_en: The pitch package decides whether a short drama survives pre-production; this turns it into a traceable document chain, not an essay.

worldwonderer-drama-skills-short-drama-s.tagline_zh: 把定稿剧本转成原文落实表、有戏剧动机的镜头、连续性边界和冻结关键帧提示词，关键场次还能先做视觉计划试戏。
worldwonderer-drama-skills-short-drama-s.tagline_en: Turns a locked script into line-accountable shot lists with dramatic motivation, continuity bounds and frozen keyframe prompts, with visual planning for key scenes.
worldwonderer-drama-skills-short-drama-s.why_zh: 「冻结关键帧」这个设计很professional：把人物和场景锁死后再生成，才不会每集换个脸。
worldwonderer-drama-skills-short-drama-s.why_en: Frozen keyframes are the professional touch — lock characters and sets first, and episodes stop drifting into different faces.

op7418-guizang-material-illustration.title_zh: 生成有材质感的解释图和文章配图
op7418-guizang-material-illustration.tagline_zh: 解释性配图最难两全：准确的往往丑，好看的往往说不清。歸藏这套专攻这一点——材质质感 + 文字标注，一眼看懂还挺好看。
op7418-guizang-material-illustration.tagline_en: Generates Guizang-style material illustrations, labeled explanatory diagrams and chart beautification — the article visuals that are both instantly legible and good-looking.
op7418-guizang-material-illustration.why_zh: 作者是中文 AI 设计内容的头部创作者，审美有背书——这类东西的价值全在挑图那双眼睛。
op7418-guizang-material-illustration.why_en: The author is a leading Chinese voice on AI design; with work like this the value sits entirely in the eye doing the picking.
op7418-guizang-material-illustration.limit_zh: 只做插图这一层：小红书/公众号卡片和 PPT 版式要另配社交卡片、PPT 两件 skill。要有 imagegen 或内置生图。图内标签压到 2-5 字，模型中文写不好就只能再删字。产物默认落在 local-tests/<slug>/。
op7418-guizang-material-illustration.limit_en: The illustration layer only - card composition and slide layout go to the separate social-card and PPT skills. Needs imagegen or a built-in image tool. In-image labels cap at 2-5 Chinese characters. Output lands in local-tests/<slug>/.
op7418-guizang-material-illustration.title_en: Explainer diagrams with texture you can almost feel

anthropics-k12-teacher-skills-k12-lesson.tagline_zh: Anthropic 官方与 Learning Commons 合作出品：生成一份完整教案、配套学生材料和课堂观察表，附带评测量规。
anthropics-k12-teacher-skills-k12-lesson.tagline_en: Official from Anthropic with Learning Commons — produces a full lesson plan, student-facing materials and a classroom observation template, with eval rubrics.
anthropics-k12-teacher-skills-k12-lesson.why_zh: 官方联合教育机构做的，教案不是套模板而是带观察表和量规，教师能直接用进课堂。
anthropics-k12-teacher-skills-k12-lesson.why_en: Built with actual educators — not a template dump but a plan shipped with observation tools and rubrics a teacher can use tomorrow.

anthropics-k12-teacher-skills-k12-lesson.tagline_zh: 把一份现成教案按学生差异改编：数学、语文、科学、社会都覆盖，为不同水平和需求的学生各出一版。
anthropics-k12-teacher-skills-k12-lesson.tagline_en: Adapts an existing K-12 lesson for student differences across math, ELA, science and social studies, producing versions for varied levels and needs.
anthropics-k12-teacher-skills-k12-lesson.why_zh: 分层教学是老师最耗时又最难做好的活，官方把它做成流程，对一线教师是实打实的减负。
anthropics-k12-teacher-skills-k12-lesson.why_en: Differentiation is a teacher's most time-consuming task; turning it into a process is real relief for classroom staff.

irenerachel-style-pack-skill.title_zh: 从参考图提取可复用的视觉风格包
irenerachel-style-pack-skill.tagline_zh: 看到一个喜欢的画面，想把那股味道复用到自己的东西上——但说不清它到底哪里对。它拆出 10 色标注色卡和风格参数，把感觉变成能交付的东西。
irenerachel-style-pack-skill.tagline_en: Extracts reusable visual style DNA from reference images, film stills or video frames — always emitting a labeled ten-color palette plus a flat version, packaged as a style pack.
irenerachel-style-pack-skill.why_zh: 强制输出带标注色卡和纯色版，这一步让「风格」从形容词变成可传递的资产。
irenerachel-style-pack-skill.why_en: "I love this look, make my stuff feel like it" is a real recurring need; this converts a vibe into deliverable palettes and parameters.
irenerachel-style-pack-skill.limit_zh: 色卡是硬交付，靠 generate_palette_cards.py 和 validate_palette_cards.py 两个 Python 脚本产出，缺依赖就得报阻塞。提取模式必须有真实参考图，产出全中文。 上游 SKILL.md 的 name 是中文「风格包」，装上后可能不被识别，改成 style-pack 更稳。
irenerachel-style-pack-skill.limit_en: Palette cards are a hard deliverable from two Python scripts (generate_palette_cards.py, validate_palette_cards.py); a missing dependency must be reported as a blocker. Extraction requires real reference images, and output is Chinese. Upstream's name field is Chinese, so the loader may not pick it up — rename it to style-pack.
irenerachel-style-pack-skill.title_en: Turns "I love this look" into ten labeled colors

op7418-guizang-sports-skill.title_zh: 读懂运动手表导出的轨迹数据
op7418-guizang-sports-skill.tagline_zh: 手表导出一堆 FIT/KML 文件，多数人看不懂也懒得看。它把功率、心率、爬升、配速逐段拆开，还出可视化路书。
op7418-guizang-sports-skill.tagline_en: Analyzes cycling, running and hiking FIT/KML tracks — power, heart rate, elevation and pacing broken down segment by segment, with visual route reports.
op7418-guizang-sports-skill.why_zh: 把一墙传感器读数翻译成「这趟骑得怎么样」，骑行跑步徒步都能用。
op7418-guizang-sports-skill.why_en: Most people never decode their watch exports; this translates a wall of sensor data into "how was that ride, really".
op7418-guizang-sports-skill.limit_zh: 只吃 FIT/KML，纯几何 KML 连时长、配速、停顿都不推。要 Node 跑 npm ci，报告页固定在本机 5174 端口，远程或云端浏览器够不着就只剩文字报告。也不给 FTP、心率区间、VO₂max。
op7418-guizang-sports-skill.limit_en: FIT/KML only, and a geometry-only KML yields no duration, pace or pauses. Needs Node and npm ci in a writable skill dir; the report page is pinned to localhost:5174, so remote agents get text only. It won't invent FTP, HR zones or VO2max.
op7418-guizang-sports-skill.title_en: Turns a FIT file into how the ride went

joeseesun-qiaomu-learning.title_zh: 用一问一答逼你自己想明白
joeseesun-qiaomu-learning.tagline_zh: AI 直接给答案，学的时候最爽、也最没用。丢一份教材、截图或一道题给它，它一次只问一个问题，带你自己推出来。
joeseesun-qiaomu-learning.tagline_en: Turns textbooks, screenshots, PDFs, notes or a single problem into a question-by-question derivation — one question at a time, making you reason it out instead of handing over answers.
joeseesun-qiaomu-learning.why_zh: AI 毁掉学习的最快方式就是给答案；「一次只问一个」这条硬约束正是解药。乔木出品。
joeseesun-qiaomu-learning.why_en: The fastest way AI ruins learning is handing over answers; the one-question-at-a-time constraint is exactly the antidote.
joeseesun-qiaomu-learning.limit_zh: 得你点名要苏格拉底式、一次一问才触发，你说「直接告诉我」它立刻退出。宽泛主题固定列 12 个关键词，写明是硬契约。配图靠 Codex 内置生图，没有就退回 ASCII 和坐标草图。
joeseesun-qiaomu-learning.limit_en: Only triggers when you explicitly ask for Socratic one-question-at-a-time tutoring, and exits the moment you say "just tell me". Broad topics always get exactly 12 keywords, a declared hard contract. Visuals need Codex image generation.
joeseesun-qiaomu-learning.title_en: The tutor that refuses to give you the answer

leonxlnx-unlazy.title_zh: 逼 agent 干完重活别糊弄
leonxlnx-unlazy.tagline_zh: 长任务做到一半开始偷懒、「差不多就这样吧」是通病。深度树把任务分层拆开，每层必须做完才准往上收。
leonxlnx-unlazy.tagline_en: An anti-laziness discipline for substantial work — the Depth Tree method splits a task into layers, each of which must be finished before rolling up. No more "good enough, I guess".
leonxlnx-unlazy.why_zh: 把「分层且必须完成」变成硬纪律，比反复叮嘱它认真干有效得多。
leonxlnx-unlazy.why_en: Agents start cutting corners mid-task; enforcing layered completion beats repeatedly telling them to try harder.
leonxlnx-unlazy.limit_zh: 闸门校验要 Node 跑 scripts/gate-check.mjs；真把话说死的 Stop 钩子只在 Claude Code 有，还必须先问你才装。作者自己划线：闲聊、一行改动、半小时以内的活别用；编排模式要开得出子 agent。
leonxlnx-unlazy.limit_en: Gate checks run node scripts/gate-check.mjs. The Stop hook that blocks an early finish is Claude Code only and must be offered, never installed silently. The author excludes chat, trivial edits and under-30-minute work.
leonxlnx-unlazy.title_en: Stops the agent from settling for "good enough"

liamgvchi-gc-minimal-zine-poster.title_zh: 纸感诗性海报生成器，留白与单色点睛
liamgvchi-gc-minimal-zine-poster.tagline_zh: 大留白、一处拼贴、一个色彩重音
liamgvchi-gc-minimal-zine-poster.tagline_en: Hand it a sentence, an article, a mood or a photo and get a paper-textured minimal zine poster — vast negative space, one small collage anchor, experimental typography, a single clear color accent.
liamgvchi-gc-minimal-zine-poster.why_zh: 卖的是克制。带自测集，作者在维护风格一致性。
liamgvchi-gc-minimal-zine-poster.why_en: Rare in that what it sells is restraint — the hardest thing for a prompt to reproduce reliably. It ships an eval set, so the author is actually maintaining that consistency.
liamgvchi-gc-minimal-zine-poster.limit_zh: 只出竖版纸感海报。字必须短，长文案会写糊。
liamgvchi-gc-minimal-zine-poster.limit_en: Needs a built-in image tool, fed by referenced_image_paths or at most five in-session images. One form only: vertical, paper-textured, heavy negative space. Keep poster text short — image models garble long copy. On a fidelity miss it regenerates once, then says outright that it failed.
liamgvchi-gc-minimal-zine-poster.title_en: Poetic paper-texture poster maker with bold whitespace

openai-skills.tagline_zh: OpenAI 官方维护的 Codex 技能目录,44 件一次备齐——生态另一半的入口,以前我们只盯 Claude 这边,这是补上的那块。
openai-skills.tagline_en: OpenAI's own Codex skills catalog — 44 skills in one place. The other half of the ecosystem, and the entrance we'd been missing.
openai-skills.why_zh: 官方目录的价值在权威和维护:格式最标准、跟着 Codex 一起更新;想搞清楚 skill 该怎么写,先翻这本。
openai-skills.why_en: An official catalog earns its place through authority and upkeep — canonical format, updated alongside Codex itself.

helloianneo-ian-xiaohei-illustrations-ia.title_zh: 给中文文章画手绘感解释图
helloianneo-ian-xiaohei-illustrations-ia.tagline_zh: 写完文章配图最头疼：截图太丑、AI 插画太飘。它专画流程、结构、隐喻——16:9 白底手绘，少量红橙蓝批注。
helloianneo-ian-xiaohei-illustrations-ia.tagline_en: Ian-style illustrations for Chinese article bodies — 16:9 hand-drawn on white with sparse red-orange-blue annotations, built for processes, structures, metaphors and arguments.
helloianneo-ian-xiaohei-illustrations-ia.why_zh: 「单一明确风格」的典范：不给你一堆选项，一种腔调做到底，所以全篇视觉统一。
helloianneo-ian-xiaohei-illustrations-ia.why_en: A model of committing to one look: no menu of options, one voice held all the way through, which is why a whole article stays visually coherent.
helloianneo-ian-xiaohei-illustrations-ia.limit_zh: 出图靠宿主内置的 image_gen，没这条能力就画不了。风格锁死 16:9、纯白底、小黑当主体，不给第二种选。图上中文批注由模型写，正文把错字严重列进重生成条件。
helloianneo-ian-xiaohei-illustrations-ia.limit_en: Rendering needs the host's built-in `image_gen`. The look is locked: 16:9, white ground, Xiaohei as the actor, no alternatives. The Chinese annotations are drawn by the model, and its QA list makes bad characters grounds for a re-roll.
helloianneo-ian-xiaohei-illustrations-ia.title_en: Article diagrams that look like one hand drew them

ningzimu-codex-ppt-skill-codex-ppt.title_zh: 把文章变成视觉统一的图片式 PPT
ningzimu-codex-ppt-skill-codex-ppt.tagline_zh: 讲稿有了、排版要命。它逐页出图，整套风格一以贯之——适合那种「好看比可编辑更要紧」的场合，比如路演和分享会。
