qian-gugugaga-character_skill_producer.why_en: The stated distinction: capture HOW she behaves, not WHAT she said — tags are for humans, behaviour rules are for the agent to run. Anything it can't ground stays a declared boundary.
qian-gugugaga-character_skill_producer.limit_en: Needs Python and runs highest-fidelity mode only, which burns tokens. Zhihu, WeChat articles and Baidu Baike are blacklisted as sources. Every generated pack stamps a data cutoff date and needs a rerun when the work updates.
qian-gugugaga-character_skill_producer.cover_note: 托管的是 GitHub 预览卡（1200×600/630），不上卡

flowful-ai-cad-skill.title_zh: 动一行几何代码之前先去查真实尺寸的建模台
flowful-ai-cad-skill.tagline_zh: 用 CadQuery 分三阶段建模，每阶段渲图给你看、等你反馈再往下，最后出 STL 和打印参数建议。
flowful-ai-cad-skill.why_zh: 接现实产品的尺寸一律去查、交叉两个来源：差一两毫米，这个零件就废了。
flowful-ai-cad-skill.limit_zh: CadQuery 只支持 Python 3.10–3.12，OCC 内核装不上得改走 conda；面向 FDM 功能件，不做渲染、雕刻和游戏资产，也不改你手里已有的 STL。
flowful-ai-cad-skill.title_en: It searches for real dimensions before writing a line of geometry
flowful-ai-cad-skill.tagline_en: Builds parametric CadQuery models in three phases, rendering a preview and waiting for your feedback at each one, and finishes with an STL plus print recommendations.
flowful-ai-cad-skill.why_en: For anything that has to fit a real product it searches for the spec and cross-references two sources, because even 1-2mm off makes the part unusable. And it refuses to disappear and come back with a finished model.
flowful-ai-cad-skill.limit_en: CadQuery needs Python 3.10-3.12; if the OCC kernel won't build you're on conda. Aimed at functional FDM parts — not rendering, sculpting, game assets, or editing an STL you already have.

serhiikorniienko-bullshit-detector-bulls.title_zh: 打叉之前必须先替对方辩护一轮的查证器
serhiikorniienko-bullshit-detector-bulls.tagline_zh: 把视频、文章、推文或 PDF 拆成一条条主张，逐条联网核对，出一张带逐条判定和 0–10 分的报告卡。
serhiikorniienko-bullshit-detector-bulls.why_zh: 快速模式只砍广度、绝不砍深度：仓促下的冤枉，仍然是冤枉。
serhiikorniienko-bullshit-detector-bulls.limit_zh: 全量模式很慢很费 token，作者自己测过 35 次跑，第一次调工具前的纯思考能占掉 15%；必须能联网搜索，断网时结论不可用；报告是英文体例；它给证据链和分数，不是权威裁定。
serhiikorniienko-bullshit-detector-bulls.title_en: It has to steelman a claim before it's allowed to reject it
serhiikorniienko-bullshit-detector-bulls.tagline_en: Extracts the discrete claims from a video, article, tweet or PDF, verifies each against independent sources, and produces a report card with per-claim verdicts and an overall BS score.
serhiikorniienko-bullshit-detector-bulls.why_en: Quick mode cuts breadth, never depth — because a fast false accusation is still a false accusation, and the steelman before any ❌ survives even the fastest run.
serhiikorniienko-bullshit-detector-bulls.limit_en: Full mode is slow and token-heavy; the author instrumented 35 runs and found 15% of all thinking happens before the first tool call. Needs live web search — offline verdicts are unusable. Reports are in English. It gives an evidence trail and a score, not a ruling.

xbuilderlab-cheat-on-money-money-find.title_zh: 从招聘和采购信号反推出一份带推理链的副业清单
xbuilderlab-cheat-on-money-money-find.tagline_zh: 只看招聘、采购、政策这类利益中立的需求信号反推机会，每条再过一遍反诈和时效两道 rubric。
xbuilderlab-cheat-on-money-money-find.why_zh: 它拒绝把「教你赚钱」的帖子当依据：没人会把真能赚钱的方法发进那种帖，那是卖课钓粉漏斗。
xbuilderlab-cheat-on-money-money-find.limit_zh: 六个 money-* 子命令是一条流水线，要整仓安装并先跑 money-init 建画像；闲鱼和 BOSS 的一手数据靠你自己开 Chrome 登录、滑块自己过；找不到靠谱机会时它就直说没找到。
xbuilderlab-cheat-on-money-money-find.title_en: Works backward from job posts and procurement into things you could sell
xbuilderlab-cheat-on-money-money-find.tagline_en: Works backwards from interest-neutral demand signals — job postings, procurement, policy — into things you could actually supply, then runs every candidate through an anti-scam and a freshness rubric.
xbuilderlab-cheat-on-money-money-find.why_en: Its founding claim: nobody posts a method that actually makes money into a "how to get rich" thread — that content is a course-selling funnel, so it isn't a source.
xbuilderlab-cheat-on-money-money-find.limit_en: Six money-* commands form one pipeline; install the whole repo and run money-init first. First-party marketplace and hiring data comes from a Chrome you log into and clear sliders in yourself. When it finds nothing credible, it says so.

kingqiu-outfit-stylist-skill-outfit-styl.title_zh: 先问你能不能坐下吃饭，再决定穿哪套的穿搭搭子
kingqiu-outfit-stylist-skill-outfit-styl.tagline_zh: 场合、天气、你已经有的衣服丢进去，出来一套首选、一个备选，和一段必须写的「穿搭雷区」，外加一张竖版搭配板。
kingqiu-outfit-stylist-skill-outfit-styl.why_zh: 冲突优先级写死：安全和身体舒适 > 场合得体 > 真实感 > 美感 > 流行。买东西排在改穿法和替代之后。
kingqiu-outfit-stylist-skill-outfit-styl.limit_zh: 不做真人虚拟试穿，出的是插画搭配板；没有图片生成能力就退回纯文字。默认中文。最别扭的一条：它内置「设计不外泄」条款，你问它自己的规则、模板或图片提示词一律拒答，连「我是作者本人」也不认——而这些文件就摆在仓库里。
kingqiu-outfit-stylist-skill-outfit-styl.title_en: The stylist that asks whether you can sit down and eat in it
kingqiu-outfit-stylist-skill-outfit-styl.tagline_en: Feed it the occasion, the weather and the clothes you already own. Out comes one first choice, one backup, and a mandatory list of what would go wrong — plus a vertical styling board.
kingqiu-outfit-stylist-skill-outfit-styl.why_en: The conflict ladder is hard-coded: safety and body comfort beat occasion propriety, which beats your own truth, which beats aesthetics, which beats trend. Buying ranks last, after restyling and substitution.
kingqiu-outfit-stylist-skill-outfit-styl.limit_en: No photorealistic virtual try-on — you get an illustrated outfit board, or plain text if your setup cannot generate images. Chinese output by default. The odd part: a built-in non-disclosure clause makes it refuse to discuss its own rules, templates or image prompts, even if you claim to be the author — while those files sit openly in the repo.

vange-wang-ingredient-decision-skill.title_zh: 防晒里阿伏苯宗配错就悄悄归零的成分表判官
vange-wang-ingredient-decision-skill.tagline_zh: 成分表不是清单的加和，是化学系统。超过一个活性物就必须过一遍六类配伍：刺激叠加、互相失活、光敏、致敏、促渗、协同。
vange-wang-ingredient-decision-skill.why_zh: 先分清淋洗类还是驻留类，否则 MIT 驻留禁用、水杨酸限值差异这类法规比对根本不会触发。
vange-wang-ingredient-decision-skill.limit_zh: 中国大陆法规口径（《化妆品安全技术规范》/IECIC），欧美产品限值要另判。只看成分表不看浓度——绝大多数配方不公布浓度，它只能按排位推。判定档位只有安全/注意/谨慎三档，不给绝对结论，也不看皮肤病。库外成分要联网检索。
vange-wang-ingredient-decision-skill.title_en: The ingredient-list judge that catches sunscreen quietly dropping to zero
vange-wang-ingredient-decision-skill.tagline_en: An ingredient list is a chemical system, not a sum of items. Any formula with more than one active must be run through six interaction mechanisms: irritation stacking, mutual deactivation, photosensitivity, preservative sensitisation, penetration amplification, and genuine synergy.
vange-wang-ingredient-decision-skill.why_en: It settles rinse-off versus leave-on first, because otherwise the regulatory checks that matter — MIT banned in leave-on products, different salicylic acid caps — never fire at all.
vange-wang-ingredient-decision-skill.limit_en: Built on mainland China regulation (Safety and Technical Standards for Cosmetics, IECIC); EU and US limits need separate judgement. It reads the list, not the concentrations — almost no brand publishes those, so it can only infer from ordering. Verdicts come in three bands only, never absolutes, and it will not read a skin condition. Ingredients outside its bundled library need a web lookup.

hermess-skincare-product-selector.title_zh: 备案号没查到就不给最终结论的护肤选品官
hermess-skincare-product-selector.tagline_zh: 二选一、多候选排序、按需挑选、成分表审查。先拿备案号去 NMPA 查现行配方，再用官方渠道核价，最后给一句买或不买。
hermess-skincare-product-selector.why_zh: 大陆产品 0.1% 以下、美国 1% 以下的成分可以不按顺序排——数位次前先分清是哪个市场。
hermess-skincare-product-selector.limit_zh: SKILL.md 把脚本路径写成了作者本人的 /Users/caifeiya/…，得自己换成你的 skill 目录。抓不到页面时它会老实标「受阻」并让你用 Chrome 自己打开，明确拒绝绕验证码——也就是说不少时候要你手动补证据或拍包装照。价格只认官方旗舰和大平台。
hermess-skincare-product-selector.title_en: The skincare picker that refuses a verdict without a filing number
hermess-skincare-product-selector.tagline_en: Four modes: A-versus-B, ranking a shortlist, building a pool from your skin and budget, or auditing one ingredient list. It pulls the current formula from the NMPA filing, prices it from official channels, then commits to buy or skip.
hermess-skincare-product-selector.why_en: In mainland China anything at or below 0.1% may be listed out of order; in the US the cutoff is 1%. So it establishes which market version you hold before it reads anything into ingredient position.
hermess-skincare-product-selector.limit_en: SKILL.md hard-codes the author's own /Users/caifeiya/… script paths — swap in your skill directory. When a page blocks it, it labels the source blocked and asks you to open it in Chrome yourself; it explicitly refuses to defeat CAPTCHAs, which means you will often be supplying screenshots or packaging photos. Price evidence is limited to official stores and major platforms.

yunpeng192-legal-language-bridge.title_zh: 把吵架说成法言法语，把判决书说回人话
yunpeng192-legal-language-bridge.tagline_zh: 你说「公司无故辞退我」，它输出能提交的仲裁申诉文本，附证据清单、维权路径和赔偿估算。覆盖劳动、租房、预付卡等 15 类。
yunpeng192-legal-language-bridge.why_zh: 误区表逐条对撞常识：定金不退订金可退，食品假货是退一赔十，2N 和 N 不能同时主张。
yunpeng192-legal-language-bridge.limit_zh: 中国大陆法律，条文和赔偿标准会随司法解释变动，正文明写不构成法律意见、不替代律师。赔偿计算器只给区间，各省的一次性伤残就业补助金标准要你自己查。合同逐条解读这一块和在架的 AnythingButLaw 有重叠。
yunpeng192-legal-language-bridge.title_en: Everyday words into legal language, legalese back to plain.
yunpeng192-legal-language-bridge.tagline_en: Say "my company fired me for no reason" and it hands back a filable arbitration statement, plus the evidence you need to keep, the route to take, and a compensation range. Fifteen domains, from labour to tenancy to prepaid cards that vanished.
yunpeng192-legal-language-bridge.why_en: Its misconception table collides with common sense line by line: one kind of deposit is forfeit and the other refundable, counterfeit food pays ten times over, and you cannot claim both severance and the double-damages figure.
yunpeng192-legal-language-bridge.limit_en: Mainland Chinese law only, and the statutes and compensation standards shift with judicial interpretation — the skill states outright that it is not legal advice and no substitute for a lawyer. The calculator gives ranges; province-specific disability employment subsidies you look up yourself. Its clause-by-clause contract reading overlaps with AnythingButLaw, already on the shelf.
yunpeng192-legal-language-bridge._无封面原因: 全仓 0 张图片。产出物是维权文书和「定金/订金」的算钱结论（内容/判断），不做 ours。
yunpeng192-legal-language-bridge.cover_note: 托管的是 GitHub 预览卡（1200×600/630），不上卡

senzhang88-socialist-workers-power-work-.title_zh: 门禁被关了也让你去打卡，被拦就报警拿回执
senzhang88-socialist-workers-power-work-.tagline_zh: 公司停你岗、降你薪、关你门禁，它不劝你忍。今天去打卡留痕，本周寄出恢复劳动条件通知书，再按 2N 而不是 N 算钱。
senzhang88-socialist-workers-power-work-.why_zh: 给建议前先查判例的胜诉与败诉模式：你没满足的列进补证据清单，你踩了的先改。录音只认你自己在场的那种。
senzhang88-socialist-workers-power-work-.limit_zh: 只做上海——社平工资、三倍封顶、各区仲裁委电话、医疗期标准全是上海口径，外地得自己换数。数据标注 2025–2026，政策年度一换就要核。它站员工这边，不给公司合规建议。和在架 arb-skill 在「辞退后算钱」这段重叠，它更早一步，从软裁员开始。
senzhang88-socialist-workers-power-work-.title_en: It tells you to go badge in even after they killed your access, and to call the police if you are blocked
senzhang88-socialist-workers-power-work-.tagline_en: When the company benches you, cuts your pay and shuts off your badge, this does not tell you to sit tight. Clock in today for the record, send the formal demand letter this week, then compute the money at double severance rather than single.
senzhang88-socialist-workers-power-work-.why_en: Before advising, it checks the win and loss patterns in comparable rulings: what you have not satisfied becomes your evidence to-do list, and what you have tripped over gets corrected first. It only counts recordings of conversations you were part of.
senzhang88-socialist-workers-power-work-.limit_en: Shanghai only — the average-wage base, the triple-wage cap, the district arbitration phone numbers and the medical-leave standards are all local, so elsewhere you substitute your own numbers. Data is marked 2025–2026 and needs rechecking each policy year. It argues for the employee and offers employers nothing. Its post-dismissal math overlaps with arb-skill on the shelf; this one starts earlier, at the quiet squeeze-out.

lishuangqiang-backend-agent-resume-scout.title_zh: 不许把「建议改造」写成「已完成」的简历项目侦察兵
lishuangqiang-backend-agent-resume-scout.tagline_zh: 它不替你写简历。它从 GitHub 挑一个你真该动手改的业务系统，clone 到本地读源码，再告诉你哪几条能写进简历。
lishuangqiang-backend-agent-resume-scout.why_zh: star 过 1k 就不再因更高而加分；本地 clone 不成功、源码里抠不出 5 个证据点的一律淘汰。
lishuangqiang-backend-agent-resume-scout.limit_zh: 只服务后端（Java/Spring、分布式）和业务型 AI Agent 两个方向，默认排除 IoT 与嵌入式；前端、算法、非技术岗用不上。它交的不是文档而是工程作业——推荐的项目你得真去改，是几周的活。必须联网、必须 git clone，你不先选一种推荐模式它就不动。
lishuangqiang-backend-agent-resume-scout.title_en: The resume project scout that will not let a plan be written up as done
lishuangqiang-backend-agent-resume-scout.tagline_en: It does not write your resume. It goes out to GitHub, finds one complete business system worth your actually modifying, clones it locally to read the source, then tells you which bullets you can already claim and which you have to build first.
lishuangqiang-backend-agent-resume-scout.why_en: Past a thousand stars, more stars earn nothing extra. Any candidate it cannot clone locally, or from whose source it cannot extract five concrete evidence points, is eliminated outright.
lishuangqiang-backend-agent-resume-scout.limit_en: Scoped to backend work (Java/Spring, distributed systems) and business-grade AI agents, with IoT and embedded excluded by default — no use for frontend, algorithms or non-technical roles. What it delivers is homework, not a document: the project it picks is weeks of real work. It needs the network, needs git clone, and refuses to start until you pick one of its recommendation modes.

sunxin-ai-crucial-conversations.title_zh: 说完数字就闭嘴，别自己补一句「不行也没关系」
sunxin-ai-crucial-conversations.tagline_zh: 提加薪、提离职、给下属负反馈、跟父母谈催婚、跟伴侣分家务。没谈的替你排练，谈崩的替你复盘，写好没敢发的那段替你改两版。
sunxin-ai-crucial-conversations.why_zh: 改写只给两版并各标代价，逼你想清要的是一个态度还是一个日期——前者对方给不了也不想给。
sunxin-ai-crucial-conversations.limit_zh: 只给文字，不代发。遇到家暴、人身威胁、自伤，它明确不套用自己那套工具（前提是双方安全对等，此处不成立），先给安全预案和 12338，并告诉你对方停不停手不取决于你的措辞。劳动仲裁只帮你准备怎么说。和在架的非暴力沟通教练在「怎么开口」上有交集。
sunxin-ai-crucial-conversations.title_en: Say the number, then stop talking — do not add "of course it's fine if you can't"
sunxin-ai-crucial-conversations.tagline_en: Asking for a raise, resigning, delivering bad feedback, fending off parents about marriage, splitting housework. It rehearses the conversation you have not had, autopsies the one that blew up, and rewrites the message you drafted but could not send.
sunxin-ai-crucial-conversations.why_en: Rewrites always come in two versions with the cost of each spelled out, which forces you to decide whether you want an attitude or a date — because the first is something the other person cannot and will not give.
sunxin-ai-crucial-conversations.limit_en: Text only; it never sends anything for you. For domestic violence, threats or self-harm it explicitly refuses to apply its own toolkit — those tools assume two parties are safe and equal — and instead gives a safety plan, a hotline, and the line that whether the other person stops is not decided by your wording. For arbitration it only helps you prepare what to say. Overlaps with the nonviolent-communication coach already on the shelf.

bettermen-car-repair-skill-car-repair.title_zh: 结算单上要写一行「旧件归还」的汽修防坑参谋
bettermen-car-repair-skill-car-repair.tagline_zh: 报价拆成配件费和工时费分开看，先问能不能修再谈总成更换，旧件必须带走。每条诊断都标自查、到店，还是立即停驶。
bettermen-car-repair-skill-car-repair.why_zh: 敲击金属声加机油灯直接判立即停驶，继续开会拉缸；反复打火每次别超 10 秒、间隔至少 30 秒。
bettermen-car-repair-skill-car-repair.limit_zh: 价格区间是中国大陆普通合资/国产车口径，豪华车上浮 50%–150%，而且没标采集日期，会过时。自查方法限于车主无工具能做的，需要举升机和诊断仪的它只让你去店里。不替代专业维修，高压电、气囊、刹车总泵一律劝你别碰。
bettermen-car-repair-skill-car-repair.title_en: The repair-shop chaperone that makes you write "old parts returned" on the invoice
bettermen-car-repair-skill-car-repair.tagline_en: Split the quote into parts and labour and read them separately, ask whether it can be repaired before you accept a whole-assembly swap, and take the removed parts home with you. Every diagnosis is tagged: check it yourself, get to a shop soon, or stop driving now.
bettermen-car-repair-skill-car-repair.why_en: A metallic knock plus the oil light means stop driving immediately — keep going and you scuff the cylinder. And when it will not start: never crank longer than ten seconds, wait at least thirty between tries.
bettermen-car-repair-skill-car-repair.limit_en: Price bands are for ordinary joint-venture and domestic cars in mainland China, with luxury marques running 50–150% higher, and no capture date is given, so they will drift. Self-checks are limited to what an owner can do without tools; anything needing a lift or a scanner is sent straight to a shop. It is not a substitute for a mechanic and tells you to keep away from high-voltage packs, airbags and brake master cylinders.

johnsmithca-sta-health-report-trend-anal.title_zh: 把历年体检报告拉成指标曲线，出报告加一张离线工作台
johnsmithca-sta-health-report-trend-anal.tagline_zh: 把历年体检报告（电子 PDF、扫描件、手机拍的照片）解析成指标时间序列，标出异常和趋好趋坏，出报告加一张离线工作台。
johnsmithca-sta-health-report-trend-anal.why_zh: OCR 抠出来的数不许参与涨跌判定；异常按当年报告自带的参考范围判，试剂一换上下限就变了。
johnsmithca-sta-health-report-trend-anal.limit_zh: 电子版解析的列坐标是照某一家体检机构的版式实测出来的，换机构要先自己确认列边界。照片版靠 macOS Vision OCR，非 Mac 走不了这条路，而且照片里的中文识别率不到一半。给的是分层建议和就医指征，不给诊断也不给药。
johnsmithca-sta-health-report-trend-anal.title_en: Years of checkup PDFs into one indicator trend, plus an offline dashboard
johnsmithca-sta-health-report-trend-anal.tagline_en: It parses years of health checkup reports — text PDFs, scans, even phone photos — into one indicator time series, flags what is abnormal, what moved significantly, and which way it is heading, then ships a report and an offline dashboard.
johnsmithca-sta-health-report-trend-anal.why_en: Numbers scraped by OCR are barred from any change verdict, and abnormality is judged against the range printed on that year's own report — swap the reagent and the bounds move.
johnsmithca-sta-health-report-trend-anal.limit_en: The column coordinates for text PDFs were measured against one particular clinic's layout, so a different provider means confirming the boundaries yourself first. The photo path runs on macOS Vision OCR, which rules out non-Mac machines, and Chinese recognition on photos lands under fifty percent. You get tiered lifestyle guidance and referral thresholds — no diagnosis, no drugs.

gnipbao-codex-whiteboard-video-skill.title_zh: 线稿只准本地模型抽、不许 AI 生成的白板手绘视频
gnipbao-codex-whiteboard-video-skill.tagline_zh: 上传一张照片，它先用本地神经网络抽出线稿，再一笔一笔画出来、配一只跟着笔尖走的手。
gnipbao-codex-whiteboard-video-skill.why_zh: 两个本地模型一个都没装时，它规定必须直接失败 —— 不许用边缘检测糊一版弱线稿交差。
gnipbao-codex-whiteboard-video-skill.limit_zh: 它只是适配层：引擎要 pip 装另一个仓库，Informative Drawings 或 Anime2Sketch 至少装一个并设环境变量，而模型的安装指南在引擎仓库里、不在这一件。一个都没装时它直接失败，不给降级方案。
gnipbao-codex-whiteboard-video-skill.title_en: Refuses to let an image model draw the line art
gnipbao-codex-whiteboard-video-skill.tagline_en: Hand it a photo and it pulls the line art with a local neural model, then draws it stroke by stroke with a hand trailing the pen tip — instead of asking an image model for something that merely looks hand-drawn.
gnipbao-codex-whiteboard-video-skill.why_en: With neither local model installed it is required to fail outright — no edge-detection fallback, because a weak outline that looks finished is worse than an error.
gnipbao-codex-whiteboard-video-skill.limit_en: It is only an adapter. The engine is a separate pip install, you must set up Informative Drawings or Anime2Sketch yourself and point env vars at it, and the model setup guide lives in the engine repo rather than here. With neither installed, extract-lineart and render-photo fail outright.

choism4-macos-disk-cleanup.title_zh: 删缓存前先查这个 App 在不在跑的 Mac 清理工
choism4-macos-disk-cleanup.tagline_zh: 扫出 Mac 上到底是什么占了盘，列成表让你逐项点头，再动手删。九条铁规写在最前面，第一条就是不给看大小不许删。
choism4-macos-disk-cleanup.why_zh: 清理脚本最常见的事故是删了正在跑的 App 的缓存。它把 pgrep 检查写成硬规则。
choism4-macos-disk-cleanup.limit_zh: 只管 macOS，Windows 用不上。它不卸载应用，遇到这类请求会让你去用 AppCleaner。APFS 快照占的空间它只报告不清理——那是 Time Machine 管的，它明说自己不碰。iCloud 存储方案、单个项目内的垃圾文件都不在范围内。
choism4-macos-disk-cleanup.title_en: A Mac cleanup that runs pgrep before it touches a cache
choism4-macos-disk-cleanup.tagline_en: Finds what is actually eating your disk, puts it in a table, and waits for you to approve each line. Nine iron rules up front; rule one is no deletion before you see sizes.
choism4-macos-disk-cleanup.why_en: The classic cleanup accident is wiping the cache of an app that is still running. Here the pgrep check is a hard rule, not advice.
choism4-macos-disk-cleanup.limit_en: macOS only. It will not uninstall apps — it points you at AppCleaner instead. APFS snapshots get reported, never deleted, because Time Machine owns them. iCloud plans and project-level junk are both out of scope.

fabianocruz-assistente-compras-ifood-ass.title_zh: 装满购物车但绝不替你按下单键的超市采买助手
fabianocruz-assistente-compras-ifood-ass.tagline_zh: 在 iFood 等巴西线上超市配菜、比价、按周补货，记住你的牌子偏好和忌口，下单那一步永远留给你。
fabianocruz-assistente-compras-ifood-ass.why_zh: 三条基本原则第一条就是「绝不点结算或付款，那是用户做的事」，替你花钱的那一步它自己封死了。
fabianocruz-assistente-compras-ifood-ass.limit_zh: 只覆盖巴西线上超市，别国用不了，正文是葡萄牙语。靠浏览器自动化跑，网站改版会失效。你的偏好、住址、历史存在自己 workspace 的 user_state.json 里，不进 skill——换机器要自己带走。
fabianocruz-assistente-compras-ifood-ass.title_en: A grocery agent that fills the cart and never presses pay
fabianocruz-assistente-compras-ifood-ass.tagline_en: Builds carts on iFood Mercado and other Brazilian online supermarkets, compares unit prices, plans the week, and remembers your brands and dietary limits. Checkout stays yours.
fabianocruz-assistente-compras-ifood-ass.why_en: Its first standing rule is never click finalize or pay — the user does that. The step that spends your money is the one it refuses to take.
fabianocruz-assistente-compras-ifood-ass.limit_en: Brazilian online supermarkets only; the skill body is in Portuguese. It drives a real browser, so a site redesign breaks it. Your preferences, address and history live in a user_state.json in your own workspace, never inside the skill — which also means you carry it between machines yourself.

francismiko-wechat-automation.title_zh: 写明 Cmd+N 会建新群、不是找旧会话的微信遥控
francismiko-wechat-automation.tagline_zh: 用辅助功能 API 操控 macOS 版微信收发消息、翻聊天记录，操作完自动切回原来的应用，不打断你手上的事。
francismiko-wechat-automation.why_zh: 踩坑表是实测的：Cmd+F 打开的是全局搜索、keystroke 打中文会乱码、不先移鼠标就滚会滚错窗口。
francismiko-wechat-automation.limit_zh: 只有 macOS 桌面版微信，手机和 Windows 都不行。要给终端和 claude 授辅助功能权限，还要 brew install cliclick。GUI 自动化天生不稳，作者要求关键步骤后截图核对状态。微信改界面就会失效。它是操作层工具，不替你判断该不该发那句话。
francismiko-wechat-automation.title_en: A WeChat remote that documents why Cmd+N creates a group instead of finding one
francismiko-wechat-automation.tagline_en: Drives the macOS WeChat desktop client through the accessibility API to send messages and read chat history, then switches back to whatever app you were in.
francismiko-wechat-automation.why_en: The gotcha table is measured, not guessed: Cmd+F opens global search, keystroke garbles Chinese, and scrolling without moving the mouse first scrolls the wrong window.
francismiko-wechat-automation.limit_en: macOS desktop WeChat only — no phone, no Windows. Needs accessibility permission for your terminal and for claude, plus brew install cliclick. GUI automation is inherently flaky, so it insists on a screenshot check after key steps. A WeChat UI change breaks it. It moves the mouse; it does not judge whether to send the message.
francismiko-wechat-automation._无封面原因: 作者没放图（仓库树 8 项，零图片文件）。**这件刻意不做自截图**：它遥控真实微信客户端，跑一遍会碰到真账号和真会话，任务书的「绝不用真实个人数据」在这里意味着根本不该跑。

geekjourneyx-travel-guidebook.title_zh: 从踩点笔记到排版成册，一趟生成旅行指南 PDF
geekjourneyx-travel-guidebook.tagline_zh: 把行程调研做成能打印的 PDF 路书：暖色纸底、衬线体、Tabler 图标和内联 SVG 装饰，靠排版撑设计感。
geekjourneyx-travel-guidebook.why_zh: 「零 AI 插图」是硬规则不是风格偏好——旅行册子最容易骗人的就是一张不存在的风景图。
geekjourneyx-travel-guidebook.limit_zh: 要 Node.js 和 Playwright 才能导 PDF，装环境有成本。深度调研阶段会并行开五个 agent，很吃 token。成品是印刷导向的长文档，不是手机上随时改的行程 App。只做排版和成书，订票订房都不管。
geekjourneyx-travel-guidebook.title_en: Turn scattered travel notes into a print-ready guidebook PDF
geekjourneyx-travel-guidebook.tagline_en: Turns trip research into a printable PDF guidebook — warm parchment ground, serif type, Tabler icons and inline SVG ornament. The design comes from typesetting, not from generated pictures.
geekjourneyx-travel-guidebook.why_en: Zero AI illustration is a hard rule rather than a taste preference. The easiest way for a travel book to lie is a landscape photo of a place that does not exist.
geekjourneyx-travel-guidebook.limit_en: Needs Node.js and Playwright to export the PDF. The research stage fans out five parallel agents and burns tokens. The output is a print-oriented document, not a phone itinerary you tweak on the road. It typesets and binds; it books nothing.

rimagination-bili-note.title_zh: 字幕太稀就不许写成完整笔记的 B 站视频提炼
rimagination-bili-note.tagline_zh: 把 B 站视频和图文动态变成可检索的 Markdown 笔记，优先取字幕，取不到再转写音频，要评论就抓评论并滤掉闲聊。
rimagination-bili-note.why_zh: 它先算字幕密度：字数偏少就判定信息在画面里，标记 needs_visual_review，拒绝拿稀字幕凑整。
rimagination-bili-note.limit_zh: 只认 B 站。网页 AI 字幕要 Chrome 加 web-access，Edge 和临时浏览器都不等价。付费内容要你自己是登录态。转写增强要装几个 G 的 Qwen3-ASR。关键帧要模型能看图，看不了它会明说只能给有限笔记。
rimagination-bili-note.title_en: A Bilibili note-taker that refuses to write full notes from thin subtitles
rimagination-bili-note.tagline_en: Turns Bilibili videos and article posts into searchable Markdown notes. Subtitles first, audio transcription as fallback, comments pulled and filtered when you want them.
rimagination-bili-note.why_en: It measures subtitle density first. When the word count is thin it concludes the content lives on screen, flags needs_visual_review, and will not pad a sparse transcript into a complete note.
rimagination-bili-note.limit_en: Bilibili only. The web AI-subtitle route needs Chrome plus web-access — Edge, a throwaway Playwright browser and a bare CDP port are explicitly not equivalent. Paid or login-gated videos need you already logged in. The transcription path pulls a multi-gigabyte Qwen3-ASR environment. Keyframe understanding needs a model that can see images; without one it says so.
rimagination-bili-note._无封面原因: 作者仓库里没有产出物样张（逐张开过：只有 assets/bili-note-logo.png，卡通电视机+笔记本配「Bili Note」字标，1844×569。纯 logo。

santiagomoneta-3d-printing-skills-klippe.title_zh: 动一个数之前先读回整份配置的 Klipper 参谋
santiagomoneta-3d-printing-skills-klippe.tagline_zh: 用 Moonraker 接管 Klipper 打印机：读改 printer.cfg、跑床网和 PID 校准、盯打印状态。
santiagomoneta-3d-printing-skills-klippe.why_zh: 它把配置连 include 的分文件一起抓全、解析成上下文再动手——改探针偏移不看运动学是要撞头的。
santiagomoneta-3d-printing-skills-klippe.limit_zh: 只认跑 Klipper + Moonraker 的机器，闭源固件（如原厂 Bambu）用不了，打印机要和你在同一个网里。它会写 printer.cfg 并重启固件，改坏了要你自己有备份。同仓另有一件 orca-slicer 管切片，两件是分开装的。校准动作要你人在机器边上看着。
santiagomoneta-3d-printing-skills-klippe.title_en: A Klipper adviser that reads the whole printer.cfg back before changing one number
santiagomoneta-3d-printing-skills-klippe.tagline_en: Takes over a Klipper printer through Moonraker: reads and edits printer.cfg, runs bed mesh and PID calibration, checks resonance and pressure advance, watches temperatures and print state.
santiagomoneta-3d-printing-skills-klippe.why_en: It pulls the config plus every included file, parses it into printer_context.json, and only then acts. Editing a probe offset without knowing the kinematics is how you crash a toolhead.
santiagomoneta-3d-printing-skills-klippe.limit_en: Only for machines running Klipper and Moonraker — closed firmware such as stock Bambu is out — and the printer must be on your network. It writes printer.cfg and restarts firmware, so keep your own backup. Slicing lives in a separate orca-slicer skill in the same repo. Calibration runs assume you are standing at the machine.

sjy051-music-composition.title_zh: 说平行五度不是不道德、只是一种声音的作曲参谋
sjy051-music-composition.tagline_zh: 和声、旋律、对位、配器、曲式和各语种流行乐的作曲工具箱，把「副歌感觉不够劲」这种模糊话拆成能动手改的具体选项。
sjy051-music-composition.why_zh: 它拒绝把技法讲成戒律：平行五度巴赫躲、德彪西用，先问你要哪种声音再给两到四个带取舍的方案。
sjy051-music-composition.limit_zh: 只管作曲和乐理，明说不碰 DAW 操作、MIDI 文件生成、混音母带、音色设计和打谱软件界面。它不产出音频也不产出 MIDI，给的是你能弹出来的具体指令。参考库很大，用之前要先读 references/00-navigation.md 挑文件，一次问太宽它会让你先收窄。
sjy051-music-composition.title_en: A composition adviser that says parallel fifths are a sound, not a sin
sjy051-music-composition.tagline_en: Harmony, melody, counterpoint, orchestration, form and genre convention across many traditions — and it turns a vague complaint like the chorus feels weak into concrete moves you can play.
sjy051-music-composition.why_en: It refuses to teach technique as commandment: Bach avoided parallel fifths, Debussy used them. It asks which sound you want, then offers two to four options with their trade-offs.
sjy051-music-composition.limit_en: Composition and theory only. It explicitly does not cover DAW operation, MIDI generation, mixing and mastering, sound design, or notation-software UI. It emits no audio and no MIDI — just instructions you can play. The reference library is large; start from references/00-navigation.md, and a question that would need five files gets narrowed first.
sjy051-music-composition._无封面原因: 作者仓库里唯一的产出物样张是 benchmarks/output/…_main_motif_sketch.svg（진양조 24 拍海琴主题动机草图，真产出物）——但它是**给深色底设计的**：坐标标签/周期标题/拍号的填充是 rgb(194,192,182)，对我们的浅色卡底 #f7f7f8 只有 1.70:1 对比（正文要 4.5），网格线是 rgba(222,220,209,.15) 几乎为 0。贴上去读者只会看到一串紫色音符浮在空白上，比无图更像坏了。benchmarks/charts/*.png 是「这个 skill 评测得分」的对比图，不是它的产出。

terancejiang-financial-report-minesweepe.title_zh: 信奉「财报是用来排除企业的」的 A 股排雷台
terancejiang-financial-report-minesweepe.tagline_zh: 输入股票代码，拉十年财务数据和审计意见，按七层二十八条规则逐条判 PASS/WARN/FAIL，最后给一个整体风险评级。
terancejiang-financial-report-minesweepe.why_zh: 它的核心立场写在最前面：财报是用来排除企业的，不是用来发现牛股的，有疑就杀——和选股工具正好反着来。
terancejiang-financial-report-minesweepe.limit_zh: 只做 A 股，港美股不覆盖。数据走 Tushare，要你自己有 token，接口额度按等级限。它算的是财务异常信号，不是造假认定，更不是投资建议。规则来自唐朝《手把手教你读财报》那套方法，认不认这套方法决定你认不认它的结论。年报 PDF 下载是可选步骤。
terancejiang-financial-report-minesweepe.title_en: An A-share filing screen built on the rule that reports are for ruling companies out
terancejiang-financial-report-minesweepe.tagline_en: Give it a ticker; it pulls ten years of financials and audit opinions, walks twenty-eight risk rules across seven layers with PASS/WARN/FAIL per rule, and ends on a single risk rating.
terancejiang-financial-report-minesweepe.why_en: Its stated core position is that financial reports exist to exclude companies, not to discover winners — when in doubt, kill it. That is the inverse of a stock picker.
terancejiang-financial-report-minesweepe.limit_en: A-shares only; no HK or US coverage. Data comes from Tushare and you supply the token, with quota by tier. It flags anomalies, not proven fraud, and it is not investment advice. The rule set comes from Tang Chao's book on reading financial statements, so whether you trust the output depends on whether you trust that method. Downloading the annual-report PDF is optional.
terancejiang-financial-report-minesweepe._无封面原因: 作者仓库里没有产出物样张（逐张开过：只有 assets/book-cover.png，350×350，是**第三方出版物的立体书封**——唐朝《手把手教你读财报》。登它等于在我们站上展示别人的书封美术，和之前那件 examples/ 里全是 1980 年代动画原片翻拍是同一类问题。

tonykoop-claude-skills-houseplant.title_zh: 在 Blender 里试剪过再对真盆景下刀的养护台
tonykoop-claude-skills-houseplant.tagline_zh: 用手机扫出盆景的三维分身，在里面把修剪和缠丝方案试完，选定的那版再动真剪刀，顺带管浇水、繁殖和花期记录。
tonykoop-claude-skills-houseplant.why_zh: 「剪之前先模拟」这句在别处只是说法，它真做了：分身、试剪、定版、再下刀，且明写哪些是模拟哪些是实测。
tonykoop-claude-skills-houseplant.limit_zh: 三维那条线要 Blender 和 MCP，只做 2D 也能用但招牌功能就没了。扫描要你自己拍多角度照片，至少一张里得有尺子之类的比例参照。记录默认落在 Obsidian 或表格里。它在一个塞了 45 件 skill 的大仓里，装的时候要挑准子目录。
tonykoop-claude-skills-houseplant.title_en: A bonsai bench that test-cuts in Blender before you touch the real tree
tonykoop-claude-skills-houseplant.tagline_en: Builds a 3D twin of your plant from phone captures, lets you try pruning and wire-training scenarios on it, and only then commits the version you picked to the physical tree — plus watering, propagation and bloom logs.
tonykoop-claude-skills-houseplant.why_en: Simulate before you cut is a slogan everywhere else. Here it is the actual pipeline — twin, try, commit, cut — and the output always states which parts were simulated and which were observed.
tonykoop-claude-skills-houseplant.limit_en: The 3D path needs Blender and its MCP; 2D-only works but loses the killer feature. Scanning is on you: multi-angle photos with a ruler or other scale reference in at least one shot. Records default to Obsidian or a spreadsheet, so you need that already. It lives inside a 45-skill mono-repo, so install the right subdirectory.
tonykoop-claude-skills-houseplant._无封面原因: 仓库有 18 张图，但**一张都不属于这件**：全在 docs/benchmarks/makerspace/（CNC 招牌、激光亚克力、等离子花架的基准测试）和 plugins/maker/skills/sheet-music/examples/（乐谱）下，而这件的 path 是 plugins/maker/skills/houseplant。单体仓库里别的 skill 的图，不能拿来当这件的封面。

truegrit16-snapsift-snapsift.title_zh: 「谁眨眼了」清晰度看不出来，靠眼神挑片的照片清道夫
truegrit16-snapsift-snapsift.tagline_zh: 一次旅行几千张，它按人脸的清晰度、睁眼、视线和表情挑该留哪几张，淘汰的一张都不删，全搬进 Archive。
truegrit16-snapsift-snapsift.why_zh: 作者实测：全局拉普拉斯方差把主人删掉的照片评得比留下的更「锐」，所以对焦只测脸那一块。
truegrit16-snapsift-snapsift.limit_zh: 要在本地装 mediapipe==0.10.14（作者点名这个版本），沙箱里长任务会被杀，几千张得分批续跑。夜景、篝火、烟火这类刻意暗的片子它会保护，但对纯风景的重复片下手偏狠。它最好的判断依赖人脸，没有人的照片只能退回技术指标。
truegrit16-snapsift-snapsift.title_en: The photo culler that judges eyes, not sharpness
truegrit16-snapsift-snapsift.tagline_en: Point it at a trip dump of thousands and it picks keepers by face sharpness, eyes-open, gaze and expression. Nothing is deleted — rejects move to Archive with a manifest.
truegrit16-snapsift-snapsift.why_en: The author measured it: global Laplacian variance scored the photos the owner had already deleted as sharper than the ones they kept. So focus is measured on the face crop only.
truegrit16-snapsift-snapsift.limit_en: Needs mediapipe==0.10.14 installed locally (the author pins that exact version), and long runs get killed in sandboxes, so thousands of frames need resumable batching. It protects deliberately dark frames — night, bonfire, fireworks — but culls redundant scenery hard. Its best judgment needs a face; photos with no people fall back to technical metrics.

slxslx0604-batch-photo-tag.title_zh: 一夹一张联系印相图，回一句编号把标签写进 IPTC
slxslx0604-batch-photo-tag.tagline_zh: 一夹一张联系印相图弹进 macOS 预览，你回一句「9 | h,红叶」这样的编号语法，标签就写进 IPTC 关键词。
slxslx0604-batch-photo-tag.why_zh: 它写明拼图不许用 Read 显示——Read 看到的图只有助手看得见，用户屏幕上什么都没有。
slxslx0604-batch-photo-tag.limit_zh: 只在 macOS 上跑（靠 open 弹预览、exiftool 写标），只处理 JPG。默认词表是作者自己那十五类题材，不合你的库就得先改。它只管题材这一个维度，地点标签要另找脚本。中断了要从当前那一夹重来。
slxslx0604-batch-photo-tag.title_en: One contact sheet, one line of codes, IPTC keywords written
slxslx0604-batch-photo-tag.tagline_en: One folder at a time, it renders a 6x6 contact sheet into macOS Preview; you reply with a compact code like "9 | h,autumn | 6,8: +5" and the tags go straight into IPTC keywords.
slxslx0604-batch-photo-tag.why_en: It spells out the trap: never render the contact sheet with the Read tool, because an image Read can see is an image the user cannot. It has to land in Preview.
slxslx0604-batch-photo-tag.limit_en: macOS only — it leans on `open` for Preview and exiftool for writing — and JPG only. The default vocabulary is the author's own fifteen subject categories, so an unusual library needs editing first. It tags subject matter only; location keywords need a separate script. Interrupt it and you redo the current folder.

teshenglee-photography-coach-skill-photo.title_zh: 修图步骤写成界面路径、控件、起始值和看什么算对
teshenglee-photography-coach-skill-photo.tagline_zh: 丢一张参考图或自己拍砸的片子，它先分开「读到的元数据」和「看出来的推测」，再问你用哪个 app 修图。
teshenglee-photography-coach-skill-photo.why_zh: 不问你用哪个 app 就不给步骤，那个工具里没有的控件也不许开——读到的元数据和看出来的推测分开写。
teshenglee-photography-coach-skill-photo.limit_zh: 它只给方向和起始值，不替你出图。GPS 默认只说到区域或地标一级，要精确坐标得你自己开口。截图和社交平台下载图它拒绝推断 EXIF。风格库里列的是摄影师和奖项的名字，不是能直接套的滤镜。
teshenglee-photography-coach-skill-photo.title_en: Edit steps as screen path, control, starting value, and what to look for
teshenglee-photography-coach-skill-photo.tagline_en: Hand it a reference shot or a photo that came out weak; it separates what it actually read from metadata from what it is only inferring, then asks whether you edit in Apple Photos or Lightroom before naming a single slider.
teshenglee-photography-coach-skill-photo.why_en: It won't name a slider before you say whether you edit in Apple Photos or Lightroom, and it may never prescribe a control the chosen tool does not have.
teshenglee-photography-coach-skill-photo.limit_en: It gives directions and starting values, never a finished file. GPS stays at area or landmark level unless you ask for precision. It refuses to infer EXIF from screenshots or social-media downloads. Its style library names photographers and awards as references, not as filters you can apply.

housq-astro-processing-astro-processing.title_zh: 退出码为 0 不算通过、要过肉眼验收的天文摄影后期台
housq-astro-processing-astro-processing.tagline_zh: 把望远镜拍的一堆 FITS 从校准、对齐到叠加导出走完一条流水线，Siril 和 PixInsight 一次只准用一个。
housq-astro-processing-astro-processing.why_zh: 它写明「退出码为 0 不够」——数据完整性、技术指标、肉眼验收三关都过了，这一步才算做完。
housq-astro-processing-astro-processing.limit_zh: 得你自己先装好 Siril（免费）或 PixInsight（付费），StarNet、GraXpert、RC-Astro 都是可选插件，缺了就走已记录的降级路线。默认只保证彩色/OSC 深空和彗星数据，单色窄带走的是「未验证」计划。
housq-astro-processing-astro-processing.title_en: The astro stacking desk where exit code 0 is not acceptance
housq-astro-processing-astro-processing.tagline_en: Takes a pile of FITS from a telescope through inspect, calibrate, register, integrate and export as one workflow, routing between Siril and PixInsight — one main backend per run, and switching needs fresh confirmation.
housq-astro-processing-astro-processing.why_en: It states the rule outright: a zero exit code is insufficient. A stage is done only when data integrity, technical acceptance and visual acceptance all pass.
housq-astro-processing-astro-processing.limit_en: You install Siril (free) or PixInsight (paid) yourself; StarNet, GraXpert and RC-Astro are optional stage processors and it falls back on recorded routes when they are missing. Colour-camera/OSC deep-sky and comet data are the validated path — mono LRGB and narrowband get an explicitly unvalidated adaptive plan. It never modifies, renames, moves or deletes your source data.

jasonbhorne-guitar-skill-guitar.title_zh: 只给和弦走向、绝不替你抄歌词的吉他谱生成器
jasonbhorne-guitar-skill-guitar.tagline_zh: 说一个歌名，它出一份坐下就能弹的谱：和弦图、带小节数的段落结构、前奏 riff 和 solo 的六线谱。
jasonbhorne-guitar-skill-guitar.why_zh: 谱里只有和弦走向、不含歌词——它让你自己从有授权的来源补上，并写明这些谱不许转发。
jasonbhorne-guitar-skill-guitar.limit_zh: 冷门曲目它会标 MEDIUM/LOW 置信度，让你自己对着录音核哪几段是猜的。和弦图靠随件 python 脚本渲染成 ASCII，没有五线谱也没有音频。谱固定存到 ~/Documents/Guitar/Songs 下。它给的是「大概是这样」，不是官方谱。
jasonbhorne-guitar-skill-guitar.title_en: The guitar chart builder that will not type out the lyrics
jasonbhorne-guitar-skill-guitar.tagline_en: Name a song and it produces a chart you can sit down and play: chord diagrams, an arrangement map with bar counts, tab for the intro riff and the solo, filed into your own repertoire library with an index.
jasonbhorne-guitar-skill-guitar.why_en: The chart carries the progression and no lyrics — it tells you to add those from a licensed source yourself, and asks you not to republish the charts.
jasonbhorne-guitar-skill-guitar.limit_en: For obscure songs it flags MEDIUM or LOW confidence and tells you which parts to check against the recording. Chord diagrams render as ASCII from a bundled python script; there is no staff notation and no audio. Charts always land in ~/Documents/Guitar/Songs. What you get is a careful best reading, not an official transcription.
jasonbhorne-guitar-skill-guitar.cover_note: 托管的是 GitHub 预览卡（1200×600/630），不上卡

dougcompton-guitar-coach-guitar-coach.title_zh: 每次练琴出一份计时日志，三份之后自己排出纠正练习
dougcompton-guitar-coach-guitar-coach.tagline_zh: 每次练琴出一份带计时分段的 markdown 日志，攒够三份就自己找出反复出问题的地方，把它排成今天的第一个纠正练习。
dougcompton-guitar-coach-guitar-coach.why_zh: 同一个 BPM 连挂三次就降一档、循环缩到 2–4 个音，要连三次干净才准上；低档没稳前绝不加量。
dougcompton-guitar-coach-guitar-coach.limit_zh: 默认把你当「重新捡起吉他的初学者」，高阶玩家得自己覆盖设定。日志、路线图、曲库都是你本地目录里的 markdown，换机器要自己搬。听录音打分那一步要跑本地 python 脚本、只吃 WAV。只覆盖吉他，不管别的乐器。
dougcompton-guitar-coach-guitar-coach.title_en: Three timed practice logs in, it picks today's first corrective drill
dougcompton-guitar-coach-guitar-coach.tagline_en: Every session writes a timed, sectioned markdown log; once three logs exist it finds the weak spot that keeps recurring and makes it the first corrective drill of the day.
dougcompton-guitar-coach-guitar-coach.why_en: Fail the same BPM rung three times and it drops a rung, shortens the loop to two to four notes, and demands three clean reps before you climb back — never more volume until the lower rung is stable.
dougcompton-guitar-coach-guitar-coach.limit_en: It assumes a returning beginner unless you override that. Logs, roadmaps and repertoire are plain markdown in a folder you choose, so moving machines means moving files. The listen-and-reflect scoring runs a local python script and only takes WAV. Guitar only.
dougcompton-guitar-coach-guitar-coach._无封面原因: 作者没放图（仓库树 66 项，零图片文件）。查过 17 个脚本能不能自截图：chord_library.py / progress_charts.py 的输出都是**终端文本**（和弦记成 x32010 这种字符串、进度是 ASCII 条），不是可当封面的图形产出。

softwarestartups-cortexrig-analyze-song.title_zh: 自己没听过就不许判过载还是干净的吉他音色还原台
softwarestartups-cortexrig-analyze-song.tagline_zh: 给一首歌，它扒出吉他轨、翻遍 rig rundown 和访谈，把器材映射成 Quad Cortex 上真有的模块。
softwarestartups-cortexrig-analyze-song.why_zh: Demucs 分不开两把吉他——亮的木吉他会把整轨波峰因数拉高，藏在后面的过载电吉他就被读成「干净」。
softwarestartups-cortexrig-analyze-song.limit_zh: 要你有 Neural DSP Quad Cortex，还要装 uv、demucs、yt-dlp、basic-pitch，外加一个 exacli 搜索密钥；跑不起来它会退成「只查资料」并说清原因。琴和拾音器默认按作者那把 Blade California Custom 写。
softwarestartups-cortexrig-analyze-song.title_en: The tone reverse-engineer that won't call a part clean if it never heard it
softwarestartups-cortexrig-analyze-song.tagline_en: Give it a song and it separates the guitar stem, digs through rig rundowns and interviews, and maps the real gear onto modules the Quad Cortex actually has — every claim tagged verified, likely or speculative.
softwarestartups-cortexrig-analyze-song.why_en: Demucs cannot separate two guitars: a bright acoustic inflates the whole stem's crest factor, so a driven electric hiding behind it reads as clean. The author logged the exact miss that taught them this.
softwarestartups-cortexrig-analyze-song.limit_en: You need a Neural DSP Quad Cortex, plus uv, demucs, yt-dlp and basic-pitch installed, plus an exacli (Exa search) key; when the toolchain is missing it degrades to research-only and says which reason applies. Guitar and pickup defaults are written around the author's own Blade California Custom.

yavuztopsever-wiring-diagram-skill.title_zh: 说不出每根线接到哪个焊点就停下来问你的吉他接线图
yavuztopsever-wiring-diagram-skill.tagline_zh: 要一张 Jazz Bass 串并联加 DPDT 的焊线图，它先写成一条条「源 → 目标」的网表，再画成俯视焊接图。
yavuztopsever-wiring-diagram-skill.why_zh: 画之前必须把每根线写成「源.属性 → 目标.属性」；说不出全部节点就停下来问你，不许先画后圆。
yavuztopsever-wiring-diagram-skill.limit_zh: 只画被动电路——主动前级、板载 EQ、电池、效果器、音箱、箱体接线一概不碰。输出是 SVG，要能跑 python 和 drawsvg。随件里有一份 J-Bass 串并联 DPDT 的逐线追踪，专门用来回答「这个开关凭什么这么工作」。
yavuztopsever-wiring-diagram-skill.title_en: The guitar wiring diagram that stops and asks when it can't name every node
yavuztopsever-wiring-diagram-skill.tagline_en: Ask for a Jazz Bass series/parallel DPDT layout and it first restates the request as a wire-by-wire netlist, then draws it with a python library as a top-down Seymour Duncan style solder diagram.
yavuztopsever-wiring-diagram-skill.why_en: Before any code, every wire has to be written as source.attribute -> destination.attribute. If it cannot name every node, it stops and asks rather than drawing something plausible.
yavuztopsever-wiring-diagram-skill.limit_en: Passive instrument electronics only — no preamps, onboard EQ, batteries, pedals, amps or speaker cabinets. Output is SVG and needs python plus drawsvg. One bundled reference is a formal per-wire trace of the J-Bass series/parallel mod, there specifically for when you ask why the switch works the way it does.

ryanpnsmith-vgc-competitive-skill-vgc-co.title_zh: 按 limitless 夺冠队表配宝可梦 VGC 阵容
ryanpnsmith-vgc-competitive-skill-vgc-co.tagline_zh: 配队前先去 limitlessvgc 翻真实夺冠队，用「赛场真的这么打」而不是「机制上可以」下结论；双属性不折成单属性算克制。
ryanpnsmith-vgc-competitive-skill-vgc-co.why_zh: 点名常犯的错：把草/幽灵折成纯草，会凭空算出四倍火弱点——幽灵那一半早抵掉了。
ryanpnsmith-vgc-competitive-skill-vgc-co.limit_zh: 只跟当前赛制，规则一换数据就过期；必须联网拉 limitlessvgc / pikalytics 才敢说「标准配」。当前赛制在《宝可梦冠军》上，剑盾厚底靴、生命宝珠等道具不存在，未核实的配置一律拒。
ryanpnsmith-vgc-competitive-skill-vgc-co.title_en: VGC teams grounded in real top-cut lists
ryanpnsmith-vgc-competitive-skill-vgc-co.tagline_en: Before building, it opens real top-cut lists on limitlessvgc — claims rest on what wins, not what mechanics permit; dual types stay dual.
ryanpnsmith-vgc-competitive-skill-vgc-co.why_en: It names the error: flatten Grass/Ghost to pure Grass and you invent a 4× Fire weakness the Ghost half already cancelled.
ryanpnsmith-vgc-competitive-skill-vgc-co.limit_en: Current format only — data goes stale on regulation change. Must fetch limitlessvgc/pikalytics live. Champions format: SwSh staples like Heavy-Duty Boots simply do not exist; unverified sets are refused.

clay07g-gtnh-claude-skill-gtnh-skill.title_zh: 只查你那份安装数据、不许凭记忆答的模组包问答台
clay07g-gtnh-claude-skill-gtnh-skill.tagline_zh: 把 GT: New Horizons 安装目录里三千多条任务索引成 SQLite 全文库，问什么都用 SQL 查给你。
clay07g-gtnh-claude-skill-gtnh-skill.why_zh: 它给信息源排了死序：数据库 > 官方 wiki > 模型对模组的印象，并写明最后那一档「非常经常是错的」。
clay07g-gtnh-claude-skill-gtnh-skill.limit_zh: 只覆盖 GT: New Horizons 这一个模组包，要 Java 17 加一次 gradle 构建（或去 Releases 下 zip），索引出来的是你自己那一版的任务。任务库之外的操作细节它只能给「可能」的答案，但会告诉你这句话是哪来的。
clay07g-gtnh-claude-skill-gtnh-skill.title_en: The modpack answer desk that queries your own install instead of remembering
clay07g-gtnh-claude-skill-gtnh-skill.tagline_en: Indexes the 3,600-plus quests inside a GregTech: New Horizons installation into a SQLite full-text database, so "what gates Quantum Storage" becomes a SQL query instead of a guess.
clay07g-gtnh-claude-skill-gtnh-skill.why_en: It ranks its sources and says so: the database first, then the official wiki, then the model's own memory of the mods — which it labels very often inaccurate.
clay07g-gtnh-claude-skill-gtnh-skill.limit_en: One modpack only, and it wants Java 17 plus a gradle build (or a zip from Releases); what it indexes is your particular installation. For anything outside the quest data it can only offer a possible answer, but it always says where the answer came from.

waylon524-us-visa.skill.title_zh: 被签证官审一轮，最后点出你最危险的三个回答
waylon524-us-visa.skill.tagline_zh: 在终端里被签证官审一轮：一次问一句，含糊、夸张或前后矛盾就立刻追问，最后给风险点而不是「包过」。
waylon524-us-visa.skill.why_zh: 结论只能基于你的回答本身，不许因为「材料很多」就放你过；看出你想美化事实会直接点名诚信风险。
waylon524-us-visa.skill.limit_zh: 默认只按中国公民的 B1/B2 走，F/J/H/L/K 和移民签只能当高层次模拟。开场必须先问你要中文还是英文面签。它给的是模拟判断，不是使领馆的正式决定，也不会替你约号、填表或写材料。
waylon524-us-visa.skill.title_en: A mock consular interview that ends by naming your riskiest answers
waylon524-us-visa.skill.tagline_en: Sit through a real-feeling B1/B2 interview in your terminal: one question at a time, and any answer that is vague, inflated or contradicts an earlier one gets followed up immediately.
waylon524-us-visa.skill.why_en: The verdict must rest on your answers alone — never on how thick your paperwork is — and if you look ready to dress up a fact, it names the credibility risk instead of playing along.
waylon524-us-visa.skill.limit_en: Built for Chinese citizens applying for B1/B2; F, J, H, L, K and immigrant categories only get a high-level simulation. It must ask whether you want the interview in Chinese or English before starting. What it gives is a simulation, never a consulate's decision, and it will not book appointments or fill in forms for you.

shadowhusky-visa-application.title_zh: 分得清分享码有效期和签证有效期的签证材料装配台
shadowhusky-visa-application.tagline_zh: 从一句「我要办日本签证」到一叠按顺序编号、能直接打印递窗口的材料：封面信、在职证明、清单和填好的表，档案存下来下次复用。
shadowhusky-visa-application.why_zh: 它列出了会读错的日期陷阱：英国分享码 30 天就过期，它证明的那个签证却能有效好几年，两个不是一回事。
shadowhusky-visa-application.limit_zh: 会把护照号、工资、IBAN 存进 ~/.claude/visa-profile.json（本地明文），但写之前必须等你确认每一个字段。规则以官网为准、要求交叉核对至少两个来源，两个来源冲突它只报告分歧不替你选。每次开场都会打印一个像素 banner。
shadowhusky-visa-application.title_en: The visa pack assembler that knows a share code is not a visa
shadowhusky-visa-application.tagline_en: Goes from "help me sort out my Japan visa" to a numbered, officer-ready print pack — cover letter, employment letter, filled form, checklist — and keeps a profile so the next application is a one-day job.
shadowhusky-visa-application.why_en: It lists the date traps that sink applications: a UK share code expires in 30 days while the visa it proves can be valid for years, and the two are not the same field.
shadowhusky-visa-application.limit_en: It stores passport numbers, salary and IBAN in ~/.claude/visa-profile.json in plain text locally — though it must wait for you to confirm each extracted value first. Requirements come from official sites cross-validated across at least two sources, and when sources disagree it surfaces the disagreement rather than picking. Every invocation prints a pixel-art banner first.

skills-il-legal-tech-israeli-citizenship.title_zh: 先告你哪条路已经死了、再让你去掏档案的血缘护照台
skills-il-legal-tech-israeli-citizenship.tagline_zh: 说出祖辈从哪来、什么时候走的，它先判这条路还开不开，再排出从人口登记摘录、加签到宣誓翻译的整条材料链。
skills-il-legal-tech-israeli-citizenship.why_zh: 它先查路线还开不开：让人跑去掏档案、付翻译费，最后发现这条路早就废了，是真花钱。
skills-il-legal-tech-israeli-citizenship.limit_zh: 只服务住在以色列的申请人，材料链全是以色列这一端的（人口登记摘录、apostille 机关、宣誓翻译）。条款以 2026 年 8 月 9 日核过为准，欧洲这些法每年在改，它会让你回官方源复核。血统断链或有争议的案子它直接把你推给执照律师。
skills-il-legal-tech-israeli-citizenship.title_en: The descent-passport triage that tells you which route is already dead
skills-il-legal-tech-israeli-citizenship.tagline_en: Name the ancestor, where they came from and when they left, and it first rules on whether that route is still open, then lays out the whole document chain from registry extract to apostille to sworn translation.
skills-il-legal-tech-israeli-citizenship.why_en: It checks route status before anything else, because sending someone to pull archive records and pay for translations on a repealed route costs them real money.
skills-il-legal-tech-israeli-citizenship.limit_en: Written for applicants living in Israel, and the document pipeline is entirely the Israeli side — population-registry extract, the right apostille authority, sworn translation. Specifics are verified as of 9 August 2026 and these laws move every year, so it routes you back to the primary source. A broken or contested line of descent gets handed straight to a licensed lawyer.

rikirinjani-android-toolkit.title_zh: 有一张「打死不许卸」名单的安卓预装清理台
rikirinjani-android-toolkit.tagline_zh: 插上线用纯 adb 干活：先认品牌，再按 MIUI / One UI / ColorOS 各自的垃圾清单分类列出来。
rikirinjani-android-toolkit.why_zh: 它把「绝不能卸」单列成一张表：桌面、电话、设置、SystemUI、通讯录和短信 provider。
rikirinjani-android-toolkit.limit_zh: 要先在手机上开 USB 调试、电脑上装好 adb，命令示例是 PowerShell 写法。卸载走 pm uninstall/disable，卸错了得你自己恢复。品牌垃圾清单是静态的，新机型新系统可能对不上。找重复文件靠 md5，几万张照片会很慢。
rikirinjani-android-toolkit.title_en: The Android debloater that ships a never-remove list
rikirinjani-android-toolkit.tagline_en: Works over plain adb: detects the brand first, lays out the MIUI / One UI / ColorOS bloat lists by category, and waits for your confirmation before uninstalling anything.
rikirinjani-android-toolkit.why_en: It keeps a separate table of packages that must never be removed — launcher, phone, settings, SystemUI, the contacts and telephony providers, Play Services Framework.
rikirinjani-android-toolkit.limit_en: You need USB debugging on the phone and adb on the computer, and the examples are written as PowerShell. Removal goes through pm uninstall/disable, so undoing a mistake is on you. The brand bloat lists are static and may not match a very new model or OS version. Duplicate-finding uses md5, which crawls on a library of tens of thousands of photos.

dull-bird-changde-dialect-skill-changde-.title_zh: 汉寿人说「我」不说「俺」，「俺」是桃源腔的常德话
dull-bird-changde-dialect-skill-changde-.tagline_zh: 说一句「说常德话」就切进汉寿龙阳话，词和音都出自国家语保工程汉寿调查点的官方录音、带国际音标；说「说普通话」退出。
dull-bird-changde-dialect-skill-changde-.why_zh: 它把两片口音设成互斥：汉寿说「我」「自家」，桃源说「俺」「各人」，切过去整套换掉，不许混用。
dull-bird-changde-dialect-skill-changde-.limit_zh: 默认口音是汉寿龙阳话，不是常德市区腔；桃源腔那份兜底词表来自 1986 年一本纸质词汇，只在汉寿数据没覆盖到时才用。要确定性开关，得按 Claude Code / Codex / Kimi / OpenClaw 各装一个钩子。代码和报错不方言化。
dull-bird-changde-dialect-skill-changde-.title_en: The Changde dialect skill that knows Hanshou says wo, not an
dull-bird-changde-dialect-skill-changde-.tagline_en: Say "speak Changde" and it switches into Hanshou Longyang speech, with words and readings taken from the state language-resource survey's official Hanshou recordings, IPA and all.
dull-bird-changde-dialect-skill-changde-.why_en: The two sub-accents are mutually exclusive by design: Hanshou says wo and zijia, Taoyuan says an and geren, and switching replaces the whole vocabulary rather than blending them.
dull-bird-changde-dialect-skill-changde-.limit_en: The default is Hanshou Longyang speech, not downtown Changde. The Taoyuan fallback wordlist comes from a 1986 print glossary and is only used where the Hanshou data has no entry. Deterministic on/off needs a hook installed separately for Claude Code, Codex, Kimi and OpenClaw; without one it degrades to the model spotting trigger words. Code and error messages are never dialectised.
dull-bird-changde-dialect-skill-changde-._无封面原因: 作者仓库里没有产出物样张（逐张开过：只有 docs/assets/changde-beef-noodle-logo.png，一碗手绘常德牛肉粉配「qí fěn 吃粉」美术字，1024×1024。是招牌不是产出物，而且会误导——这件的产出是方言文本，卡上放一碗粉会让人以为它生成美食图。

1229lky-art-cantonese-transcribe.title_zh: 粤语音频出一句一行配粤拼的 md，全程本地跑
1229lky-art-cantonese-transcribe.tagline_zh: 丢一个粤语音频、文件夹或播客链接，全程在你自己电脑上跑，出一句一行配粤拼的 md 和手机能看的 PDF。
1229lky-art-cantonese-transcribe.why_zh: 断句绝不外包给在线大模型，交给本地 ct-punc——作者说这正是它换个模型也能复用的关键。
1229lky-art-cantonese-transcribe.limit_zh: 要在本地装 FunASR/SenseVoice、ct-punc、ToJyutping 那一整套，第一次下模型很久，CPU 上长音频慢。听错的字要你自己往 corrections.txt 里加，再 --resync 重排、不重跑识别。只出 md 和 PDF，没有 srt。
1229lky-art-cantonese-transcribe.title_en: Cantonese audio to one line per sentence, Jyutping under each, all local
1229lky-art-cantonese-transcribe.tagline_en: Hand it a Cantonese audio file, a folder of them, or a podcast link; everything runs on your own machine and out comes one sentence per line with Jyutping under each, as markdown and a phone-readable PDF.
1229lky-art-cantonese-transcribe.why_en: Sentence segmentation goes to a local ct-punc model and never to an online LLM — the author says that is exactly what makes the skill portable across models.
1229lky-art-cantonese-transcribe.limit_en: You install the FunASR/SenseVoice, ct-punc and ToJyutping stack locally; the first model download takes a while and long audio is slow on CPU. Misheard words and wrong readings are fixed by you, by appending to corrections.txt or jyutping_overrides.txt and re-running --resync, which reflows without redoing recognition. Output is markdown and PDF only — no SRT subtitles.
1229lky-art-cantonese-transcribe._无封面原因: 作者没放图（仓库树 8 项，零图片文件）。

jiang59991-qiaopi.title_zh: 一句话白话文，落成南洋阿嬷能读的家书
jiang59991-qiaopi.tagline_zh: 把「今天好想你」翻成南洋华侨寄回故乡的家书，抬头、起兴、嘱咐、落款按干支年排好；说话人和对象不明就先沉浸式反问一次。
jiang59991-qiaopi.why_zh: 落款绝不写「妾」；历史上侨批必有钱，但你没提寄钱它就不写附银那行——凭空加一句就跳戏。
jiang59991-qiaopi.limit_zh: 只做一种语感：潮汕南洋侨批体，以电影《给阿嬷的情书》的诗化句式为骨，不是通用文言翻译器。随件是 1888–1957 年真实侨批和电影里的信，用来学句式、不是史料库。方言只作点缀，不会写成全篇潮汕话。
jiang59991-qiaopi.title_en: Turn plain sentences into Nanyang grandpa-style letters
jiang59991-qiaopi.tagline_en: Turns "I miss you today" into a letter a Nanyang emigrant would have sent home: salutation, seasonal opening, instructions, and a sexagenary-cycle sign-off — asking one question first if it cannot place the writer and reader.
jiang59991-qiaopi.why_en: The sign-off may never use the self-deprecating "concubine" form. And although real qiaopi always enclosed money, it leaves that line out unless you asked for it — inventing a remittance breaks the letter.
jiang59991-qiaopi.limit_en: It does one register — Teochew/Nanyang qiaopi, built on the lyric cadence of the 2026 film Letters to Grandma — not general classical Chinese. The bundled references are real 1888-1957 letters and lines from the film, there to teach phrasing rather than to serve as an archive. Dialect appears as seasoning only; it will not write a whole letter in Teochew.
jiang59991-qiaopi._无封面原因: 作者没放图（仓库树 10 项，零图片文件）。
jiang59991-qiaopi.cover_note: 托管的是 GitHub 预览卡（1200×600/630），不上卡

elhamid-as-told-to-as-told-to.title_zh: 只记你说过的话，不替你补半句的人生访谈录
elhamid-as-told-to-as-told-to.tagline_zh: 一场一场地采访你或你父母的人生，逐字稿原样留档，另出一份下次接着问的笔记；成不成书随你，档案先归你自己。
elhamid-as-told-to-as-told-to.why_zh: 不许递一个细节让老人点头确认：「大概 2003 年冬天吧」进待核清单，正文写「我不确定」。
elhamid-as-told-to-as-told-to.limit_zh: 它只采访在场的本人，不替不在场的人写传记，也拒绝改写成简历、领英简介或创始人故事。情绪一上来就全停：只给「留在这里／换话题／今天到这」三个选项，一个追问都不许有。仓库 dev/ 目录里抄了同行的整份 skill 当对照，安装时别一起拷进去。
elhamid-as-told-to-as-told-to.title_en: Life-story interviewer that writes only your words
elhamid-as-told-to-as-told-to.tagline_en: Interviews you, or your parent, session by session; keeps the verbatim transcript untouched and a separate working note for next time. Whether it becomes a book is your call — the archive is yours either way.
elhamid-as-told-to-as-told-to.why_en: It will not hand the elder a detail to nod at. "Probably winter 2003" goes on the verify list, and the record itself says "2003 or 2004 — I'm not certain."
elhamid-as-told-to-as-told-to.limit_en: It only interviews the person in the room, refuses to write a biography of someone absent, and declines to convert the corpus into a resume, LinkedIn bio or founder story. When emotion rises it stops entirely, offering only stay here / change the subject / done for today, with no question about what surfaced. The repo's dev/ folder contains other authors' full skills copied in as prior art — don't install that part.
elhamid-as-told-to-as-told-to.cover_note: 托管的是 GitHub 预览卡（1200×600/630），不上卡

brendanbank-fix-my-text-skill-fix-my-tex.title_zh: b/d 写反了帮你改、口语拼法一个不动的改字台
brendanbank-fix-my-text-skill-fix-my-tex.tagline_zh: 把「dook」认回 book、把漏掉的冠词和介词补回去、句号后面该大写就大写，但你原来那个词一个都不换成更漂亮的说法。
brendanbank-fix-my-text-skill-fix-my-tex.why_zh: 它把两件事分开：句号后大写不是「加正式感」而是句子结构；gonna、dunno、cos 是风格选择、不是错。
brendanbank-fix-my-text-skill-fix-my-tex.limit_zh: 只做英文。碰到「她」「那个东西」「到时候」这种读者会看不懂的模糊指代，它会先停下来列问题等你回答，不先给改好的稿。它禁用长破折号（作者认为那是 AI 味的标记），你原文里的破折号会被换成逗号或句号。
brendanbank-fix-my-text-skill-fix-my-tex.title_en: The proofreader that fixes reversed b and d and leaves gonna alone
brendanbank-fix-my-text-skill-fix-my-tex.tagline_en: Reads "dook" back as book, puts the dropped articles and prepositions back, capitalises after a full stop — and never swaps a word you chose for a fancier one.
brendanbank-fix-my-text-skill-fix-my-tex.why_en: It separates two things people confuse: capitalising after a period is sentence structure, not added formality, while gonna, dunno and cos are deliberate style, not errors.
brendanbank-fix-my-text-skill-fix-my-tex.limit_en: English only. When it finds a reference a reader could not follow — "her", "the thing", "by then" — it stops and asks a numbered list of questions before producing any corrected text. It bans the em dash outright, on the author's view that it reads as an AI tell, so any em dash of yours comes back as a comma or a period.
brendanbank-fix-my-text-skill-fix-my-tex._无封面原因: 作者没放图（仓库树 5 项，零图片文件）。

julianpscheid-chronic-illness-research-p.title_zh: 把你这个病的多年研究搭成一个带证据分级的本地仓库
julianpscheid-chronic-illness-research-p.tagline_zh: 跑一次，把你这个病的多年研究搭成一个本地仓库：证据分级、PMID 回环核验、给医生看的材料，之后都在那个仓库里做。
julianpscheid-chronic-illness-research-p.why_zh: 基线没做完它拒绝往下走；且「引文核过」不等于「结论核过」——它专防拿真论文去撑一个更强的说法。
julianpscheid-chronic-illness-research-p.limit_zh: 只跑一次做脚手架，之后的活在生成的仓库里做，它会拒绝重复运行。不做诊断、不做急症判断、不做症状打卡，也不给用药方案；它假定你已经有、或正在找一位临床医生。生成的仓库会攒真实健康信息，作者要求推到公开仓库前先做一次脱敏复核。
julianpscheid-chronic-illness-research-p.title_en: Scaffolds one local repo to hold years of research on your condition
julianpscheid-chronic-illness-research-p.tagline_en: Runs once to scaffold a multi-year research repo for your condition — evidence tiers, PMID round-trip verification, clinician-facing materials — and all later work happens inside that repo.
julianpscheid-chronic-illness-research-p.why_en: It refuses to move on before the baseline is done. And a verified citation is not a verified claim: it guards specifically against citing a real paper for a stronger claim than the paper makes.
julianpscheid-chronic-illness-research-p.limit_en: One-shot scaffolding only; it declines to run again and sends you into the generated repo. It does no diagnosis, no acute triage, no symptom tracking and no dosing, and it assumes you already have or are actively pursuing a clinician. The repo it creates accumulates real health information, and the author asks for a redaction review before you push it to any public remote.

joeseesun-qiaomu-epub-book-generator.title_zh: Markdown 装订成微信读书能翻的 EPUB 书
joeseesun-qiaomu-epub-book-generator.tagline_zh: 文章攒够了想成书，卡的是封面和目录。它按 KDP 的 1600×2560 出封面，图先转 PNG 再嵌，微信读书能开。
joeseesun-qiaomu-epub-book-generator.why_zh: 远程图片先下载、SVG 先转 PNG 再嵌——这两步正是 EPUB 进微信读书后配图全裂的原因。
joeseesun-qiaomu-epub-book-generator.limit_zh: 只从 Markdown 出发，不接 Word 和网页链接。封面在 6 套主题里挑，不是给你现画。SVG 转图要装 Playwright。压缩默认转 JPEG，透明底会没。
joeseesun-qiaomu-epub-book-generator.title_en: Turns a folder of Markdown into an EPUB that survives WeChat Read
joeseesun-qiaomu-epub-book-generator.tagline_en: The hard part of self-publishing is never the text, it is the cover and the table of contents. This one renders a 1600x2560 KDP cover and rasterises your SVGs before packing.
joeseesun-qiaomu-epub-book-generator.why_en: It downloads remote images and converts SVG through headless Chrome first, which is exactly why its books do not open with every illustration broken.
joeseesun-qiaomu-epub-book-generator.limit_en: Markdown in, EPUB out — no Word, no URLs. The cover comes from six themes rather than a fresh design. SVG conversion needs Playwright installed. Compression defaults to JPEG, so transparency is lost.
joeseesun-qiaomu-epub-book-generator._拿到手的是什么: 一个带 KDP 尺寸封面、微信读书和 Apple Books 都能打开的 EPUB 文件

zouchenzhen-thesis-defense-pptx-skill-th.title_zh: 照学校模板出可编辑的答辩 PPT，配图只准用论文里的
zouchenzhen-thesis-defense-pptx-skill-th.tagline_zh: 它先从 PDF/LaTeX 抓出图注做成配图白名单，再复制模板原生页填内容，最后导图逐页查溢出。
zouchenzhen-thesis-defense-pptx-skill-th.why_zh: 模板里和旧汇报里那些「看着挺搭」的图一律不许搬——白名单只认最终论文真引用过的那几张。
zouchenzhen-thesis-defense-pptx-skill-th.limit_zh: 完整质检要 Windows 装了 PowerPoint（靠 COM 导图查溢出），macOS/Linux 只剩 python-pptx 那半套。你得先有学校模板 pptx，它不替你设计模板。默认 12–16 页。
zouchenzhen-thesis-defense-pptx-skill-th.title_en: A defense deck that inherits your department template and cites only real figures
zouchenzhen-thesis-defense-pptx-skill-th.tagline_en: It reads the thesis itself — PDF, TeX, captions — builds an allow-list of the figures the paper actually cites, then clones native template slides instead of rebuilding blanks.
zouchenzhen-thesis-defense-pptx-skill-th.why_en: Every deck it exports is a real editable pptx, and it exports slide images afterwards to catch clipped text and stale template words before you see it.
zouchenzhen-thesis-defense-pptx-skill-th.limit_en: The full quality gate is Windows plus installed PowerPoint (COM export and overflow inspection); elsewhere you get the python-pptx half. You must supply the template — it will not design one.
zouchenzhen-thesis-defense-pptx-skill-th._拿到手的是什么: 一份沿用学校模板、每页文字都能改的答辩 PPTX，附逐页导图溢出检查

hasasasa-html-to-editable-pptx.title_zh: HTML 幻灯片转成 pptx，文字还是能改的文本框
hasasasa-html-to-editable-pptx.tagline_zh: 同事只要 ppt，你手里只有网页 deck。它逐字量位置摆成原生文本框，只有装饰太复杂的局部才退回截图。
hasasasa-html-to-editable-pptx.why_zh: 它记得 PowerPoint 和 WPS 都不读 pptx 内嵌的裸字体，所以先问你能不能装进用户字体目录。
hasasasa-html-to-editable-pptx.limit_zh: 视觉验收要 PowerPoint COM 或 LibreOffice 才渲得出图，没有就只剩结构自检。中文首次要下约 40MB 字体子集。复杂渐变和滤镜会退化成截图，那块改不了。
hasasasa-html-to-editable-pptx.title_en: Your HTML deck as a pptx whose text is still text
hasasasa-html-to-editable-pptx.tagline_en: It measures every glyph in a real browser, then rebuilds the page as native PowerPoint textboxes; only decoration too complex to reproduce falls back to a screenshot.
hasasasa-html-to-editable-pptx.why_en: It knows PowerPoint COM and WPS both ignore fonts embedded inside a pptx, so it asks permission to install the resolved faces into your user font directory instead.
hasasasa-html-to-editable-pptx.limit_en: The visual audit stage needs PowerPoint COM or LibreOffice to render; without one you only get the structural self-check. First CJK run downloads roughly 40MB of font subsets.
hasasasa-html-to-editable-pptx._拿到手的是什么: 一个文字仍是原生文本框、能在 PowerPoint 里直接改字的 pptx

renezander030-capcut-cli-capcut-edit.title_zh: 改剪映工程里的字幕和时间轴，改完你接着手剪
renezander030-capcut-cli-capcut-edit.tagline_zh: 别的 AI 剪辑丢给你一条渲好的成片，它动的是 draft_content.json——回剪映打开，轨道和素材原样都在。
renezander030-capcut-cli-capcut-edit.why_zh: 剪映 6.0 起 draft 加密，它只检测不解密：解厂商的加密和读明文格式不是一个风险等级。
renezander030-capcut-cli-capcut-edit.limit_zh: 剪映 6.0+ 工程加密，它读不了——要么把剪映锁在 5.9.x 不更新，要么换国际版 CapCut。编辑前必须在剪映里关掉工程。非官方实现，剪映升级就可能失配。
renezander030-capcut-cli-capcut-edit.title_en: Edits the CapCut project itself, so you can keep cutting by hand
renezander030-capcut-cli-capcut-edit.tagline_en: Subtitles, timing, speed, volume, fades, ken-burns keyframes and long-to-short cuts, written straight into the draft store with a .bak and rolling snapshots on every write.
renezander030-capcut-cli-capcut-edit.why_en: Asked to defeat JianYing 6.0 encryption, the author wrote the decision down and declined: detect, do not decrypt. The Wikimedia asset fetcher refuses non-commercial licenses too.
renezander030-capcut-cli-capcut-edit.limit_en: JianYing 6.0+ drafts are encrypted and unreadable — pin 5.9.x or use CapCut International. Close the project in the editor first. Unofficial, so any app update can break it.
renezander030-capcut-cli-capcut-edit._拿到手的是什么: 一个字幕、时间轴、卡拉OK都改好的剪映工程，回剪映打开还能接着手剪

shpigford-nurb-nurb.title_zh: 零件参数名就是滑块名，浏览器里拖着改的 3D 打印件
shpigford-nurb-nurb.tagline_zh: 零件是一个 Python 函数，关键字默认值就是浏览器里的滑块。每次保存不动镜头就重建，尺寸由你拖着定。
shpigford-nurb-nurb.why_zh: 它把参数名当界面写：不许叫 pilot_dia，得叫 screw_hole_width——滑块只有这行字。
shpigford-nurb-nurb.limit_zh: 要装 nurb 工具链并常驻一个 nurb dev 服务。手机扫的模型只算参考几何，配合面得先打一条试片。在架另有一件 CadQuery 建模台，两件是不同路子。
shpigford-nurb-nurb.title_en: A printable part whose parameter names are the sliders you drag
shpigford-nurb-nurb.tagline_en: Every part is a Python function and its keyword defaults become labelled sliders in a live viewer that rebuilds on save without moving your camera.
shpigford-nurb-nurb.why_en: A look is a hypothesis and a number settles it: it answers "that wall looks thin" with the measured 1.6mm against your printer's 1.0mm line width instead of agreeing.
shpigford-nurb-nurb.limit_en: You install the nurb toolchain and keep a dev server running. Phone scans count as reference geometry, so mating surfaces need a printed fit coupon first. A CadQuery bench is already on the shelf.
shpigford-nurb-nurb._拿到手的是什么: 一个参数能拖着改的 3D 打印零件（STL/STEP），外加浏览器里每次保存就重建的预览

oil-oil-oil-icon.title_zh: 16 枚一次生成再切开，出一套透明底的同款图标
oil-oil-oil-icon.tagline_zh: 一次只生一张 4×4 灰底大图再切开——同一次生成出来的 16 枚，风格才真的一样。切完合到品红底上逐枚验边。
oil-oil-oil-icon.why_zh: 它明说不干什么：单个图标去画 SVG，16–24px 的界面小图标去用矢量库，位图在那个尺寸不锐。
oil-oil-oil-icon.limit_zh: 要有能调的生图工具（内置 imagegen 或 Codex），都没有就得自己出 API key。抠底分 floodfill 和 rembg 两条路，玻璃和 3D 质感容易留毛边。只适合大尺寸点睛图标。
oil-oil-oil-icon.title_en: One 4x4 sheet, sixteen icons, cut out onto transparent PNGs
oil-oil-oil-icon.tagline_en: Style consistency by construction: sixteen icons come out of a single generation on flat grey, then get sliced and background-removed one cell at a time.
oil-oil-oil-icon.why_en: The mandatory QA step composites every cut icon onto magenta and checks the edge, because a halo you cannot see on white is the thing that ruins the set.
oil-oil-oil-icon.limit_en: Needs a callable image generator; without one you supply an API key yourself. Cutout runs floodfill or rembg, and glossy or 3D styles keep fringing. Not for 16-24px UI glyphs.
oil-oil-oil-icon._拿到手的是什么: 一套风格统一、透明底的 PNG 图标，一次 16 枚

rss3208-visiomaster.title_zh: 截图里的架构图重画成 Visio 能拖的 vsdx
rss3208-visiomaster.tagline_zh: 截图里的流程图和论文模块图，它重建成节点、标签、连接线都能选中的 Visio 文件，再导出 SVG 和 PNG。
rss3208-visiomaster.why_zh: 它禁止用「把原图贴上去」蒙混过关：主结构必须重画成可编辑图元，只有小缩略图和纹理允许留位图。
rss3208-visiomaster.limit_zh: Windows 专用，要本机装 Visio 桌面版和 pywin32，mac 和 Linux 完全跑不了。严格复核必须有本地源图文件，聊天附件不算。宽而密的图得先分区，一次画不完。
rss3208-visiomaster.title_en: Rebuilds a diagram screenshot as a .vsdx you can drag in Visio
rss3208-visiomaster.tagline_en: Flowcharts, architecture diagrams and paper module figures come back as selectable nodes, labels and connectors through an image to scene.json to Visio COM pipeline.
rss3208-visiomaster.why_en: Pasting the original image is explicitly forbidden as an answer: the main structure must be redrawn as editable shapes, and only thumbnails or textures may stay raster.
rss3208-visiomaster.limit_en: Windows only, with desktop Visio and pywin32 installed — nothing runs on macOS or Linux. Strict review requires a real local source file; a chat attachment does not count.
rss3208-visiomaster._拿到手的是什么: 一份能在 Visio 里选中拖动的 .vsdx，外加导出的 SVG/PNG

fokkyp-softwarecopyright-skill-software-.title_zh: 读你的项目出一整套软著申请 Word，代码只准用真的
fokkyp-softwarecopyright-skill-software-.tagline_zh: 软著卡人的是 60 页源码、操作手册和申请表格式。它读你的仓库，先出 Markdown 草稿等你确认，再落成 Word。
fokkyp-softwarecopyright-skill-software-.why_zh: 操作手册它自己循环去 AI 味并留自检记录：不许「赋能」「一站式」，每段都要答得上用户看见什么。
fokkyp-softwarecopyright-skill-software-.limit_zh: 只做材料，不替你交件，登记还是你自己去走流程。要 Python 3.10+ 和 python-docx，完整 OpenXML 校验还要 .NET SDK。手册里的截图位要你自己补。
fokkyp-softwarecopyright-skill-software-.title_en: Reads your repo and writes the full Chinese software-copyright filing set
fokkyp-softwarecopyright-skill-software-.tagline_en: Application-form data, the sixty-page source-code document, an end-user manual and a design specification, drafted in Markdown for your confirmation and then rendered to Word.
fokkyp-softwarecopyright-skill-software-.why_en: Two rules carry it: source material must come from the real repository with no invented code, and the manual is looped through its own de-slop audit with the record kept on disk.
fokkyp-softwarecopyright-skill-software-.limit_en: It produces documents, not a filing — you still submit them yourself. Needs Python 3.10+ with python-docx, and .NET SDK 8 for full OpenXML validation. Screenshots stay as reserved slots.
fokkyp-softwarecopyright-skill-software-._拿到手的是什么: 一整套软著申请材料的 Word：申请表信息、60 页源码文档、操作手册、设计说明

jackywxsz-jacky-motion.title_zh: 口播稿加 SRT 出一个能录屏的自动播 HTML
jackywxsz-jacky-motion.tagline_zh: 画面按字幕的毫秒点推进，没有 HTML 演示的区间自动留成带小标题的 B-roll 录屏画框，节奏和口播对得上。
jackywxsz-jacky-motion.why_zh: 它不合成语音也不嵌音频：声音一旦成为自动播放的依赖，录屏那一遍就再也对不齐。
jackywxsz-jacky-motion.limit_zh: 不出视频也不配音，录屏和配音要你自己来。得先有对应的 .srt。只有 16:9 和 4:3，全片单一风格不许混搭。校验脚本要 Node。整套按中文口播设计。
jackywxsz-jacky-motion.title_en: Voiceover script plus SRT, out comes a self-playing deck you screen-record
jackywxsz-jacky-motion.tagline_en: The SRT is the master clock: beats advance on subtitle milliseconds, and any stretch without an HTML beat becomes a labelled B-roll frame instead of dead air.
jackywxsz-jacky-motion.why_en: It refuses to generate speech or embed audio at all, because the moment sound becomes an autoplay dependency the screen recording can never be re-synced.
jackywxsz-jacky-motion.limit_en: No video and no voice — you record and narrate. Requires a matching .srt. 16:9 and 4:3 only, one style per film, and the validators need Node. Built around Chinese voiceover.
jackywxsz-jacky-motion._拿到手的是什么: 一个按 SRT 毫秒点自动播放、打开就能录屏的单文件 16:9 HTML

anshler-graphify-novel.title_zh: 长篇写到三十万字，靠这本 bible 查前后矛盾
anshler-graphify-novel.tagline_zh: 人物状态、未收线索、世界设定各自成档，新章写完过一遍审阅，再把全书关系图重建一次。
anshler-graphify-novel.why_zh: draft/ 和 static/ 排除在抽取之外——没定稿的段落不许进正典，一致性检查才站得住。
anshler-graphify-novel.limit_zh: 关系图要另装别人的 graphify（pip graphifyy），它只负责提示安装。仓库里就一份 SKILL.md，全靠约定的目录结构，你得先按 bible/ 的布局把稿子搬进去。
anshler-graphify-novel.title_en: A story bible that catches the contradiction on page four hundred
anshler-graphify-novel.tagline_en: Character state, open threads and world lore each get their own file; every new chapter is reviewed against them and the whole-manuscript relationship graph is rebuilt.
anshler-graphify-novel.why_en: draft/ and static/ are excluded from extraction by design — an unfinished passage is not canon, which is the only footing a consistency check can stand on.
anshler-graphify-novel.limit_en: The graph half needs someone else's graphify package installed; this skill only offers to do it. One SKILL.md and a directory convention, so your manuscript has to move into its layout first.
anshler-graphify-novel._拿到手的是什么: 一本 story bible（人物档、线索表、世界设定）加一份逐章一致性审阅和全书关系图

timmyw5-icloud-photo-rescue-icloud-photo.title_zh: 退订 iCloud 前，把导出的照片归成年月和相册
timmyw5-icloud-photo-rescue-icloud-photo.tagline_zh: 苹果导出的几万张平铺文件，它按 EXIF 定日期、还原相册软链、生成缩略图和离线相册页。动文件前先出 dry-run。
timmyw5-icloud-photo-rescue-icloud-photo.why_zh: 作者在 3.8 万张上踩过：Live Photo 的 -1.MOV 不在 CSV 里，日期永远跟着图片走。
timmyw5-icloud-photo-rescue-icloud-photo.limit_zh: 只认 privacy.apple.com「获取数据副本」那种分部导出，别的备份形式对不上。macOS 专用（靠 sips），exiftool 和 ffmpeg 要 brew 装。机械硬盘上得分批续跑。
timmyw5-icloud-photo-rescue-icloud-photo.title_en: Leave iCloud without losing a photo: the export, rebuilt as a real library
timmyw5-icloud-photo-rescue-icloud-photo.tagline_en: Tens of thousands of flat files become YYYY/YYYY-MM folders with albums restored as relative symlinks, thumbnails generated, and a browsable offline album page.
timmyw5-icloud-photo-rescue-icloud-photo.why_en: Learned on 38,000 photos: the Live Photo sidecar never appears in Apple's CSV, so it always inherits the still's date rather than guessing from its own metadata.
timmyw5-icloud-photo-rescue-icloud-photo.limit_en: Only reads Apple's own "copy of your data" multi-part export. macOS only (it leans on sips), with exiftool and ffmpeg from brew. On a spinning disk you resume in batches.
timmyw5-icloud-photo-rescue-icloud-photo._拿到手的是什么: 一个按年/月归档、相册还原成软链、缩略图和离线相册页都建好的本地照片库

qiuos-compose-this-scene.skill.title_zh: 一张照片切出五种构图预览，附标注和联系表
qiuos-compose-this-scene.skill.tagline_zh: 它不停在「主体偏左」这种话上：每个方向给一个归一化裁剪框，脚本渲成裁剪图、压暗标注图和一张联系表。
qiuos-compose-this-scene.skill.why_zh: 三到五个方向必须意图不同——不是同一张图裁大裁小，负空间、引导线、极近特写各占一个。
qiuos-compose-this-scene.skill.limit_zh: 要有本地图片路径才渲得出图，聊天里的附件只能给文字建议。脚本只做裁剪和参考线叠加，不修色不修图。参考里的摄影师名字是风格坐标，不是能套的预设。
qiuos-compose-this-scene.skill.title_en: Five crops of the same photo, rendered with guides and a contact sheet
qiuos-compose-this-scene.skill.tagline_en: It commits to normalized crop boxes and focus points, then renders each one as a preview, a dimmed annotated original, and one contact sheet to compare across.
qiuos-compose-this-scene.skill.why_en: The options must differ in intent rather than in tightness: negative space, leading-line geometry and a dramatic close crop each have to earn their own slot.
qiuos-compose-this-scene.skill.limit_en: Rendering needs a local file path; a chat attachment only gets you words. The script crops and overlays guides — it does not grade or retouch. Photographer names are references, not presets.
qiuos-compose-this-scene.skill._拿到手的是什么: 三到五张裁剪预览图、压暗标注图和一张联系表

dimgouso-science-sim-author-science-sim-.title_zh: 把一份 SimSpec 出成能拖滑杆的离线仿真页
dimgouso-science-sim-author-science-sim-.tagline_zh: 给它一份 SimSpec，出唯一一个 index.html：画布跑仿真、滑杆调参、时序图、导 CSV，末尾附探究学案。
dimgouso-science-sim-author-science-sim-.why_zh: 输出契约写死到 DOM id 一级，禁 eval 禁外链——所以那一页在教室断网也能跑。
dimgouso-science-sim-author-science-sim-.limit_zh: 只认三种渲染器：抛体轨迹、一维振子、RC 电路；SimSpec 落到别的域它直接停下来问你，不猜着画。产物永远只有一个 index.html，多文件工程别指望。
dimgouso-science-sim-author-science-sim-.title_en: One offline index.html that runs the simulation, sliders and all
dimgouso-science-sim-author-science-sim-.tagline_en: Hand it a SimSpec and get back exactly one file: canvas simulation, parameter sliders, a time-series plot, CSV export, and an inquiry worksheet.
dimgouso-science-sim-author-science-sim-.why_en: The output contract is pinned down to DOM ids, with eval and remote assets forbidden — which is why the page still runs in a classroom with no wifi.
dimgouso-science-sim-author-science-sim-.limit_en: Three renderers only: projectile trajectory, 1D oscillator, RC circuit. A SimSpec outside those domains makes it stop and ask rather than guess. The deliverable is always a single index.html — never a project tree.

science-prof-robot-recursive-math-animat.title_zh: 渲一支 Manim 数理动画，六套设计系统随挑
science-prof-robot-recursive-math-animat.tagline_zh: 动手前先给一句话结论加三到五个节拍，你点头才写场景代码。六套设计系统，渲完切帧自查再重渲。
science-prof-robot-recursive-math-animat.why_zh: GIF 只准用来查版式：ffmpeg 重编码会把深色极简配色的渐变压烂。
science-prof-robot-recursive-math-animat.limit_zh: 要装 manim、ffmpeg，物理场景锁死 manim-physics 0.4.0。默认交 MP4，要小体积 GIF 就得砍时长或减色。gTTS 配音要联网，换 Gemini TTS 得自己配 key。
science-prof-robot-recursive-math-animat.title_en: A Manim maths animation, six design systems to pick from
science-prof-robot-recursive-math-animat.tagline_en: It pitches a one-line takeaway and three to five beats first; scene code waits for your yes. Six design systems, then a frame-by-frame self-review before the final render.
science-prof-robot-recursive-math-animat.why_en: GIF is allowed only for layout checks — aggressive ffmpeg re-encoding crushes the gradients in dark minimal palettes.
science-prof-robot-recursive-math-animat.limit_en: Needs manim and ffmpeg installed, with manim-physics pinned to 0.4.0 for physics scenes. MP4 is the default deliverable; a small GIF means cutting length or colors. gTTS voiceover needs network, and the Gemini TTS path needs your own key.

lucakaufmann-gridfinity-generator-skill.title_zh: 按 42 毫米网格出能直接打印的收纳盒 STL
lucakaufmann-gridfinity-generator-skill.tagline_zh: 抽屉按毫米量、盒子按格算，一条命令出 STL：18650 电芯、SD 卡、GBA 卡带都有现成孔位。
lucakaufmann-gridfinity-generator-skill.why_zh: 孔位表细到 cr927 纽扣电池和 PS Vita 记忆卡——照着真抽屉一格格量过的人才列得出。
lucakaufmann-gridfinity-generator-skill.limit_zh: 要先装 OpenSCAD 2024+ 并把 gridfinity_extended_openscad 克隆到 ~/git/，否则只能跑 --preview 出不了 STL。SKILL.md 没有 frontmatter name，装的时候目录名得你自己起。
lucakaufmann-gridfinity-generator-skill.title_en: Print-ready Gridfinity STLs on a 42 mm grid
lucakaufmann-gridfinity-generator-skill.tagline_en: Measure the drawer in millimetres, size the bins in grid units, get an STL from one command — with ready cavities for 18650 cells, SD cards and GBA cartridges.
lucakaufmann-gridfinity-generator-skill.why_en: The cavity table goes down to cr927 coin cells and PS Vita memory cards — the list of someone who measured a real drawer, slot by slot.
lucakaufmann-gridfinity-generator-skill.limit_en: You must install OpenSCAD 2024+ and clone gridfinity_extended_openscad into ~/git/ first; without them only --preview works and no STL comes out. The SKILL.md has no frontmatter name, so you name the install directory yourself.

tobewin-handdraw-skill.title_zh: 拿 JSON 分镜渲一支手绘白板讲解 MP4
tobewin-handdraw-skill.tagline_zh: 只吃本地 SVG、不碰生视频模型：写 project.json、跑 validate、渲成带配音的成片。
tobewin-handdraw-skill.why_zh: 它自己说清 write 只是确定性显字、不是真笔顺——不拿动效冒充手写。
tobewin-handdraw-skill.limit_zh: 素材必须是本地 SVG 线稿，位图和外链一律不收；每场限八个物件、建议三到八秒。要 Node 和 FFmpeg，配音走 Edge TTS 需联网。没说时长就按 30 秒并把这个假设写在标题里。
tobewin-handdraw-skill.title_en: A hand-drawn whiteboard explainer MP4 from a JSON storyboard
tobewin-handdraw-skill.tagline_en: Local path-based SVG only, no text-to-video model anywhere: write project.json, run validate, render an MP4 with free Edge TTS narration.
tobewin-handdraw-skill.why_en: It says plainly that `write` is a deterministic reveal, not real stroke order — no passing an animation off as handwriting.
tobewin-handdraw-skill.limit_en: Assets must be local SVG line art; raster images and remote URLs are refused. Eight objects per scene, three to eight seconds each. Needs Node and FFmpeg, and Edge TTS narration needs network. With no duration given it targets 30 seconds and states that assumption in the title.

dlazyai-ai-product-video.title_zh: 把你的网页做成有卡点和音效的产品宣传片
dlazyai-ai-product-video.tagline_zh: 先只读地看一遍产品，再给三种互不合并的模式：套模板、全自动、共同创作。152 张镜头卡都带 demo 源码。
dlazyai-ai-product-video.why_zh: 它明说别只因为 Ink Press 是现成模板就推荐它，得给出适合与不适合的具体依据。
dlazyai-ai-product-video.limit_zh: 要 Remotion 工具链，成片靠真实页面截图，产品跑不起来就没素材。音效库另有 ATTRIBUTION 和试听记录，商用前自己核授权。目前只对 web 和桌面产品调过。
