dlazyai-ai-product-video.title_en: Your web app, cut into a promo film with beats and sound design
dlazyai-ai-product-video.tagline_en: A read-only product inspection comes first, then three modes that never merge: template, autonomous, or co-creation. All 152 shot recipe cards ship with demo source.
dlazyai-ai-product-video.why_en: It tells the agent not to recommend the Ink Press template just because it is ready-made, and to give concrete reasons it does or does not fit.
dlazyai-ai-product-video.limit_en: Needs the Remotion toolchain, and the footage comes from real page screenshots — if the product does not run, there is nothing to shoot. The SFX library carries its own ATTRIBUTION and audition log; check the licences before commercial use. Tuned for web and desktop products only so far.

medstatstar-meta-analysis.title_zh: 出森林图漏斗图，附一份能原样重跑的 R
medstatstar-meta-analysis.tagline_zh: RevMan 全套加 metareg、贝叶斯网络 Meta、TSA、诊断 Meta，每一步都交可复现 R 代码。
medstatstar-meta-analysis.why_zh: 它从不替你装 R 包：装包是你在自己环境里的手动动作——这条堵住了静默改环境。
medstatstar-meta-analysis.limit_zh: 要自己装 Rscript 和二十来个包，装不上就跑不了。为绕开市场对 .R 文件的限制，R 源码以 Python 模板存着，首次要跑 check_integrity.sh 生成。只往当前目录写产物、不外传数据。
medstatstar-meta-analysis.title_en: Forest and funnel plots, plus the R code to reproduce them
medstatstar-meta-analysis.tagline_en: RevMan's full feature set plus Stata's metareg/mvmeta, Bayesian network meta, TSA and diagnostic meta — every module ships reproducible R.
medstatstar-meta-analysis.why_en: It never installs R packages for you: installing is a manual act in your own environment, which shuts the door on silent environment changes.
medstatstar-meta-analysis.limit_en: You install Rscript and twenty-odd packages yourself; if that fails, nothing runs. To work around a marketplace restriction on .R files the R source lives as Python templates, so the first run needs check_integrity.sh. It writes only into the working directory and sends no data out.

rokokol-slop-stop-skill.title_zh: 它把题解了但不给你看，只一级级放提示
rokokol-slop-stop-skill.tagline_zh: 它先自己把题解掉，然后一个字都不给你——只给机制和一个拿别人材料搭的小例子。你真卡住才一级级递提示，直接要答案那一级会被记成 surrendered，写进你的技能地图。
rokokol-slop-stop-skill.why_zh: 提示阶梯本身就是量尺：直接给答案那一级会被记成 surrendered。
rokokol-slop-stop-skill.limit_zh: 全程不替你写、不替你改、不替你跑一行任务代码，要现成解就别装。技能地图只在你同意时才动，它也不扫你的仓库来判水平——它说那证明不了什么。
rokokol-slop-stop-skill.title_en: It solves your problem, then refuses to show you
rokokol-slop-stop-skill.tagline_en: It solves the task itself and never shows you the plan — only the mechanism and a tiny example built on foreign material. Hints come one rung at a time, and only when you genuinely stall.
rokokol-slop-stop-skill.why_en: The hint ladder doubles as the measurement: the rung where it just gives the answer is recorded as `surrendered`.
rokokol-slop-stop-skill.limit_en: It will not write, edit or run a line of code for your task — not to demonstrate, not to unblock. The skill map moves only with your agreement, and it refuses to scan your repos to judge your level, since that cannot tell your code from generated code.
rokokol-slop-stop-skill.title_ban_is_product: 「不给你看」就是这件货的产物：一个宁可不给答案、只一级级放提示的导师，直接要答案会被记成 surrendered。先例是店主标过的 aryaminus-astro。
rokokol-slop-stop-skill.unshelf_reason: 上游仓 404 不存在（2026-09-03 探到；此前已被静默 hide，没有理由 —— 现在补上）。它曾是标题「禁令即产物」的判例，判例记录保留在 check_curation 注释里。

muselinn-nature-ref-verifier.title_zh: 逐条核参考文献，出字段级的验证报告
muselinn-nature-ref-verifier.tagline_zh: 整篇论文的文献表丢进去，作者顺序、卷期、页码逐字段对撞多个库，按红黄绿三级列出该改哪一条。
muselinn-nature-ref-verifier.why_zh: 它把 Crossref 覆盖率老实写成七成：中文期刊和 IEEE 老文献得另走 CNKI 万方。
muselinn-nature-ref-verifier.limit_zh: 查中文文献要另配 kimi-datasource 或 webbridge，同步 Zotero 要 zotero-mcp，缺了就只剩 Crossref 加网页兜底。它只报分歧不替你定稿。
muselinn-nature-ref-verifier.title_en: Field-by-field verification report for every reference you cite
muselinn-nature-ref-verifier.tagline_en: Drop in a whole bibliography: author order, volume, issue and page numbers get cross-checked against several databases, then graded red, amber or green.
muselinn-nature-ref-verifier.why_en: It puts Crossref coverage honestly at around 70% — Chinese journals and older IEEE entries have to go through CNKI and Wanfang instead.
muselinn-nature-ref-verifier.limit_en: Chinese-language lookups need kimi-datasource or webbridge configured, and Zotero sync needs zotero-mcp; without them you are left with Crossref plus a web fallback. It reports the disagreement and leaves the final call to you.

thekie-pr-walkthrough-skill-pr-walkthrou.title_zh: 把 agent 写的 PR 拆成层，替你措辞成意见
thekie-pr-walkthrough-skill-pr-walkthrou.tagline_zh: 按关注点而不是按文件分层，schema 和类型这种底座排在依赖它的改动前面；清单先给你看，你能重排能跳过。
thekie-pr-walkthrough-skill-pr-walkthrou.why_zh: 它把自己写成朗读者：判断哪里不对是人的事，它只负责呈现、记录和措辞。
thekie-pr-walkthrough-skill-pr-walkthrou.limit_zh: 它一个问题都不替你挑，要的是你自己一层层读完；想要现成评审结论的别装。默认关掉模型自动触发，得你点名才起。只靠 gh 看 PR 和 diff。
thekie-pr-walkthrough-skill-pr-walkthrou.title_en: An agent's PR, split into layers, with your comments phrased for you
thekie-pr-walkthrough-skill-pr-walkthrou.tagline_en: Layers are grouped by concern rather than by file, with foundations like schemas and types placed before whatever depends on them. It shows the list and stops — you may reorder, merge or skip.
thekie-pr-walkthrough-skill-pr-walkthrou.why_en: It writes itself into the reader's seat: the human decides what is wrong, and it only presents, captures and phrases.
thekie-pr-walkthrough-skill-pr-walkthrou.limit_en: It flags nothing on its own — the point is that you read every layer yourself, so skip it if you want a verdict handed over. Model auto-invocation is disabled by default, so it only fires when you call it. Works purely through `gh` on the PR and its diff.

lifei68801-contract-review.title_zh: 按你是甲方还是乙方，同一条款判反过来
lifei68801-contract-review.tagline_zh: 先填一份自家红线和你的角色，它按那一方逐条挑合同里的问题出报告——同一条付款条款，甲方看是保护，乙方看就是风险。没有配置它拒绝开审，也不替你猜你是哪一方。
lifei68801-contract-review.why_zh: 快速模式只问一句：违约责任上限不超过实收款的几成。其余按角色自动预填。
lifei68801-contract-review.limit_zh: 红线是你自己填的，填错报告就跟着错；它不懂你所在行业的监管细则，也不是律师意见。不联网、不外传合同。首次必须走完初始化，绕不过去。
lifei68801-contract-review.title_en: The same clause flips depending on which side you're on
lifei68801-contract-review.tagline_en: With no config file it refuses to start, and it will not guess whether you are the buyer or the supplier — the role decides which way every red line points.
lifei68801-contract-review.why_en: Quick mode asks exactly one question: the cap on liability as a percentage of money actually received. Everything else is prefilled from your role.
lifei68801-contract-review.limit_en: You write the red lines, so bad ones give a bad report; it does not know your industry's regulations and is not legal advice. No network, no contract leaves the machine. The first run must complete initialisation — there is no way past it.

addxing-function-testing.title_zh: 从 PRD 或提交记录出一份 Excel 测试用例
addxing-function-testing.tagline_zh: 正向、异常、边界、状态切换、数据一致性按需勾选，出概述、功能点清单、用例三张表，通过列是下拉框。
addxing-function-testing.why_zh: P0 被定死成「出错用户一定会发现、或造成线上事故」，其余一律往下压。
addxing-function-testing.limit_zh: 它的前提是开发自测、没有专职测试，所以用例数量刻意克制，要全量覆盖矩阵的别装。只出用例不跑用例，Excel 里的通过列得你自己填。
addxing-function-testing.title_en: An Excel test-case report from a PRD or a run of commits
addxing-function-testing.tagline_en: Happy path, failure, boundary, state transition and data consistency get picked as needed, then land in three sheets — overview, feature inventory, cases — with a pass/fail dropdown.
addxing-function-testing.why_en: P0 is pinned to "the user will definitely notice, or it becomes a production incident"; everything else is pushed down.
addxing-function-testing.limit_en: It assumes developers test their own work with no dedicated QA, so case counts are deliberately restrained — skip it if you want an exhaustive coverage matrix. It writes cases but never runs them, and the pass column is yours to fill.

lum1104-video-to-skill.title_zh: 把一门视频课装成一件带证据包的 skill
lum1104-video-to-skill.tagline_zh: 整个播放列表按原序过一遍，转成能讲课、能出练习、能批改的 skill；证据留在私有工作区，装出去的那份不带。
lum1104-video-to-skill.why_zh: 缺料它不遮：漏了哪一集、这缺口会让生成的 skill 少哪块能力，都写出来。
lum1104-video-to-skill.limit_zh: 不做「更新已有 skill」——重跑只会另出一份，它自己写明不会把旧的覆盖掉、也不动你的人工修改。长播放列表跑得久，断了靠缓存续。它出的是一件能讲能练能批改的 skill，不是课程摘要。
lum1104-video-to-skill.title_en: A video course, installed as a skill with its evidence bundle
lum1104-video-to-skill.tagline_en: It walks the whole playlist in order and turns it into a skill that teaches, sets practice and gives feedback — the evidence workspace stays private and never ships with the skill.
lum1104-video-to-skill.why_en: It does not paper over gaps: which items were missed, and how that missing material limits the generated skill, both get reported.
lum1104-video-to-skill.limit_en: It asks only when a real boundary appears — credentials needed, private local media about to leave the machine, a billed dependency, unexpectedly large scope — and otherwise proceeds with reversible local work. Long playlists take a while and resume from cache. It converts demonstrated capability, not transcripts, so do not expect a summary.

aiwork4me-image-metadata-cleaner.title_zh: 出一份洗掉元数据的图片副本和核验报告
aiwork4me-image-metadata-cleaner.tagline_zh: 发图前先把 GPS 坐标、机身序列号这类字段抹掉：只往新副本里写，原图一个字节不动。
aiwork4me-image-metadata-cleaner.why_zh: 它明写自己不干什么：不许用来抹 AI 标记、绕溯源或糊掉平台标注。
aiwork4me-image-metadata-cleaner.limit_zh: 只处理你自己拥有或获授权的图。脚本会拒绝把输出路径解析到输入同一个文件，也不给 --overwrite 除非你明说。它抹的是元数据，画面内容一个像素不改。
aiwork4me-image-metadata-cleaner.title_en: Sanitised copies of your images, plus a verification report
aiwork4me-image-metadata-cleaner.tagline_en: Strip GPS coordinates and camera serial numbers before you post: it writes separate copies and never touches a byte of the original.
aiwork4me-image-metadata-cleaner.why_en: It writes down what it refuses to be: not a way to hide AI authorship, defeat provenance checks, or bypass platform labels.
aiwork4me-image-metadata-cleaner.limit_en: Only for images you own or are authorised to process. The script refuses an output path that resolves to the input file, and will not take --overwrite unless you explicitly ask. It cleans metadata; the pixels are untouched.

mistake-12-bilibili-reader-skill.title_zh: 从收藏夹挑一个视频，出中英双语总结 PDF
mistake-12-bilibili-reader-skill.tagline_zh: 字幕、高赞评论和弹幕一起读，按体裁套版式出 PDF，还记着收藏夹的考古进度和你总结过什么。
mistake-12-bilibili-reader-skill.why_zh: 它拦住了最脏那条路：不许引导你从 F12 手抄 Cookie，改走扫码登录自动取。
mistake-12-bilibili-reader-skill.limit_zh: B 站三个 Cookie 明文存在 .env 里，等于账号会话落盘。要用 uv 建环境再装 Playwright chromium。开了推送，PDF 摘要会过微信飞书 Telegram 这些第三方；选不推送才全留本地。
mistake-12-bilibili-reader-skill.title_en: A bilingual PDF digest of one video from your own favourites
mistake-12-bilibili-reader-skill.tagline_en: It reads captions, top comments and danmaku together, lays the PDF out by genre, and remembers how far through your favourites you have dug and what you already covered.
mistake-12-bilibili-reader-skill.why_en: It closes off the dirtiest path: the agent is forbidden from walking you through copying cookies out of devtools, and uses QR login instead.
mistake-12-bilibili-reader-skill.limit_en: Three Bilibili cookies sit in plaintext in .env — your session lands on disk. Setup needs uv for the venv plus a Playwright chromium install. If you enable push delivery, the PDF summaries travel through WeChat, Feishu or Telegram; choosing no push keeps everything local.

abysscat-yj-video-podcast-summary.title_zh: 把一期播客做成带时间戳的单页 HTML
abysscat-yj-video-podcast-summary.tagline_zh: 核心洞察前置、目录可点、关键引述配中译、精彩对谈还原成文字，还能把片段视频嵌进去，无外部依赖。
abysscat-yj-video-podcast-summary.why_zh: 第零步是给每期单独建目录——不然上一期的 clips 和 transcript 会串进这一期。
abysscat-yj-video-podcast-summary.limit_zh: 要装 yt-dlp 和 ffmpeg，长视频转写慢。产物是一页 HTML 不是可编辑源；版式跟着仓库模板走，想换风格得自己改 references/html-template.md。
abysscat-yj-video-podcast-summary.title_en: One timestamped HTML page out of a two-hour podcast
abysscat-yj-video-podcast-summary.tagline_en: Core insights up front, a clickable table of contents, key quotes with translation, standout exchanges transcribed verbatim, and optional embedded clips — no external dependencies.
abysscat-yj-video-podcast-summary.why_en: Step zero is a fresh directory per video, because otherwise the previous episode's clips and transcript bleed into this one.
abysscat-yj-video-podcast-summary.limit_en: Needs yt-dlp and ffmpeg, and transcription of a long video is slow. The deliverable is a finished HTML page rather than an editable source; the layout follows the bundled template, so restyling means editing references/html-template.md.

fr33d3m0n-threat-modeling.title_zh: 跑八阶段 STRIDE，出 DFD 图和威胁台账
fr33d3m0n-threat-modeling.tagline_zh: 风险评估报告、数据流图、威胁清单、攻击路径验证、缓解计划、渗透测试计划一次交齐，附 CWE 和 CAPEC 映射。
fr33d3m0n-threat-modeling.why_zh: 知识库单列 llm-threats 和 agentic-threats，它按 agent 系统的攻击面建模。
fr33d3m0n-threat-modeling.limit_zh: 随件 security-controls/references/ 里有上千行 XSS 过滤绕过和 WAF bypass 载荷表（OWASP 那套），SKILL.md 一个字没提——装了它这批载荷就在你 agent 手边。八阶段很吃上下文，产物是模型和计划，不替你打补丁。
fr33d3m0n-threat-modeling.title_en: Eight-phase STRIDE, delivered as DFDs and a threat inventory
fr33d3m0n-threat-modeling.tagline_en: Risk assessment report, data-flow diagrams, threat inventory, attack-path validation, mitigation plan and pentest plan in one pass, mapped to CWE and CAPEC.
fr33d3m0n-threat-modeling.why_en: The knowledge base carries llm-threats and agentic-threats as their own files — it models the attack surface of agent systems instead of reusing a generic checklist.
fr33d3m0n-threat-modeling.limit_en: The bundled knowledge/security-controls/references/ carries over a thousand lines of XSS filter-evasion and WAF-bypass payloads (the OWASP set) that the SKILL.md never mentions — install this and those payloads sit next to your agent. A full eight-phase run costs real context, and the deliverable is models and plans, not patches.

amoshc-ai-skill-anti-seo-researcher.title_zh: 买东西前先给测评打可信度分，再给结论
amoshc-ai-skill-anti-seo-researcher.tagline_zh: 论坛帖、电商评价、评论区分层搜完再打分：一水的零缺点扣分，说得出用了八个月和退换经历的加分。
amoshc-ai-skill-anti-seo-researcher.why_zh: 「真人很少在第一句写全品牌加型号加产品线」——软文识别细到这一层。
amoshc-ai-skill-anti-seo-researcher.limit_zh: 打分规则里的关键词按地区语言从 category_profile 加载，冷门品类得你自己补画像。它靠公开搜索取料，站内隐藏内容和私域口碑抓不到，结论只是加权，不是实测。
amoshc-ai-skill-anti-seo-researcher.title_en: Credibility-scored reviews first, shopping verdict second
amoshc-ai-skill-anti-seo-researcher.tagline_en: It searches forums, marketplace reviews and comment sections in layers, then scores them: flawless write-ups lose points, and "eight months in" plus a returns story gains them.
amoshc-ai-skill-anti-seo-researcher.why_en: "Real users rarely write the full brand plus model plus product line in the first sentence" — that is the resolution its sponsored-content detection works at.
amoshc-ai-skill-anti-seo-researcher.limit_en: The scoring keywords load per region and language from a category_profile, so an unusual category means writing that profile yourself. It works from public search, cannot see gated or private-community opinion, and the verdict is a weighted read, not a hands-on test.

huiyonghkw-hekouwang-yandu-deck-skill.title_zh: 把一篇文章做成一屏一镜可翻页的演示网页
huiyonghkw-hekouwang-yandu-deck-skill.tagline_zh: 纯 CSS 加原生 JS 不引外链，自托管思源字体子集化治首屏字重跳变，一条命令发到 CF Pages。
huiyonghkw-hekouwang-yandu-deck-skill.why_zh: 它专门警告别沿用仓库里的 CF token 和 database_id，否则留言会写进别人的库。
huiyonghkw-hekouwang-yandu-deck-skill.limit_zh: 作者说清这份是可移植副本、真身在他自己项目里，副本会过时。三套引擎两套只维护存量。要 Cloudflare 账号、要自备字体源，留言板还要 D1。视觉底子是作者品牌，得自己改。
huiyonghkw-hekouwang-yandu-deck-skill.title_en: An article, rebuilt as a one-screen-per-beat flip-through deck
huiyonghkw-hekouwang-yandu-deck-skill.tagline_en: Plain CSS and vanilla JS with no external links, self-hosted subsetted Source Han fonts to kill the first-paint weight jump, and one command to publish on Cloudflare Pages.
huiyonghkw-hekouwang-yandu-deck-skill.why_en: It warns you specifically not to reuse the bundled CF beacon token or database_id — your traffic would report to someone else's dashboard and your comments land in their database.
huiyonghkw-hekouwang-yandu-deck-skill.limit_en: The author states this is a portable copy while the real system lives in his own project, so the copy drifts. Two of the three engines are maintained only for legacy decks. You need a Cloudflare account, your own font sources, and D1 for the comment board. The visual base is the author's brand and needs reworking.

littlebeaverstudio-kingdeedataexporter.title_zh: 把金蝶云星空的单据报表导成多表 Excel
littlebeaverstudio-kingdeedataexporter.tagline_zh: 按期间和组织导应收应付、科目余额、银行流水、采购销售，落成一个多工作表 Excel，还能追加官方字段。
littlebeaverstudio-kingdeedataexporter.why_zh: 随件带了二十六份官方字段说明——对着真单据啃过一遍才攒得出这种东西。
littlebeaverstudio-kingdeedataexporter.limit_zh: 只对金蝶云星空／K3 Cloud，别的 ERP 一概不通。账号密码写在本地 config.py（仓库已 gitignore）。默认不联网查更新，只在显式加 --check-update 时查。单据量大要靠 --org 和 --only 缩范围，不然会很慢。
littlebeaverstudio-kingdeedataexporter.title_en: Kingdee Cloud documents and reports, exported as one multi-sheet Excel
littlebeaverstudio-kingdeedataexporter.tagline_en: Pull receivables, payables, account balances, bank ledgers, purchase and sales documents by period and org into a single multi-sheet workbook, with official field definitions appendable.
littlebeaverstudio-kingdeedataexporter.why_en: It ships twenty-six official field-specification files — the kind of thing you only accumulate by working through real documents one form at a time.
littlebeaverstudio-kingdeedataexporter.limit_en: Kingdee Cloud / K3 Cloud only; no other ERP works. Credentials live in a local config.py, gitignored — do not commit it. It does not check for updates unless you pass --check-update. Large pulls need --org and --only to stay manageable.

obviously-not-patent-skills.title_zh: 扫一遍代码挑出可申请专利的部件，附三种权利要求写法
obviously-not-patent-skills.tagline_zh: 代码里哪一处真有区别性，自己最难看清。它按专利律师的抽象法则逐处打分，还把 bcrypt.compare() 改写成「施加密码学单向函数」——写太具体反而好绕开。
obviously-not-patent-skills.why_zh: 两头都克制：只有 8 分以上才生成权利要求，全程不联网、不写文件，并且明写自己是工程分析不是法律意见。
obviously-not-patent-skills.limit_zh: 只生成检索关键词，不替你查专利库，也不判能不能授权——作者写明「never perform searches」「NOT legal advice」，最后还是得找律师。源文件超过 100 个默认走 Quick Mode 抽样。全英文，四件是「扫描器＋验证器」两两配对，验证器不重新打分、直接信扫描器的结论。
obviously-not-patent-skills.title_en: Finds the patentable parts in your own codebase
obviously-not-patent-skills.tagline_en: The hardest thing to see in your own code is which part is actually distinctive. It scores each one by a patent attorney's abstraction rule — turning bcrypt.compare() into "applies a cryptographic one-way function", because claims that name libraries are easy to design around.
obviously-not-patent-skills.why_en: Restrained in both directions: claim language only for patterns scoring 8+, nothing leaves your machine, and it states plainly that this is engineering analysis, not legal advice.
obviously-not-patent-skills.limit_en: It writes the search queries but never runs the search, and never rules on patentability — the author states it does not perform searches and is not legal advice, so a real attorney is still the next step. Repos over 100 source files fall back to Quick Mode sampling. English only; the four skills are scanner/validator pairs, and the validators trust the scanner's scores rather than re-scoring.

konanok-photo-skills.title_zh: 一卡 RAW 筛完调完导成成片，调色参数交给模型开
konanok-photo-skills.tagline_zh: 三百张里挑十张最耗人。它先用本机 CLIP 模型筛掉废片和连拍重复，再让多模态模型开一套 Lightroom 参数，最后交 RawTherapee 出片，素材不上传。
konanok-photo-skills.why_zh: 分工分得对：筛片交给小模型（作者标 18 倍于 ViT-L/14、Top-10 重合 8/10），像素交给真 RAW 引擎，中间那层才让模型说话。
konanok-photo-skills.limit_zh: 本机要有 rawtherapee-cli——macOS 上 Homebrew 那份可能被系统拦在启动前、退出码 133，得换官方独立 CLI。筛片模型 300MB 首次运行才下载。RAW 才有 16 bit 余量，JPG/HEIC 只有 8 bit、曝光得保守。六件里一件是三合一版，photo-previewer 作者写明只在仓内用。
konanok-photo-skills.title_en: Culls and grades a whole card of RAW into finished JPGs
konanok-photo-skills.tagline_en: Picking ten frames out of three hundred is the tedious part. A local CLIP model culls the duds and burst duplicates, a multimodal model writes Lightroom-style parameters, and RawTherapee renders the files — nothing is uploaded.
konanok-photo-skills.why_en: The division of labour is right: a small local model does the culling (the author claims 18x faster than ViT-L/14 with 8/10 top-10 overlap), a real RAW engine does the pixels, and the model only speaks in the layer between.
konanok-photo-skills.limit_en: Needs rawtherapee-cli locally; on macOS a Homebrew build may be blocked before startup and exit 133, so use the official standalone CLI. The 300MB screening model downloads on first run (via an hf-mirror) and exits with manual instructions in non-interactive mode. Only RAW gives the full 16-bit latitude — JPG/HEIC are 8-bit and want conservative exposure moves. Of the six skills, one is an all-in-one merge of three others and photo-previewer is marked repo-only.

x-rayluan-openclaw-study-coach.title_zh: 发散题按四步带着想，每天给爸妈一个 3 分钟活动
x-rayluan-openclaw-study-coach.tagline_zh: 「读完这段有什么感受」——孩子答不出，家长也讲不清。它把这类题拆成四步：翻译题目、回原文找证据、给工具箱选项、组合答案，永远不替写。
x-rayluan-openclaw-study-coach.why_zh: 1-12 年级四档语气自动切换，薄弱点和错题纵向记着不重置；「禁止直接给答案」是它给自己划的死线，不是宣传语。
x-rayluan-openclaw-study-coach.limit_zh: 全中文、照中国课标写，语数英＋理科＋文综五科都在，但讲得对不对全靠模型——没有题库也没有教材，作业得你自己发进来。数据落在本机 markdown/CSV，换机器就没了。18 件里 math-tutor-sympy 在两个目录各放了一份同样的文件，要用 SymPy 得本机有 python3。
x-rayluan-openclaw-study-coach.title_en: Walks a kid through open-ended questions in four steps
x-rayluan-openclaw-study-coach.tagline_en: "How did that passage make you feel?" — the kid is stuck and the parent can't explain it either. It splits those questions into four steps: restate the question, go back to the text for evidence, offer a toolbox of options, assemble the answer. It never writes the answer.
x-rayluan-openclaw-study-coach.why_en: Four tone tiers auto-switch across years 1–12, weaknesses and mistakes are remembered longitudinally rather than reset, and "never give the answer directly" is a hard rule it sets for itself, not a slogan.
x-rayluan-openclaw-study-coach.limit_en: All Chinese and written to the mainland curriculum, covering five subject areas — but the correctness comes from the model: there is no question bank and no textbook, and you feed in the homework yourself. Data lands as local markdown/CSV, so it does not follow you to another machine. Of the 18 skills, math-tutor-sympy ships as a byte-identical copy in two directories, and SymPy needs local python3.

moonlin1213-muted-zine-poster-v01.tagline_zh: 纸感、哑光、一个色彩重音就够
moonlin1213-muted-zine-poster-v01.why_zh: 主题或句子压成竖版纸感海报，饱和度被按住。
moonlin1213-muted-zine-poster-v01.limit_zh: 不是热闹大片。要霓虹、要满版字，对不上。
moonlin1213-muted-zine-poster-v01.cover_note: 托管的是 GitHub 预览卡（1200×600/630），不上卡

zeejay0-gathered-scenes-zine-skill-moran.title_zh: 照片变电影海报，但只留你拍下的真实光影
zeejay0-gathered-scenes-zine-skill-moran.why_zh: 不是「生成一张海报」，是把搜集来的场面压成一种固定的电影静帧：低饱和、一层雾、像印在纸上。
zeejay0-gathered-scenes-zine-skill-moran.limit_zh: 风格锁死在莫兰迪电影静帧。要热闹大片、要品牌 VI、要多风格切换，这件会把你按回去。
zeejay0-gathered-scenes-zine-skill-moran.title_en: Turn your photo into a film poster using only its real light
zeejay0-gathered-scenes-zine-skill-moran.cover_note: 托管的是 GitHub 预览卡（1200×600/630），不上卡

zeejay0-gathered-scenes-zine-skill-scene.title_zh: 一张照片蒸馏成一本敢留白的迷你zine
zeejay0-gathered-scenes-zine-skill-scene.why_zh: 一场戏压成能翻的几页：顺序、留白、纸感都按刊物走。
zeejay0-gathered-scenes-zine-skill-scene.limit_zh: 页少。要长篇画册、要分镜脚本，装不下。
zeejay0-gathered-scenes-zine-skill-scene.tagline_zh: 可翻的薄刊物，不是一张海报
zeejay0-gathered-scenes-zine-skill-scene.title_en: Distill one photo into a bold, airy mini zine
zeejay0-gathered-scenes-zine-skill-scene.cover_note: 托管的是 GitHub 预览卡（1200×600/630），不上卡

jinchenma94-bazi-skill.title_zh: 四柱八字，把生辰当成一张表来排
jinchenma94-bazi-skill.why_zh: 中文现场里少见把八字写成可装 skill 的。它卖的是排盘方法，不是鸡汤运势。
jinchenma94-bazi-skill.limit_zh: 术数有门派。它按作者那一套排，跟你师傅不是同一宗时，结论对不上。不算命准不准的担保。
jinchenma94-bazi-skill.cover_note: 托管的是 GitHub 预览卡（1200×600/630），不上卡

eternityspring-shuohao-skills-novel-char.title_zh: 短剧开拍前先把角色拆开
eternityspring-shuohao-skills-novel-char.why_zh: 说浩这套里真正能上手的是拆角色：人设、关系、能演的动作，不是「一键写全集」。
eternityspring-shuohao-skills-novel-char.limit_zh: 它是短剧工业的前工序。要完整剧本、要平台发布、要自动剪辑，还得另装。

crawfordxx-xiaoma-durex-copywriter.title_zh: 按杜蕾斯海报那套双关写文案
crawfordxx-xiaoma-durex-copywriter.why_zh: 从 260 张原海报拆出双层语义和视觉公式，不是「写得性感一点」这种空指令。
crawfordxx-xiaoma-durex-copywriter.limit_zh: 配方来自避孕套海报。拿去写政务、写药品说明书、写严肃讣告，会很脏。
crawfordxx-xiaoma-durex-copywriter.cover_note: 托管的是 GitHub 预览卡（1200×600/630），不上卡

yokel1121-muyang-illustration-skills-muy.title_zh: 东方诗意插画，一款一装
yokel1121-muyang-illustration-skills-muy.why_zh: 25 款里只上这一款：诗意水墨，不是「插画工具箱」。风格锁死才像商品。

op7418-guizang-yingzao-skill-yingzao.why_zh: 不是滤镜堆叠，而是按建筑类型与地域文化做版式决策：构图、留白、字距都服务于场所精神。
op7418-guizang-yingzao-skill-yingzao.limit_zh: 只处理真实存在的中国建筑/街景/文化场所照片；虚构场景、纯商业广告、普通磨皮修图它会乱来。输入需是照片而非草图。
op7418-guizang-yingzao-skill-yingzao.tagline_zh: 拍过老街、老店、老宅却总出不来高级感？它把照片重排成杂志跨页，还能拼多图场景，附原图对比。

cli-cli-code-review.title_zh: 合代码前先过一遍仓库规矩的 gh 评审员
cli-cli-code-review.why_zh: 它不套通用规则，而是先解析仓库里的约定文件，再对照 PR 逐项检查，像老同事一样懂你们项目的脾气。
cli-cli-code-review.limit_zh: 只针对 GitHub CLI 的 PR 做静态审查，不跑测试、不查运行时问题；需要仓库有明确的约定文档。
cli-cli-code-review.tagline_zh: PR 一上来就按你仓库的约定逐条核对，不靠通用模板。它先读 CONTRIBUTING 和现有代码风格，再挑刺。
cli-cli-code-review.title_en: A gh reviewer that checks PRs against repo rules

cli-cli-dependabot-triager.title_zh: 只评不批的Dependabot PR分流员，三档结论
cli-cli-dependabot-triager.why_zh: 结论扎根于上游源码变更而非依赖元数据，能识别版本跳跃中的真实风险；状态机确保同一PR状态只评论一次。
cli-cli-dependabot-triager.limit_zh: 只处理Dependabot开的PR，且需能访问上游仓库源码；不合并、不批准、不打标签，仅输出建议。
cli-cli-dependabot-triager.tagline_zh: 每天堆积的依赖更新PR，它逐条读上游源码改动后给出Merge/先审/别合三档结论，附高/中/低置信度。

rohitg00-agentmemory-agentmemory-config.title_zh: 不翻源码就改配置，环境变量端口开关全在这
rohitg00-agentmemory-agentmemory-config.why_zh: 把散落在代码里的配置项、环境变量、端口和 feature flag 收拢成一张清单。
rohitg00-agentmemory-agentmemory-config.limit_zh: 只覆盖 agentmemory 这一个项目的配置面，不解释业务逻辑；改完配置不负责验证生效，也不管重启流程。
rohitg00-agentmemory-agentmemory-config.tagline_zh: 改端口、设 API key、开功能开关，翻遍 README 找不到的默认关闭原因，它直接告诉你。
rohitg00-agentmemory-agentmemory-config.cover_note: 仓即产品，仓级图就是这件的图

jimliu-doubao-multimodal-skill-doubao-mu.title_zh: 音视频丢给它，回来的是字幕、时间轴和谁在说话
jimliu-doubao-multimodal-skill-doubao-mu.why_zh: 它把火山方舟的多模态能力包成了顺手工具：自动传 TOS、自动下载结果，ASR 还分纯文本/逐字时间戳/。
jimliu-doubao-multimodal-skill-doubao-mu.limit_zh: 只认火山方舟的豆包模型，需要你已有 Ark API Key 且开通 TOS 存储；本地文件必须能上传。
jimliu-doubao-multimodal-skill-doubao-mu.tagline_zh: 开会录音、采访视频、技术讲座——不用本地装 Whisper，豆包多模态直接出带时间戳的字幕、说话人分离和关键帧。
jimliu-doubao-multimodal-skill-doubao-mu.cover_note: 托管的是 GitHub 预览卡（1200×600/630），不上卡

oil-oil-kimi.title_zh: 设计稿交给它，前端代码拿回来就能跑
oil-oil-kimi.why_zh: 把 Kimi 的设计判断力直接接进你的工作流，不用开 IDE、不用陪聊。它懂界面好坏，能审仓库。
oil-oil-kimi.limit_zh: 只认 Kimi Code CLI 且需预先登录；不能生成或编辑图片素材，只能分析已有的本地图和视频。
oil-oil-kimi.tagline_zh: 本地 Kimi Code CLI 的非交互封装，专治视觉方向、设计系统、界面评审和前端打磨。能看本地图和视频。

dacnay816y62-hub-window-scenery-skill.title_zh: 左下角永远钉着地名徽章的车窗风景照
dacnay816y62-hub-window-scenery-skill.why_zh: 不是简单贴图，而是把车窗框、玻璃反光和窗外景深一起算出来，徽章位置固定，批量出图时风格统一得像同一台相。
dacnay816y62-hub-window-scenery-skill.limit_zh: 只认交通工具窗景（车/船/飞机/缆车），不生成窗外特写或人像；地名徽章仅限左下角，不能改位置；要真实地名需自备列表。
dacnay816y62-hub-window-scenery-skill.tagline_zh: 坐在车里想发朋友圈，却总拍出反光玻璃和脏边框？它直接生成从车窗望出去的写实风景，每张左下角自动盖好地名徽章。
